texts.english: Rose C'est La Vie of the Moon

Leina's servant, who can transform into three forms: robot, jet helicopter and supercar. Technically a member of the Jet tribe. Because Triple Jim can carry members of the Cronos tribe, Jim is a great help when traveling, but is poor at fighting because of a gentle nature. That said, Jim understands how martial artists feel, and often put Jim's own body on the line for Leina's sake. Always humble and polite in speech, Jim shouts "It is above you, if you please!" even when warning someone that something is falling from above. In episode 24, Jim performed a catchphrase imitating Rom's. Jim also seems to be able to use Tenku Chushin Ken, though only a little.

texts.english: Triple Jim's supercar form. In the original story, Triple Jim usually carried Leina in this form when they traveled. Incidentally, Rom rode a machine called Flex.

texts.english: Triple Jim's jet helicopter form. In an emergency, Triple Jim makes high-speed trips in this form.
lines: Triple Jim's jet helicopter form. In an emergency, Triple Jim makes high-speed
trips in this form.

texts.english: Reinforced armor for the Cronos tribe, built by Wrestler Robo for Rom after Kenro was taken from him. According to Rom, it is "a magnificent design with absolutely no waste." The arms and legs are linked to the wearer's brain waves, so the wearer can move them at will, as if they were the wearer's own body. However, because it is controlled by brain waves, it has the weakness that it becomes uncontrollable if the wearer's anger is too intense, and the arms and legs stop moving entirely if the wearer freezes in fear. It can also dash at high speed using rollers and fly for short periods using thrusters, and Rom used this Power Riser to perform Tenku Chushin Ken techniques.

texts.english: A warrior of the Jet tribe who, like Rom and Drill, trained under Kirai. He was taught Tenku Shin Ken by Kirai. As his name suggests, he can transform into a jet aircraft. Within Rom's party he is the cool, handsome type, who dashes in to rescue friends and beautiful women in their moment of crisis. He is also quite sharp, and often served as Rom's strategist. His only built-in weapon is the sword stored at his waist, from which he unleashes various secret techniques of Tenku Shin Ken. The Blazer Cannon is an additional weapon that appeared from the middle of the original story; it has the same name as Rod Drill's, but the cannon on Jet fires beams.

texts.english: Blue Jet's flight form. In exchange for losing the use of his sword, Vulcans and the Blazer Cannon become usable as built-in weapons. In the original story, he also sometimes traveled with Rom hanging from him. Incidentally, the shout of "Je-e-et!" when transforming into this form was first thought up by Blue Jet and became popular among the Jet tribe.

texts.english: A fellow disciple of Rom and Jet. He is from the Battle tribe and transforms into a drill tank. Cheerful and bold, he excels at power-based fighting. He was something of a mood maker within the party, yet repeatedly saved his companions from danger with that drill. He is the type who sleeps a full 10 hours, and apparently once punched Jet in his sleep when Jet came to wake him. He has no built-in weapons, and since his trademark drill cannot be used in this form either, he fights with his fists alone, but he rarely shouts technique names; the only one confirmed is "Tenku Chushin Ken: Head-Hunting." The Blazer Cannon differs from Jet's in the shape of its muzzle, and is a missile launcher.

texts.english: Rod Drill's drill tank form. With drill charges and Vulcans, it has more armament than the humanoid form, and it can burrow underground. For some reason, Drill seems to be afraid of spiders and long, thin things (Cronos earthworms). In addition, Drill is used to handling explosives and is surprisingly an artist, making him a rather mysterious character.

texts.english: A medium-sized robot that Rom merges with. Its name is written with the characters for "sword" and "dragon." When the energy of light reaches its peak, Kenro crosses the dimensional wall and summons Kenryuu. By merging with Kenryuu, Rom is able to display tens of times his usual strength. Kenryuu often fights using Kenro, and, like Tenku Chushin Ken, makes frequent use of Tenku Shin Ken.

texts.english: A giant robot that Rom merges into, from Kenryuu. Its name is written with the characters for "double" and "kung fu." The merge into Baikanfu is specifically called the Pile Formation. When Kenro, receiving Rom's will, turns to light in midair, the Pile Formation is completed, transcending time and dimensions. Baikanfu synchronizes with all the energy on the earth's surface and can produce power capable of changing even natural phenomena. It makes relatively frequent use of electric-type techniques such as Lightning Smash and Thunder Punch, but it has many other techniques as well, each carrying one-hit-kill destructive power. The shield used by Kenryuu can, like Kenro, also be used in the Baikanfu state.

texts.english: A production-model Evangelion that follows EVA-02. It is piloted by Toji Suzuhara, who was chosen as the Fourth Child. It was shipped from NERV's 1st Branch in the United States to Japan, and during an activation test at the Second Experimental Site in Matsushiro, it was taken over by the 13th Angel Bardiel with Toji still inside. Incidentally, the reason its designation is written with the plain numeral 3 rather than with the formal kanji numeral for three, as the other units' designations are, is that this unit was built in the United States.

texts.english: Its official name is Multipurpose Humanoid Decisive Weapon, Artificial Human EVA-01. The special agency NERV spent 14 years and an enormous budget building the Evangelions as weapons for intercepting the Angels, and Unit-01 is the test type. It has an absolute domain and physical barrier called the AT Field (Absolute Terror Field), and it is operated by pilots called Children, boys and girls aged 14. It runs on power supplied from the outside through an umbilical cable, and in an emergency the cable can be disconnected (in this case the active limit time is about 5 minutes). Unit-01, piloted by Shinji Ikari, has many mysterious aspects even compared with the other Evas, such as restarting after passing its active limit and going berserk. It also has a red sphere called a core (a similar object has been confirmed in the Angels as well). Also, the Magoroku-E Sword exists only as a design concept and is a weapon that never appears in the anime.

texts.english: The first Evangelion ever built. It can be called the prototype of machines such as Unit-01 and Unit-02. Apparently it was never intended for combat deployment, so it does not support the various equipment options. Also, because it went berserk during an activation test, it had been frozen with special Bakelite. Incidentally, it seems that many units were built before this Unit-00, the one that actually functioned.

texts.english: EVA-00 that was heavily damaged in Operation Yashima and then refitted with the same armament as the other Evas. At that time its color scheme was changed to blue. Perhaps because its base frame is the experimental Unit-00, it had few chances to fight at the front and was often assigned to rear support. In the anime it was damaged in the battle with the 16th Angel Armisael, and no sorties after that have been confirmed.

texts.english: A production-model Evangelion built from the data of Unit-00 and Unit-01. It is the first Evangelion designed with combat deployment in mind. It was designed in Japan, and the final assembly and activation tests were carried out in Germany. In Asuka's words, "the real Evangelion." Its true ability was shown to the fullest in the battle against the nine Mass Production Evangelions in the theatrical film, but...

texts.english: EVA-01 in a berserk state. The berserk state is a mysterious behavior seen only in EVA-01. It is triggered mainly in desperate situations, and even Shinji, the pilot, cannot control it. In the berserk state Unit-01 is ferocious and destroys its enemies thoroughly. It also displays regenerative ability, and has even restored a severed arm by itself. In episode 18 of the TV series, it seems that Unit-01 was made to go berserk deliberately by a Dummy System that imitated Rei Ayanami's personality.

texts.english: A boar-type data weapon that symbolizes "Creation." It has an impulsive, clumsy personality, and also serves as the leader of the data weapons. It rarely materialized to fight, but it was used frequently as a weapon. Its attribute is "Light."

texts.english: A Cell Fighter fitted with a booster for use in space. The number of Hyper Dendoh Batteries it carries is greatly increased to 18, and its combat ability is also improved by the addition of a large beam cannon and missile pods, making it a heavy fighter for space combat.

texts.english: A support mecha for Dendoh, developed in GEAR Britain. During battle, it swaps Dendoh's Hyper Dendoh Batteries from the air. It carries 4 batteries, which allows two battery changes. With the arrival of the Cell Fighter, Dendoh's ability to keep fighting improved dramatically, and the range of possible operational formations also widened.

texts.english: A second-unit Cell Fighter fitted with a space booster that emphasizes combat power. It carries 12 Hyper Dendoh Batteries and is equipped with a large long-range beam cannon and space mines. Because it was developed as Vega's dedicated machine, there is a hangar for the Valkyrie on the underside of the fuselage.

texts.english: A dragon-type data weapon that symbolizes "Compassion." It has a calm, hard-to-please personality, is learned, and tends to love solitude. It often materialized to fight. Its attribute is "Flame."

texts.english: The other Gear that stands as a pair with Dendoh. This is its state with the visor raised, revealing its true face. The technology used to convert Ogre into a one-person machine could also be applied to Dendoh, so for a time Dendoh was operated by a single pilot.

Ogre equipped with Dragon Flare.
Ogre equipped with Viper Whip.

texts.english: Ogre equipped with Phoenix Alae. Naturally, it also gains unlimited energy through Infinite Layer. When made into a weapon, Phoenix Alae takes the same names as Altair's beloved swords and becomes two swords, Kumogami and Minatsuchi.

texts.english: Ogre equipped with Kiba. When Ogre uses it, it becomes Kiba Breaker. Its Final Attack is a great sword of light that cuts the enemy in two.

texts.english: A cobra-type data weapon that symbolizes "Confidence." It is delicate and shrewd, the type whose true thoughts cannot be read. It is the best schemer among the data weapons. Data weapons also have the role of unlocking the sealed abilities of the Gears, and it is said that something will happen when all six data weapons are gathered. Its attribute is "Lightning."

texts.english: Dendoh equipped with a number of weapons that Dr. Inoue secretly built in case the data weapons became unusable. Many of the weapons use physical rounds or energy packs, so battery consumption can be kept down. They are basically disposable, and once a weapon is out of ammunition, it is purged so that Dendoh can fight with a lighter body. It was probably made with a hint taken from the line Hokuto said when he first rode Dendoh: "Don't you have any weapons? Like missiles, or beams, or swords, or bows, or yo-yos?"

texts.english: A giant robot brought from outer space as a legacy of the planet Alktos. Its Japanese name, GEAR Senshi Dendo, is read "Gear Fighter Dendoh." It operates through a cockpit mechanism that traces the pilots' movements and through programs installed by the Gear Commanders. It requires two chosen pilots, and nobody else can operate it. Incidentally, Ginga rides in the right chest and Hokuto in the left chest. A major external feature is the four Hyper Plasma Drives mounted on its hands and feet, and it can unleash many special moves by using these turbines. It is powered by Hyper Dendoh Batteries and can also fly on its own through the effect of anti-magnetic lines of force, but when the batteries run out, the Gear stops functioning. On its own, Dendoh carries no firearms at all and is a melee-only machine, fighting with the movements of Ginga's Shorinji Kempo. However, by file-saving data weapons it can use weapons, and its combat power increases several times over. Each data weapon also has its own special move, a Final Attack, but these moves use up the batteries heavily and have the drawback of leaving them empty after a single shot.

texts.english: Dendoh equipped with Gatling Boar. Its Final Attack is a Gatling cannon that fires countless beam shots. The ability unlocked by Gatling Boar is Clock Manager, which can stop the time of targets within a limited field. Because it is such a convenient ability, Ginga used it often.

texts.english: Dendoh equipped with Dragon Flare. Its Final Attack is a dragon of flame that burns the enemy to ashes. The ability unlocked by Dragon Flare is Crush Ray, a destructive ray that destroys computer circuits. It has no physical destructive power, but it was extremely effective against the Gulfer, who are machine life forms.

texts.english: Dendoh equipped with Viper Whip. Its Final Attack is to throw a plasma sphere created by spinning the wire. The ability unlocked by Viper Whip is Illusion Flash, which is super-speed movement that leaves afterimages.

texts.english: Dendoh equipped with Phoenix Alae. Its Final Attack is a rainbow-colored light that destroys all machines. The ability unlocked by Phoenix Alae is Infinite Layer, which allows unlimited energy to be supplied to Dendoh.
lines: Dendoh equipped with Phoenix Alae. Its Final Attack is a rainbow-colored light

texts.english: Dendoh equipped with Bull Horn. Its Final Attack is to split the ground with a fist and make it rise up like a sword to pierce the enemy. The ability unlocked by Bull Horn is Auto Pressure, which allows the turbines to form a gravity field. Perhaps because Ginga could not make good use of gravity control, it was seldom used.

texts.english: Dendoh equipped with Unicorn Drill. Its Final Attack is a drill-shaped tornado shot. The ability unlocked by Unicorn Drill is Firewall, a transparent plate-shaped barrier. Perhaps because it was the first data weapon Hokuto saved, he is strongly attached to it, and it was the one used most often. Note that, unlike in the game, in the original work the special abilities of the data weapons saved in the Gear Commanders could be used regardless of Dendoh's form.

The ability unlocked by Leo Circle is Hyper Scan, which makes it possible to see through an opponent and search for weaknesses. It is the data weapon Ginga is most attached to, and although he used it often, the Hyper Scan ability was not put to much use.

Unlike the other Final Attacks, it is not a type that fires something, but its power is correspondingly enormous. It also helps that it holds the power of two.

texts.english: A buffalo-type data weapon that symbolizes "Wisdom." It is usually quiet, but when angered it is out of control. It is the strongest of the data weapons. For some reason it was not used much. Its attribute is "Earth."

texts.english: A unicorn-type data weapon that symbolizes "Trust." It has a curious, friendly personality. Besides becoming a weapon or materializing, data weapons can also become "aliased," taking an astral form that has no physical interference with other objects. Unicorn Drill liked to alias and would slip out of the Gear Commander on its own to play. Its attribute is "Whirl."

lines: The dedicated motorcycle of Vega, deputy commander of the Earth defense
organization GEAR. Designed by Dr. Inoue, it is a super bike that handles
everything from directing operations at the front lines to combat. It can also
transform into a water-running mode.

texts.english: Aestivalis Custom for Izumi's exclusive use. Its specs are the same as Ryoko's machine, but the head design is the same as the one Izumi rode in the days of the old Nadesico.
lines: Aestivalis Custom for Izumi's exclusive use. Its specs are the same as Ryoko's
machine, but the head design is the same as the one Izumi rode in the days of
the old Nadesico.

texts.english: Aestivalis Custom for Hikaru's exclusive use. Its specs are the same as Ryoko's machine, but the head design is the same as the one Hikaru rode in the days of the old Nadesico.
lines: Aestivalis Custom for Hikaru's exclusive use. Its specs are the same as Ryoko's

texts.english: An Aestivalis custom-made for Ryoko. It is a special version built on Ryoko's proposal that if two gravity wave units were attached to the back, the output would double as well. Using the high output from twice the normal number of gravity wave units, it can use a large rail cannon, and its mobility is also much improved, but it has become a machine that requires considerable skill to handle. The antenna on the head of Ryoko's machine is a reinforced sensor for commanders.

texts.english: The high-mobility form of Black Sarana. This is the state with the high-mobility unit attached, and in this form solo Boson Jump is possible. However, it cannot use its handgun and effectively has no means of attack other than ramming, so it is used only for limited operations such as breaking through enemy lines.

texts.english: The name Black Sarana is given to Akito's dedicated Aestivalis when thick armor and boosters are attached to it. It is a machine Nergal prepared for Akito, who acts alone for the sake of revenge. Nozzles built into various parts of the body make acrobatic high mobility possible, but as a result of pursuing mobility and heavy armor, its armament is kept to a minimum. Therefore its greatest attack is a ramming attack that makes use of its sturdiness. The tail-shaped tail binder is a manipulator arm, and has an anchor claw at its tip.

texts.english: An Aestivalis customized for Akito's exclusive use. Some say it is a prototype of the Alstroemeria. Because it was designed on the premise of attaching armor and boosters to make the Black Sarana, the wired punch and the wheels for roller dash in the heels are omitted.

texts.english: An Aestivalis with reinforced armament and output, commonly known as the Super Aestivalis. It is a powered-up version of the machine used exclusively by Akatsuki during the Jovian War. Aestivalis is the general name for a series of close-combat humanoid weapons developed by Nergal Heavy Industries, and by swapping various frames it can adapt to any battlefield. Also, because it has no generator of its own and operates by receiving a gravity beam from a battleship, it is small yet high-output. However, its control uses an IFS (Image Feedback System), and pilots must be injected with IFS nanomachines, so many people dislike it. In fact, after the end of the Jovian War, machines made by the Crimson Group, which do not require nanomachine injection, were officially adopted, but a small number of pilots still use customized Aestivalis.

texts.english: A Nadesico-class second-generation space battleship built by Nergal Heavy Industries. Because it is a test ship intended to collect operational data for a one-man-operation battleship, it can be operated by Ruri and Omoikane alone. It is equipped with two phase transition engines and four nuclear pulse engines, and can form a distortion field of higher output than the old Nadesico.

texts.english: A Nadesico-class third-generation battleship secretly built at Nergal's lunar dock, equipped with a more complete one-man operation system based on Nadesico B's data. A A-Class Jumper is required, but it is a super-high-performance ship capable of solo Boson Jump without going through a Chulip. Also, its powerful sensors and communication functions allow it to infiltrate and seize enemy computer systems, but this owes less to the ship's own ability than to the ability of Ruri and Omoikane, who have a record of seizing control of Sarutahiko during the Jovian War.

texts.english: A mass-production Dragonar. A main weapon of the Earth Alliance Forces, built at the secret weapons factory in Chongqing by making use of the combat data of the D-Weapons. Equipped with an excellent auto-sensor, it has, on paper, the combined capabilities of three machines: Dragonar-1, Dragonar-2 and Dragonar-3. Although it was given what, when you think about it, is only natural for a mass-production machine (specs superior to the prototypes), for the sake of the story it ended up as nothing more than a mecha that exists to be beaten.

texts.english: A prototype Metal Armor developed as a close-combat unit with excellent mobility, called by the abbreviation "D-1." Metal Armor is the general term for the humanoid mobile weapons developed by the Giganos Empire, and it developed from lunar work robots called Metal Workers. As this suggests, the Dragonars were made in Giganos but were seized by the Earth Alliance, and the three units together are also called the "D-Weapons." For the Earth Alliance, which lacks Metal Armor development technology, the D-Weapons are trump-card machines for turning the tide. The main armament is a 75 mm hand rail gun and close-combat laser swords mounted on both hips; the two laser swords can be joined to make a twin sword. Both shoulders also carry grenades called shoulder bombs. By being fitted with Lifter-1, a flight unit for atmospheric flight, the D-1, which already boasted high combat power, gained mobility and was powered up further. Incidentally, the D-1's computer is nicknamed Clara.

texts.english: A D-1 that underwent reinforcement modifications at the hands of Dr. Lang Plato. By incorporating know-how gained from developing the Dragoon and the Alliance's own technology, its mid-range combat and search-and-detection abilities have been improved, and its original close-combat ability has also been powered up. The two laser swords are mounted on the left hip, and a throw-in bomb is equipped on the right hip. Also, because a gravity field detection system was installed on the left shoulder, the shoulder bombs have been reduced to a single one on the right shoulder.

texts.english: A prototype Metal Armor developed for long-range support. Abbreviated "D-2." Its main armament is the 280 mm rail cannons on both shoulders, which alone have enough firepower to smash an enemy in one hit, and it also has a wealth of optional equipment such as twin Gatling cannons and rocket launchers, making it an extremely heavily armed machine. It does carry an assault knife for close combat, but it is poor at close-range fighting. The D-2's flight unit, Lifter-2, has a refueling system and can also refuel the other two machines. Incidentally, the D-2's computer is nicknamed Sonia.

texts.english: A reinforced and modified D-2. Unlike the D-1 Custom, which raised overall performance, the modification focused on raising firepower, the D-2's greatest feature. The rail cannons on both shoulders have become a large 640 mm caliber, and the twin automatic cannons that were omitted when the Lifter is worn have been revived. In addition, twin heavy dual missiles have been newly added to the legs. Naturally, armor and generator output have also been increased.

texts.english: A prototype Metal Armor developed for electronic warfare. With excellent reconnaissance, detection and intelligence-gathering abilities, it supports the combat operations of the D-1 and D-2 and disrupts the enemy. It can also hack enemy base computers and neutralize enemy holograms, so its field of activity is broad. However, since it is not a combat machine, its armor and armament are kept to a minimum, and various sensors and radars are embedded in their place. Lifter-3, the flight unit for the D-3, is likewise a lightweight type that emphasizes speed, and the D-3 has the highest speed of the three machines. Incidentally, the D-3's computer is nicknamed Maggie.

texts.english: The state in which the Gundam Mk-II and the G-Defenser have combined. It makes up for the Gundam Mk-II's weakness, its fragile armor, and strengthens firepower by using the Long Rifle, the main gun of the G-Defenser. It can also combine with the Mk-II while the G-Defenser stays in its aircraft form, and that configuration is called the G-Flyer (it does not appear in the game). Also, in Super Gundam form the G-Defenser's Core Fighter is separated, so it is a one-seater.

texts.english: A prototype transformable mobile suit that the AEUG had Anaheim Electronics develop. It was a major milestone of the Z Project, Anaheim's new mobile suit development program, and it is a famous masterpiece that produced derivative machines such as the Hyaku Shiki and the Methuss during prototyping, and successors such as the Zeta Plus, the ZZ Gundam and the Re-GZ. It was completed by combining the movable frame technology obtained from the Gundam Mk-II, the armor material of the Rick Dias, and ideas proposed by Kamille (such as the Mk-II's flying armor). By transforming into Waverider form, it can enter the atmosphere without options such as a ballute system, and can also fly within the atmosphere. In mobile suit form as well it has high mobility and maneuverability, and thanks to its high-output generator it can also use powerful weapons such as the Hyper Mega Launcher. Later a Bio Sensor was introduced, and the machine's responsiveness improved greatly. Judau piloted it in the early part of "Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ," and even after the ZZ Gundam appeared he used this machine in situations that called for mobility.

texts.english: The high-speed mobile form of the Zeta Gundam. By transforming, it concentrates the direction of its verniers toward the rear and obtains tremendous mobility. This high thrust also allows it to fly within the atmosphere. The biggest merit of transforming into this form is that atmospheric entry becomes possible without optional equipment such as a ballute system. Thanks to this function, the Zeta Gundam came to occupy an important position strategically as well. There also seems to be a variation called the "Wave Shooter," in which the flying armor is swapped for something else.

texts.english: A prototype mobile suit developed by Anaheim Electronics and operated by the AEUG. Its developer is Dr. M. Nagano. It was developed as a transformable mobile suit as part of the Z Project, Anaheim's new mobile suit development program, but a structural defect was discovered and the transformation mechanism was omitted. Even so, its machine performance was high, and it was judged fully usable in actual combat, so it was assigned to the Argama. Its greatest feature is its gold armor, which apparently also had anti-beam coating ability. Furthermore, the "hyaku" (one hundred) in its name also carries the meaning of "a mobile suit that lasts a hundred years." With a high-output generator that can run the optional Mega Bazooka Launcher on its own, the high mobility given by the flexible binders on its back, and Quattro's piloting skill, it achieved great results, starting with the assault on Jaburo. It was heavily damaged in the final battle with Haman, but in "Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ" a second unit was assigned to the Argama and was mainly piloted by Beecha.

texts.english: One of the plans for strengthening the armament of the Hyaku Shiki Kai. It mounts both beam weapons and ballistic weapons on the main body to improve firepower, and at the same time its defense is strengthened by the reflector panels on the chest. In reality, large transformable mobile suits came into their heyday, and it was never mass-produced.

texts.english: An ultra-high-performance machine developed on the base of the MSK-008 Dijeh. Although the details are unknown, various revolutionary functions have been added, and it apparently may be called a completely different machine. This can also be inferred from the fact that the Dijeh SE-R's model number, SE.DJ-1R, is unique and unlike any other.

texts.english: A Neo Zeon prototype mobile suit exclusively for Newtypes, improved from Haman's prototype unit 1. The prototype unit 2, with a black color scheme, is piloted by Ple. The main improvement is that the beam saber that doubles as a beam gun has become a three-pronged type, giving a slight increase in offensive power; its basic performance is equal to that of prototype unit 1.

texts.english: A Neo Zeon prototype mobile suit exclusively for Newtypes, improved from Haman's prototype unit 1. The prototype unit 3, with a red color scheme, is piloted by Ple Two. The difference from unit 2 is that it is equipped with a psycommu controller that allows external operation, and its basic performance is equal to that of prototype units 1 and 2.

texts.english: A prototype transformable heavy mobile suit that the AEUG had Anaheim Electronics develop. It was completed in Anaheim's Z Project after the Zeta Gundam. Its development concept is "an RX-78 and G-Armor that can operate alone." For that reason it inherits the transformation system built for the Zeta Gundam and the core block system and G-Parts mechanism of the RX-78 Gundam, and is made up of a Core Fighter, a Core Top forming the upper body, and a Core Base forming the lower body. Furthermore, each can be operated as a fighter, and in the combined state it can transform into the heavy fighter-bomber G-Fortress. It also emphasizes firepower, carrying many high-output beam weapons, starting with the High Mega Cannon on its forehead. On the other hand, it has the drawback of a short operating time because it consumes a great deal of energy. Among the mobile suits of around U.C. 0087 that pursued high output, it can be called the highest point reached. Judau Ashta piloted it and became the core of the Gundam Team.

texts.english: The heavy fighter-bomber form into which the ZZ Gundam transforms. It is made up of the Core Top (the ZZ Gundam's A-Part and a Core Fighter) and the Core Base (the ZZ Gundam's B-Part and a Core Fighter), and is mainly used for long-distance travel. The ZZ Gundam was developed on the concept of handling an RX-78 Gundam and a G-Armor with a single machine, but the G-Fortress was not given as much versatility as the G-Armor. However, its attack power was the strongest around U.C. 0087.

texts.english: A powerful battleship built by Anaheim Electronics on the basis of the Argama. "Nahel Argama" means "close to the Argama." It has five catapults for mobile suits and a main gun on the level of a colony laser. Also, thanks to computer support, each gun can be operated from the bridge, so it can be run with a very small crew.

texts.english: A mobile suit support machine developed by Anaheim Electronics. It inherits the design philosophy of the self-propelled mobile suit gun platforms that existed in the One Year War, and can be operated as a sub-flight system armed with powerful weapons. It also has simple living quarters, so it can be used as a mobile base for long operations. It was used when the Gundam Team, who had descended to Earth, acted separately from the Argama.

texts.english: A mobile suit for Newtypes that Anaheim Electronics developed with its full strength at the request of the Earth Federation Forces' Londo Bell unit. The pilot, Amuro, took part in the design himself, and it is an ultra-high-performance machine that can be called the culmination of all the Gundams to date. By using the new material psycho-frame, brought by Neo Zeon leader Char Aznable, around the cockpit and in the drive system, it boasts outstanding responsiveness and maneuverability. The psycho-frame also controls the machine's greatest feature, the Fin Funnels, psycommu-applied weapons installed for the first time on a Gundam-type mobile suit. Compared with conventional funnels, the Fin Funnels are larger and higher-output; besides being used as mega particle cannons, combining several of them generates a magnetic field and makes it possible to deploy a beam barrier. It is also well balanced in its other armament, carrying beam weapons, ballistic weapons and close-combat weapons. It fought a deadly battle with Char's Sazabi on the falling Axis, and afterward, in order to stop Axis from falling, it formed a mysterious force field through the resonance of the psycho-frame. Taking its armament, machine performance and pilot Amuro's skill together, it is no exaggeration to call it the strongest Gundam.

with conventional funnels, the Fin Funnels are larger and higher-output; besides
being used as mega particle cannons, combining several of them generates a
magnetic field and makes it possible to deploy a beam barrier. It is also well
balanced in its other armament, carrying beam weapons, ballistic weapons and
close-combat weapons. It fought a deadly battle with Char's Sazabi on the
falling Axis, and afterward, in order to stop Axis from falling, it formed a
mysterious force field through the resonance of the psycho-frame. Taking its
armament, machine performance and pilot Amuro's skill together, it is no
exaggeration to call it the strongest Gundam.

texts.english: The mobile armor form in which the Re-GZ is equipped with the Back Weapon System. Mobility, long-range cruising ability and firepower are dramatically improved. However, the Back Weapon System is used in a nearly disposable manner, and re-equipping it (on the battlefield) after it has been detached and the machine has become a mobile suit is impossible.

texts.english: A prototype mobile suit developed by Anaheim Electronics and used by the Londo Bell unit. It is a simplified mass-production prototype of the Zeta Gundam, and by being equipped with the Back Weapon System it becomes a mobile armor. This mechanism succeeded in improving producibility while maintaining high machine performance. Even so, it was far more expensive than other mass-produced machines, and its deployment ended with a single unit in the Londo Bell unit. Incidentally, Re-GZ is short for "Refined Gundam Zeta."

texts.english: A heavily armored, heavily armed Mobile Fighter that is the pride of Neo America. Boxer Mode, in which the chest armor is purged and the shoulder armor is fitted over the fists like gloves, is a desperate tactic that throws away defense to double its footwork. At this time, using the thrusters inside the shoulder armor also increases the destructive power of its punches. In addition, the dedicated shield is an excellent piece of equipment: it can be ridden like a surfboard and used as a transporter for high-speed movement.

texts.english: Gundam Maxter with Super Mode activated.
lines: Gundam Maxter with Super Mode activated.

texts.english: A Neo France Mobile Fighter that excels in reconnaissance ability and mobility. It is a swordsmanship-based machine that makes use of the specialty of its pilot, George. Its greatest feature, however, is the Rose Bits built into the cape-type shield on its left shoulder, and its special move is an attack using countless bits that are freely controlled by brain waves. The Rose Bits are a highly versatile weapon that can also be used as a barrier or as an electromagnetic net to trap enemies, and Gundam Rose carries out a gorgeous and elegant style of combat.

texts.english: Gundam Rose with Super Mode activated.
lines: Gundam Rose with Super Mode activated.

texts.english: The newest-model Mobile Fighter that Neo Japan had been developing for the Gundam Fight Finals. "Mobile Fighter" is the general term for the melee-centered mobile suits made for the Gundam Fight, and they are operated by transmitting the pilot's movements to the machine through the Mobile Trace System. For this reason the pilot must have the makings of a martial artist. Put another way, this means no special training is required, but in reality the damage the machine takes is also transmitted to the pilot, so it can only be handled by a true martial artist whose mind and body have both been tempered. God Gundam has a built-in energy multiplier, an enhanced version of the Shining Gundam's emotional energy conversion system, and can convert the pilot's ki into energy. The state in which the machine's performance is greatly increased by this system is called Hyper Mode, and the machine shines gold. God Gundam surpasses the Shining Gundam in every respect, and even Domon, who had handled the Shining Gundam freely, was overwhelmed by its power.

texts.english: God Gundam with the cooling fins on its back opened to release the residual heat from activating Hyper Mode. It almost looks as if it is giving off a halo.

texts.english: God Gundam riding Fuunsaiki in Hyper Mode.
lines: God Gundam riding Fuunsaiki in Hyper Mode.

texts.english: A Mobile Fighter of Neo China that emphasizes burst speed. It was designed on the premise that a martial artist would ride in it, and although it has fewer verniers than other Gundams, it has extremely high mobility. The twelve Feilong Flags in total, mounted on its back and both shoulders, are beam lances that generate flag-shaped beams, an all-purpose weapon that can be used for any purpose, including harassing fire. In addition, the Dragon Claws on both arms extend and retract freely and can also make flame attacks, and even the queue at the back of its head traces the pilot's movements, serving as a hidden weapon that strikes vital points when the enemy is caught off guard.

lines: Dragon Gundam with Super Mode activated.

texts.english: A Mobile Fighter of Neo Sweden. It is also the only female-type Gundam of the 13th Gundam Fight. Its armor has been pared down to the limit in favor of mobility and flexibility, and it bewilders enemies with its quick movements. Its greatest feature is the Berserker System, which forcibly draws out the pilot's fighting instinct and makes her display 120% of her combat ability; when Berserker Mode is activated, the parts corresponding to its hair, the cooling fins, are deployed. After fighting and losing to Domon, she no longer used the Berserker System and instead learned the Double God Finger, but it is unclear whether the God Finger's capability was added to the Nobel Gundam.

texts.english: A Mobile Horse operated by Fuunsaiki, Master Asia's beloved horse. Originally a support unit for Master Gundam, it can transform into a carrier for breaking through the atmosphere.

texts.english: A heavyweight Mobile Fighter of Neo Russia that pursues striking power over mobility. It was built as a result of capturing and studying machines of other nations, and it has independent-drive Viktor Engines built into various parts of its body, giving it a total output twice that of an ordinary Mobile Fighter. For that reason, although it is heavily armored, it is also capable of high mobility that does not match its rugged design. The Graviton Hammer, which swings an iron ball mounted on its left shoulder, is a pure mass weapon and therefore cannot be defended against.

texts.english: A Mobile Fighter of Neo Nepal. Its prayer-bead-like arms and waist allow quite flexible movement. In place of legs it is equipped with high-output thrusters and moves through the air as if sliding. It also has a transformation mechanism to a defensive form in which the waist and chest are stored in its bell-shaped lower body.

texts.english: A military Mobile Fighter of Neo Japan. It is a sibling machine of the Shining Gundam and was meant to be used by Major Urube in the fight against the Devil Gundam. The armor on both shoulders attaches to the Beam Bow on its left hand to become the Rising Shield. Its basic performance is equal to the Shining Gundam's, but it has no Super Mode, and its machine tuning is set for weapon combat rather than melee combat.

texts.english: A new female-type partner robot for Mazinger Z that replaces the destroyed Aphrodite A. A motorcycle called the Scarlet Mobile docks with its head and becomes the cockpit. Compared with Aphrodite A, its combat strength has been improved because it was developed from the start for the purpose of fighting the Mechanical Beasts, but a cockpit consisting only of the Scarlet Mobile (the motorcycle) is, in a sense, even more dangerous than Boss Borot.

texts.english: A robot that Boss forced the three Photon Power Laboratory scientists to build. It is made from scrap, but there were times when it showed that it could help Mazinger Z and Great Mazinger. In addition, various enhancement modifications were made depending on the situation, on Boss's ideas.

texts.english: A super robot completed by Dr. Juzo Kabuto over fifteen years. However, the doctor was assassinated by the Iron Mask sent by Baron Ashura, and Mazinger Z was entrusted to his grandson Koji. It uses Photon Power energy, and its armor is made of Super Alloy Z, refined from Japanium ore. It is equipped with various weapons over its whole body, and its combat strength is said to rival the U.S. Seventh Fleet. It could not fly on its own, but it later overcame that weakness by combining with the Jet Scrander, the Crimson Wings. The Jet Scrander has variable wings, which sweep back when flying at high speed of Mach 2.3 or more. Like Mazinger, the Scrander is also made of Super Alloy Z and has built-in weapons such as the Southern Cross Knives. In addition, it has a kind of overboost mechanism called Mazin Power, which was used when in a pinch.

texts.english: A combat super robot that Dr. Kenzo Kabuto, who predicted the Mycenae Empire's invasion of the surface, developed using the basic design of Mazinger Z as a base. It uses Photon Power energy, and its armor is made of Super Alloy New Z. It is piloted by the small fighter Brain Condor performing a Fire On onto Great Mazinger. In addition, the retractable wings built into its back, the Scramble Dash, allow it to fly at Mach 4. Much of its armament shares Mazinger Z's concept, but it is equipped with distinctive weapons: the Mazinger Blade, which is effective in close combat, and the ultra-high-voltage discharge Thunder Break. Later, the Great Booster was developed with the aim of improving its mobility and attack power. Its weak point is the Scramble Dash storage section, and if it is attacked there, all functions are paralyzed for an instant.

texts.english: A female-type combat robot that Dr. Kenzo Kabuto, who predicted the Mycenae Empire's invasion of the surface, developed as a partner for Great Mazinger. Its control craft is the small fighter Queen Star. Because it was developed for combat from the start, it has enough power to stand up to the Warrior Beasts. It can also fly thanks to the Venus Scrander, which was developed later.

texts.english: A mass-produced version of the Great Mazinger that appears in Gosaku Ota's manga version of "Great Mazinger." Shinsuminichi Heavy Industries, which had developed the humanoid weapon GMFA-1, obtained the blueprints of the Great Mazinger by illegal means and built it. Its appearance and performance are basically the same as the original, but the mass-produced type has a number marked on its chest. Also, in the work, in order to distinguish the original from the mass-produced type, Boss painted "Ganso" (Original) on the waist of Tetsuya's Great Mazinger. Besides these, there is one mass-produced Great Mazinger with an all-black body.

texts.english: The prototype of the mass-produced Great Mazinger that appears in Gosaku Ota's version of "Great Mazinger." Unlike the other mass-produced units, its whole body is painted black, and it has no machine number either. The president of Shinsuminichi Heavy Industries had it attack Tetsuya's Great in order to give a presentation to people in the defense and intelligence fields of countries around the world. At that time it showed glimpses of power exceeding the original and overwhelmed Tetsuya. It passes into the hands of the Mycenae Empire together with the other mass-produced units, but Tetsuya and the others destroy its autopilot device, and they operate it as the "Great Corps."

Boss himself gave the reason: "There are lots of them, so this makes it easy to tell." Its performance and everything else are the same as the original.

texts.english: A Getter Robo built by the Dinosaur Empire from blueprints stolen from the Saotome Institute. It is read "Getter Queen." It is piloted by Gola, the daughter of Dinosaur Emperor Gore. Because Gola had come to feel affection for humanity, she shielded Getter Robo from the attack of Mechasaurus Gin and met a tragic end, exploding and taking Gin down with her. Although it bears the Getter name, since the Dinosaur Empire uses it, it is unclear whether its power source is Getter Rays. Its weapons are also completely unknown.

texts.english: A new-type Getter Robo developed by Dr. Saotome for combat from the start. The Getter Ray amplifier gives it ten times the power of the first Getter, and its armor newly uses Synthetic Steel G. Getter Dragon, which combines in the order Dragon, Liger, Poseidon, is mainly for aerial combat, and Ryoma continues from Getter 1 as its pilot. It boasts the highest combat strength of the three forms, and above all the later-added Shine Spark is its strongest special move.

Getter Liger, which combines in the order Liger, Poseidon, Dragon, is mainly for ground and underground combat, and Hayato is its pilot. It boasts the highest mobility of the three forms and uses Alter Ego and Mach Special. Also, its right hand is a five-fingered manipulator, but it can transform into a drill depending on the situation. Note that in the original work, Getter Liger can fly from the start as well.

Getter Poseidon, which combines in the order Poseidon, Dragon, Liger, is a bipedal type, unlike Getter 3. It is mainly used in underwater combat. Also, its legs can be bent below the knee and transformed into caterpillar treads. Its pilot is Benkei, who newly joined the Getter Team in place of Musashi, who lost his life in the fight against the Dinosaur Empire. Note that in the original work it does not use Daisetsuzan Oroshi as it does in the game. It boasts the highest power of the three forms. Also, in "Getter Robo G" it was later modified so that it could fly.

texts.english: A UFO Robot built by gathering the scientific power of Planet Fleed. Its pilot is Duke Fleed, and it has a self-defense system that gives an electric shock to anyone who approaches it other than a person who holds the proof of the Fleed royal family. Its armor uses Cosmic Alloy Gren, which does not exist on Earth, and its energy source is photons collected from light such as the sun's. It can combine with the support combat saucer Spazer, and with the three kinds of Earth-made Spazers built later, it can adapt to any situation. Its weapons are powerful ones, such as Space Thunder, which emits a 60,000-degree beam, and Double Harken, a giant scythe used by combining the crescent-shaped blades on both shoulders. It reached Earth with Duke and was hidden beneath the Institute of Space Science until the Vegan Empire appeared.

texts.english: The form of Grendizer and Double Spazer combined. It is a machine that excels at aerial combat, born when the two machines combine with the shout "Combination Cross." Duke does the main piloting, but Koji operated the Double Spazer's weapons. Unlike with the Spazer, the weapons and limbs that were unusable after combining can be used freely, so there are no restrictions on movement during combat, and both flight ability and combat ability are improved. Note that although they do not appear in the game, the original work also featured the Marine Spazer for underwater use and the Drill Spazer for underground use.

texts.english: The name of the support saucer mecha that strengthens Grendizer's flight ability, armament and armor, but the state combined with Grendizer is also called by this name. Like Grendizer, it has a body of Cosmic Alloy Gren, and when it combines with the shout "Spazer Cross," the seat moves to the Spazer control cockpit in front of the tail fin. Also, even when separated it can be remotely operated unmanned, fulfilling the role of assisting Grendizer. In space it is capable of hyperspace navigation; in the atmosphere it cannot reach that kind of speed, but when it flies at full power its body glows brightly and it truly becomes a UFO. Grendizer normally waits in this state in the hangar inside the Institute of Space Science, and so that the base's location would not be discovered, each time it sortied it chose one launch point from among the normal launch gate and the secret launch gates Route 1 through Route 8. Incidentally, Route 1 is a volcano crater, Route 2 a virgin forest, Route 3 an abandoned mine, Route 4 Hell Valley, Route 5 a lake, Route 6 a cave in a mountainside, Route 7 a waterfall basin, and Route 8 a factory ruin.

Institute of Space Science, and so that the base's location would not be
discovered, each time it sortied it chose one launch point from among the
normal launch gate and the secret launch gates Route 1 through Route 8.
Incidentally, Route 1 is a volcano crater, Route 2 a virgin forest, Route 3 an
abandoned mine, Route 4 Hell Valley, Route 5 a lake, Route 6 a cave in a
mountainside, Route 7 a waterfall basin, and Route 8 a factory ruin.

texts.english: A large support fighter developed by Genzo Umon. It was the first Earth-made Spazer, and in the story Koji Kabuto rode it. It combines with Grendizer depending on the situation. It was designed as a VTOL aircraft and has large rotors on both wings. The wings tilt up and down and the nose can also move like the Concorde's, so the machine's silhouette changes when landing, in flight, and when combining. Its body is made of the same Super Alloy New Z as Great Mazinger, and it is a hybrid machine whose power source uses the same photonic energy as Grendizer.

texts.english: The world's first Earth-made UFO, designed by Koji Kabuto and built at NASA. At first it was not meant for combat, so it had no weapons at all, but it was later equipped with rapid-fire small missiles and a machine gun. Its maneuverability is high, and it can fight Minifos on even terms. Against Saucer Beasts it can only be called underpowered, but it was active when it counted, such as saving Grendizer when it was in a pinch.

texts.english: A Hakke robot bearing the title of "Heavens." Its power is the greatest among the Hakke robots. It was built by Tekkoryu but was stolen after completion. It was then secretly placed under the control of the Japanese government, but with Tekkoryu's start of activity it became a target for recapture. It has no optional equipment at all, and fights with beams and shock waves fired from the light spheres on the backs of its hands, and with melee combat. Its finishing move, the "Hades Attack," fired by bringing the light spheres on its chest and both arms together in front of the chest, has the power to break down every atom. It can also deploy a high-output barrier, making it a machine well balanced in both offense and defense. Each Hakke robot can only be piloted by a specific person, but Zeorymer is a special machine that requires two people: main pilot Masato Akitsu and sub-pilot Miku Himuro. However, Miku is only support, and only Masato can pilot it. Masato alone can also move it, but its power drops. It is housed in the hangar of the Japanese government's secret base "Last Guardian," beneath the Aokigahara sea of trees, in a state divided into four parts: the chest light sphere, upper torso, both arms, and lower body.

texts.english: Zeorymer without Miku aboard. Because Miku was taken away by Tekkoryu, Masato alone boarded it and fought Rose C'est la vie. The light in the chest light sphere has gone out, and it can only produce less than one third of its original power.

texts.english: A defensive fighter owned by Daimobic. Its pilots are Kyoshiro Yuzuki and Nana Izumi, and its main mission is supporting Daimos. It has two Vulcans behind the cockpit and missiles under the main wings, and sometimes fired beams from the antenna-like part on its nose. Its combat power is surprisingly high, and it saved Daimos from danger many times. Of course, it can also operate in space. Also, perhaps because its pilot Kyoshiro is skilled, it showed considerable maneuverability and dodged enemy attacks over and over, and was almost never shot down. For that reason it gives a very sleek impression compared with Daimos, which is always covered in scars.

texts.english: A super robot built through the cooperation of Dr. Ryuzaki and Dr. Izumi. It was originally a trailer for underground development that was converted into a combat robot, and uses Daimolite as its energy source. Daimolite is crystallized light born from a neutrino reaction; the light particles solidified under high gravity collide violently with one another and thereby keep emitting enormous energy. Also, Daimolite triggers a nuclear reaction and explodes massively at 4 degrees Celsius or above, and when fully released, it turns Daimos itself into a pure energy body. Because Daimos has a control system that traces the pilot's movements, it reproduces Kazuya's karate techniques without the slightest error, but conversely it has the weakness that when Daimos takes damage, the pilot takes damage too. Its weapons are mostly mid- and close-range ones such as the Five Shooter and the Triple Dragon Staff, making it a machine that emphasizes close combat. Also, the "Deadly Gale Correct Fist Thrust" was originally not a combination technique with Blizzard-type weapons but the name of the karate technique itself that delivers the finishing blow; likewise, following up from Blizzard-type weapons, it also used the "Deadly Gale Hand-Blade Thrust" and the "Deadly Daimos Chop."

texts.english: An all-purpose fighter owned by Mutropolis. It was used for many purposes, including not only combat but also reconnaissance, investigation and rescue operations. In the original story, it has a crew of three, and the upper part of the cockpit is a small aircraft, the Spit Fighter, which also serves as an escape device.

texts.english: A mystical super robot built through the science of the ancient Mu Empire 12,000 years ago. Normally it is stored in a golden base-body state inside Divine Face Rock, and it starts moving when Akira climbs into it (fade-in). It uses the mysterious energy Mutron, and the Mutron metal used in its armor exhibits self-repair ability by returning to the base-body state. There are also many parts of its interior that remain unexplained, and in the latter half of the original story it showed its true power through a Mutron energy release device called the Star of Ra Mu. Its main finishing move is Godbird, in which it transforms into a bird form and charges at Mach 7. Raideen can be piloted only by Akira, who carries the blood of Ra Mu, emperor of the Mu Empire, and its control method is a unique one that is integrated with Akira's body movements.

texts.english: Raideen's bird-shaped flight form, mainly used when traveling long distances. It also takes this form when using the finishing move "Godbird," in which it sets its aim on an opponent's weak point and charges. There is much about its internal structure that is unknown, and from the middle of the story onward it comes to use a brutal technique called Head Cutter.

texts.english: A VTOL aircraft that Haruka Shitow used to infiltrate TOKYO JUPITER ahead of the start of Operation Overlord. It is equipped with TDDU, an absolute barrier penetration system. It was also used when she escaped from TOKYO JUPITER together with Ayato, but it was guided to RahXephon and sank into the spring that spreads across the Room of Rah.

texts.english: A new TERRA weapon. It was brought into TERRA from the Bahbem Foundation and assigned to Alpha Squadron. Since only one unit was deployed at first, Elvy, the squadron leader, became its pilot. Unlike RahXephon, which only Ayato can ride, its cockpit is built very much like the Shinsei's, so even ordinary pilots can operate it with training. It has a weapon called the "Bausgazal" that can fire a railgun and wave-light bullets, and its power is such that a single shot blows away a reef. It also has the absolute barrier penetration system TDDU built in, and can break through the TOKYO JUPITER barrier under its own power. While on standby it is housed with a dedicated maintenance arm connected to and holding the thruster section at the waist, and at launch it is shot out directly from this state. Incidentally, the internal structure of the Vermillion is completely unknown.

texts.english: An Anti-D fighter of the Earth Federation air force. It is armed with high-speed missiles and boasts high maneuverability. However, because it has no effective equipment against Dolems, it often ended up supporting RahXephon. The absolute barrier penetration system TDDU can be installed. The reason the machine Elvy flies is painted red is that it is the squadron leader's machine.

texts.english: A giant god that awoke from the dimensional egg in the Seon Temple "Room of Rah," located under the MU Tokyo Government-General in the center of TOKYO JUPITER. It moves by synchronizing with Ayato's consciousness, and no one but Ayato can pilot it. However, it can act autonomously, attack in self-defense, and move on its own in search of Ayato. When the chest armor opens, a core appears, and it takes Ayato into its womb through the core. The inner cavern that corresponds to the cockpit is called the "Instrumentalist's Seat," and its base is filled with water called the "Spring of Oracles," with a feather-shaped chair jutting out from the spring. Incidentally, RahXephon's pilot is called an "instrumentalist" by some people. The feathers on both sides of its forehead can be opened and closed freely, and are kept closed when Ayato is not aboard or during autonomous action. RahXephon's eyes are normally red, but beneath them is a golden eyeball called the "Eye of Truth." It also has an openable visor at the brim, which can cover the eyes. It has no armament or options at all; it emits high-frequency sound from its mouth and smashes enemies with light from its palms. Because its material, structure and power source are all unknown, the Earth Federation side classifies it as Mulian Artifact Class 5A (Five-A). A giant god of many mysteries that evolves along with Ayato's mental growth.

texts.english: The form born when Ayato, having reached the true heart "Yolteotl," fused with the vessel "Xephon" and the guide "Ixtli" and obtained the title of Rah. It has the ability to fill the world with sound and tune the world. It emits rainbow-colored high-frequency waves and also possesses overwhelming arm strength. The white wings are not for flying but for tuning the world. Ayato overcame various hardships and found someone he must protect, and grew mentally; he and Ixtli, who had the form of Reika Mishima, accepted each other and became one, and as a result he obtained the "title of Rah" and transformed RahXephon into Shinsei RahXephon.

It also occasionally activates new abilities. When the Eye of Truth opens, Ayato sometimes sees the figure of Reika Mishima, who should have died.

the Eye of Truth opens, Ayato sometimes sees the figure of Reika Mishima,
who should have died.

texts.english: Experimental Unit No. 7 among the humanoid mobile weapons developed in the "Tsentr Project" being pursued within the Federation Army. Also called a TE Absorber, it is a machine that excels at close combat and melee. However, the TE Engine, which applies Terminus Energy, has many problems with power output adjustment and so on, so the drive of the joints and other parts is supplemented by batteries. Also, to allow finer output adjustment of the TE Engine and to assist machine control, DFC (Direct Feeling Control) has been introduced, and an operator wearing a special DFC suit rides along on the machine. Its model number is YTA-07RB. One unit of the same type exists, but since it is mostly meant as spare parts, it is not used for tests or combat.

texts.english: Experimental Unit No. 9, developed in the Tsentr Project. Its model number is YTA-09RB. It consists of a main body built from the various data obtained from Experimental Unit No. 7, and support combat mecha called "Machine Animaloids." The TE Engine has also been replaced with a new type, with improved output and stability compared with that of Unit No. 7. It can also use an energy field called the "TE Sphere," which raises its defense. There are two kinds of Machine Animaloid, the bird-type unmanned fighter "Hiou" and the wolf-type unmanned mobile weapon "Rouga," and each can operate alone, but normally they are split into parts and attached to Experimental Unit No. 9's arms, legs, shoulders, back and so on. The form with the striking weapon formed from Rouga's head on the right arm and the Wing Booster formed from Hiou on the back is called "Form G," and like Unit No. 7 it displays performance specialized for close combat and melee. The Wing Booster also improves its aerial combat ability.

texts.english: Experimental Unit No. 8, developed in the Tsentr Project. Its model number is YTA-08BW. It consists of a main body built from the various data obtained from Experimental Unit No. 6, and an additional weapon unit, the "Ignite Parts." The TE Engine has also been replaced with a new type, with improved output and stability compared with that of Unit No. 6. It can also use an energy field called the "TE Sphere," which raises its defense. The Ignite Parts can be operated alone as unmanned fighters, but basically they are used attached to the main body of Experimental Unit No. 8. Also, the main body of Unit No. 8 transforms into Figure W, a close-combat form, and Figure B, an artillery form (the front and back of the body are reversed), giving it more versatility than Unit No. 6. The state in which the Ignite Parts are attached to Figure W is called "Form G," and it displays performance specialized for close combat.

texts.english: A Gyandlar Commander whose body is made of iron sand. It has the ability to change its form into any shape, and because it originally has no fixed form, it takes no damage from physical attacks. It has a will of its own, but it can also merge with others, and it powered up by merging with Bug Newman. It has weapons usable at both long and short range, such as electromagnetic irradiation and the Double Sword, but unfortunately it seems unable to use the "Electromagnetic Poison Hand Blade."

texts.english: A powerful commander who once even took the No. 1 spot in the Gyandlar Commander ranking, in place of Devil Saturn 6. Ashura fires Nattoru bullets, which rob the target of bodily freedom, from the abdomen, and specializes in destroying the immobilized opponent in cruel ways. By nature Ashura is cruel and cunning, and once set a trap by turning Rom's party's surprise attack plan against them. Ashura drove Baikanfu into a corner, but was pierced through the chest by Thunder Cyclone and defeated.
lines: A powerful commander who once even took the No. 1 spot in the Gyandlar
Commander ranking, in place of Devil Saturn 6. Ashura fires Nattoru bullets,
which rob the target of bodily freedom, from the abdomen, and specializes in
destroying the immobilized opponent in cruel ways. By nature Ashura is cruel
and cunning, and once set a trap by turning Rom's party's surprise attack plan
against them. Ashura drove Baikanfu into a corner, but was pierced through
the chest by Thunder Cyclone and defeated.

texts.english: The boss of the space crime organization Gyandlar. Gyandlar's goal is to rule the entire universe and bring darkness and fear. It is also searching for Hyribead, an infinite energy said to grant eternal life. Gades is a villain who has wandered space for thousands of years piling up evil deeds, and trusts no one but himself. His sorcerous power is such that he can paralyze enemies in distant places. He attacked planet Cronos after Hyribead, but his ambition was thwarted by the Cronos tribe warriors, including Rom. He hates having rust form on his body to an extreme degree, and always kept with him a dedicated robot, Bibibi Mouse, to polish his body.

texts.english: A low-ranking Gyandlar Commander. When first introduced, Kyasumodon appeared as the main enemy and tried to set the Cronos tribe and the Battle tribe against each other, but after that appeared in large numbers as a grunt. Kyasumodon can transform into a flight form like a jet aircraft.
lines: A low-ranking Gyandlar Commander. When first introduced, Kyasumodon
appeared as the main enemy and tried to set the Cronos tribe and the Battle
tribe against each other, but after that appeared in large numbers as a grunt.
Kyasumodon can transform into a flight form like a jet aircraft.

texts.english: One of the Gyandlar executives. Fond of underhanded schemes and plots, Grujios serves as a kind of strategist for Gyandlar. With tremendous sorcerous power, Grujios can revive the ghosts of Gyandlar Commanders and use them as servants. In truth, the real body is only a caterpillar-like face floating in the tank of the head. Grujios was defeated by Rom in the Battle of the Heavenly Demon Castle, but, just as promised in the "I shall return" warning, came back in spirit form. After becoming a spirit, Grujios gained a new ability to take over other people's bodies, and tormented Rom's party by posing as an ally.

texts.english: A low-ranking Gyandlar Commander. Zarios is characterized by caterpillar-track legs, but had no especially notable role in the original story.
lines: A low-ranking Gyandlar Commander. Zarios is characterized by
caterpillar-track legs, but had no especially notable role in the original story.

texts.english: A female Gyandlar executive. In contrast to Grujios, so to speak, she often takes direct command at the front lines. Devil Saturn 6 are her direct subordinates. Wielding an electromagnetic whip, her speech and attitude fit being called "Big Sis," but she gets angry when called that. She is bold and cruel by nature, and tries to compete with Grujios at every turn. She also has a cute side in that she is actually afraid of earthquakes, and in the original story she almost got on good terms with Tough Trailer for a moment. After that, she set a trap for Tough Trailer by making that character hold the Medusa demon sword, a cursed blade that drives its holder mad, but after that scheme failed, she herself came to favor the Medusa demon sword. She can also breathe fire from her mouth and emit hypnotic light from her eyes.
lines: A female Gyandlar executive. In contrast to Grujios, so to speak, she often

sword, a cursed blade that drives its holder mad, but after that scheme failed,

texts.english: The combined form of Devil Saturn No. 1 through No. 6. Thanks to its viciousness and power it has held the No. 1 spot in the Gyandlar Commander ranking; it dropped in rank once, but soon came back. Its attacks are varied: not only fighting, but also flames from the mouth, claws launched on chains, beams from the eyes, and so on. It once even devised the Devil Foot Smash to counter God Hand Smash. It was often entrusted with Gyandlar's field operations, and was beaten up by Rom and the others time after time. It is a commander whose odd Kansai dialect makes it hard to hate, but in fact only Devil Saturn No. 1 actually uses the Kansai dialect, and the other five speak standard Japanese.

texts.english: A low-ranking Gyandlar Commander. Its agility is its trait, but it seems not to have been depicted much in the original story.
lines: A low-ranking Gyandlar Commander. Its agility is its trait, but it seems not to
have been depicted much in the original story.

texts.english: An artificial weather satellite developed by Diondra. Fenomena No. 1 can not only generate thunderclouds artificially, but also make lightning strike a targeted location by laser guidance. The lightning has a terrifying power: a voltage of 10,000 volts and a temperature of over 30,000 degrees. Fenomena No. 2, developed later, was planned to disturb the geomagnetism of planet Cronos, destroy the ozone layer overhead, and make electromagnetic waves that drive Machine Robo mad rain down onto the surface, but through an unexpected accident it caused a pole shift on planet Cronos.
lines: An artificial weather satellite developed by Diondra. Fenomena No. 1 can not

developed later, was planned to disturb the geomagnetism of planet Cronos,

texts.english: The fifth Angel confirmed. It has a regular octahedral exterior and attacks approaching enemies with a powerful charged particle cannon. To defeat this Angel, NERV used a hastily built modified positron cannon for EVAs (NERV spec) and carried out Operation Yashima, supplying it with electric power from all over Japan.
lines: The fifth Angel confirmed. It has a regular octahedral exterior and attacks
approaching enemies with a powerful charged particle cannon. To defeat this
Angel, NERV used a hastily built modified positron cannon for EVAs (NERV
spec) and carried out Operation Yashima, supplying it with electric power from
all over Japan.

texts.english: The thirteenth Angel confirmed. Hiding inside a cumulonimbus cloud, it came into contact with EVA-03, which was being transported to NERV's Second Experimental Site in Matsushiro, and completely took over Unit-03, which had just finished an activation test with Toji still aboard, and was designated an Angel. It went as far as defeating Unit-00 and Unit-02, but was destroyed by Unit-01, which had activated the Dummy System.
lines: The thirteenth Angel confirmed. Hiding inside a cumulonimbus cloud, it came into
contact with EVA-03, which was being transported to NERV's Second

texts.english: The fourteenth Angel confirmed. It invaded the Geofront from Tokyo-3 and, with overwhelming attack power beyond that of any previous Angel, defeated Unit-02 and Unit-00. In the end it fought the berserk Unit-01 and was devoured.
lines: The fourteenth Angel confirmed. It invaded the Geofront from Tokyo-3 and,
with overwhelming attack power beyond that of any previous Angel, defeated
Unit-02 and Unit-00. In the end it fought the berserk Unit-01 and was
devoured.

texts.english: The Fifth Child dispatched by SEELE. His background, like Rei Ayanami's, is completely unknown. He has the amazing ability to change his synchronization rate at will, which astonished the NERV staff. He approached Shinji, and Shinji, too, opened his heart to Kaworu's straightforwardness and kindness. However, Kaworu was the seventeenth Angel, Tabris, sent in by SEELE, and he entered Terminal Dogma with the unmanned Unit-02 under his control. Then, of his own wish, he was crushed by Unit-01, in which Shinji rode. It is a well-known story that in the Japanese title of original episode 24, in which he appears, "The Final Messenger," joining the character for "shi" and the character for "sha" in the word "messenger" makes the surname of Kaworu: "Nagisa." See the entry "Kaworu Nagisa" in the character encyclopedia.

texts.english: The EVA series that SEELE, the secret organization that manages the Human Instrumentality Project, sent into NERV Headquarters to stop Gendo, who was advancing the plan outside its schedule. There are nine in total. Unlike the earlier series, the units' specifications include flight capability and S2 Engines as standard equipment. Dummy Plugs are used for activation and operation, and it seems that Kaworu Nagisa's data is in them.
lines: The EVA series that SEELE, the secret organization that manages the Human

texts.english: The emperor of the Machine Empire Gulfer, which plots the extermination of humanity. Originally the ecosystem management computer of the planet Alktos, the Emperor suddenly ran out of control, and tried to eliminate humanity, which destroys ecosystems, and become the king who manages the universe itself. The main body consists of seven programs and has a form resembling a seven-headed dragon. The Gulfer Emperor and Zero function as mutual backup systems, and unless they are defeated at the same time they will revive. The Emperor is also protected by seven protections and can be defeated only by a simultaneous attack by seven Data Weapons.
lines: The emperor of the Machine Empire Gulfer, which plots the extermination of
humanity. Originally the ecosystem management computer of the planet
Alktos, the Emperor suddenly ran out of control, and tried to eliminate
humanity, which destroys ecosystems, and become the king who manages the
