revive. The Emperor is also protected by seven protections and can be defeated
only by a simultaneous attack by seven Data Weapons.

texts.english: A common soldier of the Machine Empire Gulfer. By taking in other machines it evolves into a Gulfer Machine Beast. A non-humanoid flying type (Type B) has also been confirmed.
lines: A common soldier of the Machine Empire Gulfer. By taking in other machines it
evolves into a Gulfer Machine Beast. A non-humanoid flying type (Type B) has
also been confirmed.

texts.english: One of the Machine Professionals that infiltrated Earth hidden in meteorites; this one emerged from a meteorite that fell near Mikazuki Island. Machine Professionals are higher beings than Machine Beasts and possess advanced intelligence. It is good at high-speed aerial combat and can also transform into a flight form. The Photon Rifle is a versatile weapon that can also transform into a Photon Scythe.
lines: One of the Machine Professionals that infiltrated Earth hidden in meteorites; this
one emerged from a meteorite that fell near Mikazuki Island. Machine
Professionals are higher beings than Machine Beasts and possess advanced
intelligence. It is good at high-speed aerial combat and can also transform into a
flight form. The Photon Rifle is a versatile weapon that can also transform into
a Photon Scythe.

texts.english: One of the Machine Professionals that infiltrated Earth hidden in meteorites; this one emerged from a meteorite that fell in a wasteland on the Oceania continent. Its weapons are a photon laser fired from its forehead and electric shocks released from the wings on its back. It was the Machine Professional that dodged the Final Attack and remained to the end.
lines: One of the Machine Professionals that infiltrated Earth hidden in meteorites; this
one emerged from a meteorite that fell in a wasteland on the Oceania
continent. Its weapons are a photon laser fired from its forehead and electric
shocks released from the wings on its back. It was the Machine Professional
that dodged the Final Attack and remained to the end.

texts.english: One of the Machine Professionals that infiltrated Earth hidden in meteorites; this one emerged from a meteorite that fell in the Amazon jungle on the South American continent. It is good at tricky attacks with its freely extendable arms.
lines: One of the Machine Professionals that infiltrated Earth hidden in meteorites; this
one emerged from a meteorite that fell in the Amazon jungle on the South
American continent. It is good at tricky attacks with its freely extendable arms.

texts.english: A Machine Beast born by taking in Earth's attack satellites. It was used in Gulfer's first descent operation, and eighteen in total have been confirmed. As they gathered to respond to Dendoh's activation, they were all wiped out together by the Flash Lightning Blade Strike.
lines: A Machine Beast born by taking in Earth's attack satellites. It was used in
Gulfer's first descent operation, and eighteen in total have been confirmed. As
they gathered to respond to Dendoh's activation, they were all wiped out
together by the Flash Lightning Blade Strike.

texts.english: A Machine Beast born by taking in a Defense Force fighter plane. Since it is based on a fighter plane, it has a variety of attacks such as missiles and machine guns.
lines: A Machine Beast born by taking in a Defense Force fighter plane. Since it is
based on a fighter plane, it has a variety of attacks such as missiles and
machine guns.

texts.english: One of the three officers of Spiral Castle. According to Ginga, "the third pompous guy." Its body is made of liquid metal, and it changes shape to dodge enemy attacks or entangle opponents. It also moves quickly and is good at surprise attacks, seeping into walls.
lines: One of the three officers of Spiral Castle. According to Ginga, "the third
pompous guy." Its body is made of liquid metal, and it changes shape to dodge
enemy attacks or entangle opponents. It also moves quickly and is good at
surprise attacks, seeping into walls.

texts.english: One of the three officers of Spiral Castle. According to Ginga, "a pompous kendama." It generates strong electromagnetic waves from its main body and has the ability to disable all electronic devices. Also, unless its head, the center, is destroyed, its body regenerates any number of times.
lines: One of the three officers of Spiral Castle. According to Ginga, "a pompous
kendama." It generates strong electromagnetic waves from its main body and
has the ability to disable all electronic devices. Also, unless its head, the center,
is destroyed, its body regenerates any number of times.

texts.english: One of the three officers of Spiral Castle. According to Ginga, "the pompous one, number two." It deploys an electromagnetic interference field around itself and has the ability to hinder the materialization of Data Weapons. It emits electric shocks from its arms and fires a beam from its mouth. It is also quite a power fighter.
lines: One of the three officers of Spiral Castle. According to Ginga, "the pompous
one, number two." It deploys an electromagnetic interference field around itself
and has the ability to hinder the materialization of Data Weapons. It emits
electric shocks from its arms and fires a beam from its mouth. It is also quite a
power fighter.

texts.english: A Machine Professional that Subaru rides. Originally, like other Machine Professionals and Machine Beasts, it had thinking ability, but it has been modified so that a human can pilot it.
lines: A Machine Professional that Subaru rides. Originally, like other Machine
Professionals and Machine Beasts, it had thinking ability, but it has been
modified so that a human can pilot it.

texts.english: One of the Machine Professionals that infiltrated Earth hidden in meteorites; this one emerged from a meteorite that fell in the Sahara Desert on the African continent. It has the ability to make its whole body white-hot and explode everything around it.
lines: One of the Machine Professionals that infiltrated Earth hidden in meteorites; this
one emerged from a meteorite that fell in the Sahara Desert on the African
continent. It has the ability to make its whole body white-hot and explode
everything around it.

texts.english: A top Gulfer executive and aide to Gulfer Emperor who commands at the front lines in place of the emperor. He excels at melee combat and is good at staff fighting with an extendable staff (a nyoibo). He also has the terrifying special ability to revive immediately even when destroyed. He often travels, or performs combined attacks, riding on the back of the heavy machine beast Vector, which is capable of interstellar travel.
lines: A top Gulfer executive and aide to Gulfer Emperor who commands at the front
lines in place of the emperor. He excels at melee combat and is good at staff
fighting with an extendable staff (a nyoibo). He also has the terrifying special
ability to revive immediately even when destroyed. He often travels, or
performs combined attacks, riding on the back of the heavy machine beast
Vector, which is capable of interstellar travel.

texts.english: Zero's strongest form, combined with the heavy machine beast Vector. Armed with a giant lancer and the Photon Blasters fired from both shoulders, its combat power and mobility are both greatly powered up. Heavy machine beasts is a general term for machine beasts that earned promotions through achievements when Gulfer invaded other planets before conquering Earth; having gained experience, they are stronger individuals than ordinary machine beasts.
lines: Zero's strongest form, combined with the heavy machine beast Vector. Armed
with a giant lancer and the Photon Blasters fired from both shoulders, its
combat power and mobility are both greatly powered up. Heavy machine
beasts is a general term for machine beasts that earned promotions through
achievements when Gulfer invaded other planets before conquering Earth;
having gained experience, they are stronger individuals than ordinary machine
beasts.

texts.english: A black Gear that forms a pair with Dendoh. It is also called Knight Ogre. Its basic abilities are the same as Dendoh's, but it has been modified to be single-seat. It is piloted by Altair, captain of the Gulfer Emperor's guard, and like Dendoh it has the ability to file-save Data Weapons.
lines: A black Gear that forms a pair with Dendoh. It is also called Knight Ogre. Its
basic abilities are the same as Dendoh's, but it has been modified to be
single-seat. It is piloted by Altair, captain of the Gulfer Emperor's guard, and like
Dendoh it has the ability to file-save Data Weapons.

texts.english: An Ogre fitted with Viper Whip. Viper Whip seeks "confidence," so Altair became its owner.
lines: An Ogre fitted with Viper Whip. Viper Whip seeks "confidence," so Altair
became its owner.

texts.english: An Ogre fitted with Bull Horn. The "wisdom" that Bull Horn seeks was also greater in Altair.
lines: An Ogre fitted with Bull Horn. The "wisdom" that Bull Horn seeks was also
greater in Altair.

texts.english: A Machine Beast adjusted for capturing Data Weapons. Because of that purpose its combat ability is low, and it carries out operations in combination with other Machine Beasts.
lines: A Machine Beast adjusted for capturing Data Weapons. Because of that
purpose its combat ability is low, and it carries out operations in combination
with other Machine Beasts.

texts.english: The Gulfer Emperor's pet. It is not a mechanical life form, but a space creature that eats machines. For that reason, it is sometimes used to punish subordinates who failed. The Lagowe virus, a computer virus that is a deadly poison to machines, is implanted in the fangs hidden in Lagowe's huge jaws.
lines: The Gulfer Emperor's pet. It is not a mechanical life form, but a space creature
that eats machines. For that reason, it is sometimes used to punish subordinates
who failed. The Lagowe virus, a computer virus that is a deadly poison to
machines, is implanted in the fangs hidden in Lagowe's huge jaws.

texts.english: The master of Spiral Castle, sent to conquer Earth, called "Oyakata-sama" (the Lord). Three Machine Generals serve under it, and it is the apex of the pyramid that includes the Machine Beasts below them. A Spiral Castle is a unit of the Gulfer army, and countless Spiral Castles exist throughout the universe.
lines: The master of Spiral Castle, sent to conquer Earth, called "Oyakata-sama" (the
Lord). Three Machine Generals serve under it, and it is the apex of the pyramid
that includes the Machine Beasts below them. A Spiral Castle is a unit of the
Gulfer army, and countless Spiral Castles exist throughout the universe.

texts.english: A super-large battleship of the Jovian Federation. Over ten times the size of the Nadesico, it is closer to a fortress than a battleship. In the Lizard War, Commander-in-Chief Haruki Kusakabe boarded it, and it was operated as the flagship of the Yujin Corps of the Jovian Federation Forces.
lines: A super-large battleship of the Jovian Federation. Over ten times the size of the
Nadesico, it is closer to a fortress than a battleship. In the Lizard War,
Commander-in-Chief Haruki Kusakabe boarded it, and it was operated as the
flagship of the Yujin Corps of the Jovian Federation Forces.

texts.english: An unmanned combat weapon of the Jovian Federation. It is classified as an insect-type fighter in the Jovian Federation, but on Earth it is mainly called by the name of the creature whose shape it resembles. These unmanned combat weapons are produced at the phase transition engine plants discovered in the Jupiter region, and since they are products of an ancient civilization, overtechnology such as small anti-gravity propulsion devices is used.
lines: An unmanned combat weapon of the Jovian Federation. It is classified as an
insect-type fighter in the Jovian Federation, but on Earth it is mainly called by
the name of the creature whose shape it resembles. These unmanned combat
weapons are produced at the phase transition engine plants discovered in the
Jupiter region, and since they are products of an ancient civilization,
overtechnology such as small anti-gravity propulsion devices is used.

texts.english: An unmanned combat weapon of the Jovian Federation. Joro is a spider-type robot named for its resemblance to the Joro spider. The abdominal unit can be swapped for self-destruct explosives and other loads depending on the mission.
lines: An unmanned combat weapon of the Jovian Federation. Joro is a spider-type
robot named for its resemblance to the Joro spider. The abdominal unit can be
swapped for self-destruct explosives and other loads depending on the mission.

texts.english: An unmanned combat weapon of the Jovian Federation. It is an upper-grade model of Batta, the most popular unmanned combat weapon. A field generator is attached, giving it excellent defense. Compared with Batta, machine guns have been removed in terms of armament, but it makes up for this with ramming attacks that take advantage of its high defense.
lines: An unmanned combat weapon of the Jovian Federation. It is an upper-grade
model of Batta, the most popular unmanned combat weapon. A field generator
is attached, giving it excellent defense. Compared with Batta, machine guns
have been removed in terms of armament, but it makes up for this with
ramming attacks that take advantage of its high defense.

texts.english: A manned humanoid combat weapon of the Jovian Federation. It is a weapon-reinforced version of Tetsujin, which was modeled on Gekiganger from Gekiganger 3, the sacred text of the Jovian Federation. The Jin series can make solo boson jumps without going through a Chulip, but the jump distance is limited to short range. Even so, that was sufficient for the purpose of breaking through the enemy front line and delivering a powerful blow to the core.
lines: A manned humanoid combat weapon of the Jovian Federation. It is a
weapon-reinforced version of Tetsujin, which was modeled on Gekiganger from
Gekiganger 3, the sacred text of the Jovian Federation. The Jin series can make
solo boson jumps without going through a Chulip, but the jump distance is
limited to short range. Even so, that was sufficient for the purpose of breaking
through the enemy front line and delivering a powerful blow to the core.

texts.english: A manned humanoid combat weapon of the Jovian Federation. It is a weapon-reinforced version of Majin, which was modeled on Umiganger from Gekiganger 3, the sacred text of the Jovian Federation. Because the Jin series carry phase transition reactors, they are large machines exceeding 30 m, and the Dai class, the weapon-reinforced version, is larger still.
lines: A manned humanoid combat weapon of the Jovian Federation. It is a
weapon-reinforced version of Majin, which was modeled on Umiganger from
Gekiganger 3, the sacred text of the Jovian Federation. Because the Jin series
carry phase transition reactors, they are large machines exceeding 30 m, and
the Dai class, the weapon-reinforced version, is larger still.

texts.english: A manned humanoid combat weapon of the Jovian Federation. It is a machine modeled on Rikuganger from Gekiganger 3, the sacred text of the Jovian Federation. A late-model Jin, it was shaped with anti-field combat in mind so that close-combat ability does not decline after the Gekigan Punch is fired. Naturally, a weapon-reinforced Daidenjin was also planned, but the war ended before roll-out.
lines: A manned humanoid combat weapon of the Jovian Federation. It is a machine
modeled on Rikuganger from Gekiganger 3, the sacred text of the Jovian
Federation. A late-model Jin, it was shaped with anti-field combat in mind so
that close-combat ability does not decline after the Gekigan Punch is fired.
Naturally, a weapon-reinforced Daidenjin was also planned, but the war ended
before roll-out.

texts.english: An unmanned destroyer of the Jovian Federation. Like other unmanned machines, it is also produced at the plants. Because it is mass-produced, it has the simplest block structure among the Jovian Federation's warships, and several variations can be made just by swapping the combat block and the power block.
lines: An unmanned destroyer of the Jovian Federation. Like other unmanned
machines, it is also produced at the plants. Because it is mass-produced, it has
the simplest block structure among the Jovian Federation's warships, and
several variations can be made just by swapping the combat block and the
power block.

texts.english: A mobile weapon of the Martian Successors. Pronounced "Shishiki." Miniaturization was achieved by making the boson jump system an external unit. The Martian Successors' machines are developed, based on Kusakabe's philosophy, on the premise of assault tactics using boson jumps. Shishiki's boson jump is limited to a single use, and it excels at surprise attack and charge tactics that take advantage of that ability.
lines: A mobile weapon of the Martian Successors. Pronounced "Shishiki."
Miniaturization was achieved by making the boson jump system an external
unit. The Martian Successors' machines are developed, based on Kusakabe's
philosophy, on the premise of assault tactics using boson jumps. Shishiki's
boson jump is limited to a single use, and it excels at surprise attack and charge
tactics that take advantage of that ability.

texts.english: A machine of Hokushin's Six. Pronounced "Muzura." An airframe that omits the legs and emphasizes mobility, and it is also capable of a single-use boson jump through an external unit. It excels at "Kugutsu-mai" (Puppet Dance), an irregular mobile attack that uses rotating turret nozzles. Like Yatenko, it also has a field generator around the cockpit.
lines: A machine of Hokushin's Six. Pronounced "Muzura." An airframe that omits the
legs and emphasizes mobility, and it is also capable of a single-use boson jump
through an external unit. It excels at "Kugutsu-mai" (Puppet Dance), an irregular

texts.english: A mobile weapon that Hokushin rides. Pronounced "Yatenko." It is a compact developed version of the Jin series that the Jovian Federation operated during the Lizard War, and although there is a limit on the number of times, it can make multiple mid-range boson jumps. Since it can move to the battlefield by boson jump, it uses fuel-type thrusters and excels at the irregular movement called "Kugutsu-mai" (Puppet Dance). It is also equipped with three small distortion field generators around the cockpit, making it a machine with high survivability.

texts.english: The prototype of a giant Metal Armor developed at the Giganos secret weapons factory. A walking ammunition depot with a 12-barrel chest machine cannon, a 100-tube missile pod, a quad Vulcan cannon, large cruise missiles and more built in. It carries a control system that allows operation by thought, enabling high mobility far beyond normal reaction speed. However, this system was unfinished and placed a heavy burden on the pilot, so it could not be used for long periods. In addition, the installed sensors had a serious flaw: they could not distinguish overlapping targets.

texts.english: Dorchenov's personal Gilgazamune. It is equipped with a long sword instead of an Azure Dragon sword. Unfortunately, the sensor flaw has not been fixed.
lines: Dorchenov's personal Gilgazamune. It is equipped with a long sword instead of
an Azure Dragon sword. Unfortunately, the sensor flaw has not been fixed.

texts.english: A mass-production Gilgazamune. The huge close-combat HB saber fitted at the request of Colonel Gon Jem seems to have been officially adopted.
lines: A mass-production Gilgazamune. The huge close-combat HB saber fitted at the
request of Colonel Gon Jem seems to have been officially adopted.

texts.english: A prototype Metal Armor of the Giganos forces. A high-performance machine that Gon Jem used as his personal unit, but it seems it never reached mass production. The grenades at the waist and the Azure Dragon sword on the back seem to reflect Gon Jem's tastes. Its attack power was nonetheless high, and the Azure Dragon sword, coated with a special alloy, combined with Gon Jem's skill, was sharp enough to cut through even the D-1's shield. The cobra painted on the shoulder is the emblem of the Gon Jem Squad.

texts.english: A machine made by fitting a MAFFU flight unit to the Gewai, the main mass-production Metal Armor of the Giganos forces. Its weapons are a 50 mm hand rail gun and a 30 mm machine cannon built into the camera-eye section. Because development of the MAFFU unit was rushed, its flight ability is somewhat inferior to the others.
lines: A machine made by fitting a MAFFU flight unit to the Gewai, the main

texts.english: A machine made by fitting a MAFFU flight unit to the Gelf, a high-performance Metal Armor deployed only in small numbers to the Practice Squad and the Imperial Guard Armored Division. The Gelfs that the Practice Squad ride are painted in special colors. It can be called a simplified Falguen, and has Simole Type-A passive armor and a radar more sensitive than a maiden's skin.

texts.english: A bike-type Metal Armor. It can split into upper and lower parts and recombine, with the upper turret part called Dolla and the lower bike part called Ganzer. Dolla can transform into a semi-humanoid form and fly, and by swapping the lower part for Gelfer, it becomes Geldolla, a marine Metal Armor. It is used for parachute drop operations and the like.

texts.english: A Gewai customized exclusively for Captain Gol. It has not only been reinforced with a 450 mm rail cannon and hand grenades, but its output has also been greatly increased, making it a machine worthy of the brawny Captain Gol. The cockpit modifications must have been a lot of work.
lines: A Gewai customized exclusively for Captain Gol. It has not only been reinforced

texts.english: A Dein customized exclusively for Captain Min. The ammunition capacity of its 50 mm hand rail gun has also been increased, but its distinctive feature is the chainsaws called Hybrid Surge mounted on both arms. Captain Min was good at a tactic of destroying the opponent's sensors with the high-heat rounds mounted on the waist and then cutting the enemy to pieces with these chainsaws.

texts.english: A Dauzehn customized exclusively for Lieutenant Zin. Its armament and output have also been strengthened, but it was mainly modified as an electronic warfare machine. Using the EDV antenna, it projected holograms, created decoys of itself, and deceived the enemy.
lines: A Dauzehn customized exclusively for Lieutenant Zin. Its armament and output

texts.english: A Dein, the close-combat metal armor of Giganos that is mainly used as a platoon leader's machine, fitted with a flight MAFFU unit. Normally it carries a multi-discharger on its back, but this was omitted in order to mount the MAFFU unit. The right eye, which retains a trace of the Gewai, is directly connected to the cockpit as a target scope. A variation, a yellow-colored Dein exclusively for Dorchenov, also appeared.

texts.english: A reconnaissance metal armor of Giganos. It is the earliest metal armor that was made, and is characterized by its huge camera eye. In the early part of the war it only had to deal with combat pods, so it could fight even with this level of equipment.
lines: A reconnaissance metal armor of Giganos. It is the earliest metal armor that

texts.english: A D-1 that underwent reinforcement modifications at the hands of Dr. Lang Plato. By incorporating know-how gained from developing the Dragoon and the Alliance's own technology, its mid-range combat and search-and-detection abilities have been improved, and its original close-combat ability has also been powered up. The two laser swords are mounted on the left hip, and a throw-in bomb is equipped on the right hip. Also, because a gravity field detection system was installed on the left shoulder, the shoulder bombs have been reduced to a single one on the right shoulder.

texts.english: Falguen, the dedicated metal armor of Captain Meio Plato, fitted with a MAFFU flight unit. Falguen can be called a prototype of the Dragonar, and is Giganos's newest machine, designed and developed by Dr. Lang Plato, Meio's father. However, because it has a high generator output, it is a touchy machine that requires considerable skill to pilot. It can be said that only Meio, known as the Blue Hawk of Giganos, could handle it. Also worth noting is that it uses Shimour Type-A passive armor, a reversible elastic metal close to hard rubber, as its armor, which allows flexible movement.

texts.english: Jagd Gelf, a long-range support metal armor, fitted with a MAFFU unit. To counter the Dragonars, which excel at three-unit formation attacks, Giganos refitted the Gelf and developed the heavy-artillery Jagd Gelf and the electronic-warfare Reb Gelf. Besides Welner's machine of the Practice Squad, the Jagd Gelf was also used by Chender of Gelbock's unit.

texts.english: Reb Gelf, the electronic-warfare type, fitted with a MAFFU unit. It is less specialized than the D-3, and can also perform direct support combat. It was used for platoon combat, and besides the Practice Squad, Gelbock's unit also used it. Of course, this color scheme is exclusive to the Practice Squad.

texts.english: A metal armor for localized combat. By swapping the lower part for either the bike-type Gunzar or the boat-type Gelfar, it can be used for both land and naval combat, an innovative machine. The state combined with Gunzar is called Gandora, and the state combined with Gelfar is called Geldora. In both forms it was often used for parachute drop operations.

texts.english: An aerial-combat machine developed to save the trouble of attaching a flight unit to a metal armor, and called a Volg Armor. For high-speed flight, it can fold its legs into a flight form to reduce air resistance. Compared with its sibling machine Schwarg, Dauzehn emphasizes attack power and has the role of an attack aircraft.

texts.english: One of the Devil Gundam's Four Heavenly Kings, the form Nobel Gundam took after being changed by DG Cells. It is also known as "Shouhou Kouko." It is suited to underwater combat, and has a spherical Attack Mode and a humanoid Standing Mode, and can also close its shutters completely to take a defensive form. After Allenby was rescued, Wong rode in it. It is also equipped with the Berserker System, further strengthened by the influence of the DG Cells.

texts.english: One of the Devil Gundam's Four Heavenly Kings, the form Neros Gundam took after being changed by DG Cells. It is also known as "Tenken Zettou." It is suited to aerial combat and can transform between Attack Mode, a bird-shaped flight form, and humanoid Standing Mode. Because of the DG Cells it has an abnormal regeneration ability. It favors hit-and-run tactics that take advantage of its high speed, and its finishing move has also been upgraded from the "Silver Foot" to the "Rainbow Foot."

texts.english: One of the Devil Gundam's Four Heavenly Kings, the form John Bull Gundam took after being changed by DG Cells. It is also known as "Shiou Souha." A machine suited to land combat, it can transform between a four-legged beast Attack Mode and a humanoid Standing Mode. In addition to mid-range combat such as all-range attacks with the extendable Grand Bomber, its super-heavyweight charge attack at point-blank range is immensely powerful.

texts.english: The strongest machine, rebuilt by the Devil Gundam inside its own body from the data of the Devil Gundam's Four Heavenly Kings: Master Gundam, Gundam Heaven's Sword, Grand Gundam and Walter Gundam. It is based on the main power furnace of the Neo Japan colony and combines the abilities of all four Heavenly Kings. It is a monster that regenerated even after being defeated by the Shuffle Alliance Fist. Major Urube, infected with DG Cells, boarded it and challenged Domon and the others to a final battle.

texts.english: A machine born as part of the Devil Gundam's self-replication ability. There is nothing remarkable in its performance, but it always acts in large units and attacks all at once. It is the base machine of the Death series that the Devil Gundam produces, and there are many variations, such as flying and underwater types. Its weapon is a club-shaped beam rifle that can be used for both melee and shooting.

texts.english: A variation of the Death Army. It is joined to a flight unit and takes a bird-like form. It is armed with a large beam cannon, but as with the other series, acting in groups is its greatest weapon. Even if it loses its flight unit, it can continue operating as an ordinary Death Army.

texts.english: The Devil Gundam, born when the Ultimate Gundam that fell to the ground went out of control, in its final evolved form. It has a peculiar shape: an upper body of the same lineage as Shining Gundam and a lower body formed by a giant transformed head. The DG Cells that make up its body inherit the three great theories of the Ultimate Cell, and through terrifying self-replication it absorbs all living things and machines and turns them into DG. Its weapons are enormous extendable claws deployed from both shoulders and beams fired from various parts of its body, and it has overwhelming power. Human spirit is essential for the Devil Gundam to display its true power, and Rain was incorporated as the human best suited to be the living unit.

texts.english: A mass-produced version of the Great Mazinger that appears in Gosaku Ota's manga version of "Great Mazinger." Shinsuminichi Heavy Industries, which had developed the humanoid weapon GMFA-1, obtained the blueprints of the Great Mazinger by illegal means and built it. Its appearance and performance are basically the same as the original, but the mass-produced type has a number marked on its chest. Also, in the work, in order to distinguish the original from the mass-produced type, Boss painted "Ganso" (Original) on the waist of Tetsuya's Great Mazinger. Besides these, there is one mass-produced Great Mazinger with an all-black body.

texts.english: The strongest robot of the Hyakki Empire, manufactured at a secret underground base on Izu Oshima. It was planned to be a combination of six units: Mecha Raidenki, Mecha Renmaki, Mecha Ankyuki, Mecha Kokoki, Mecha Raijuki and Mecha Tenppoki, but because Mecha Raidenki, which sortied to intercept Getter Robo that had flown to Oshima, was destroyed, it became a five-unit combination. General Hidler and Dr. Gura personally boarded it. It has overwhelming firepower and power, including beams from the eyes and drill, flame from the mouth, and missiles on the chest. It can also separate into the individual Hyakki robots. After the separated Hyakki robots were destroyed and its power dropped, it was defeated by Shine Spark.

texts.english: The first Hyakki robot, which the Hyakki Empire sent out to seize the Getter ray amplifier. Hyakki robots are named by adding "Mecha" to the front of the pilot's name. It has a variety of weapons, such as a strange ray from its eyes and beams from its horn. It took Genki, Michiru's younger brother, hostage, but he was rescued thanks to Hayato's quick wits, and it was defeated by the tremendous power of Getter Dragon.

texts.english: A Hyakki robot piloted by Dairinki, the Hyakki Empire's strongest man in raw strength. It was scheduled to be mounted on Mecha Yousaiki, but Dairinki, burning to avenge the Hundred Demons who had been defeated up to then, ran ahead and challenged Getter Robo alone. Its weapons are the missiles on both shoulders and the spiked large wheels fitted to both hands. The large wheels can also be used as strong shields. It gave Getter Dragon and Liger a hard time, but Getter Poseidon caught the large wheel, and it was destroyed by Getter Cyclone and Strong Missile.

texts.english: A Hyakki robot piloted by Isamu, Hayato's childhood friend, who was blinded by money and power and converted by the Hyakki Empire into Boryuki. Its weapons are beams from the horn on its head, a drill at the waist, and convergent beams fired from the horns all over its body. It had all its horns destroyed by Getter Liger, then crashed and exploded.

texts.english: A carrier-type Hyakki robot manufactured for the all-out attack on Japan. It is 120 m long, with a volume 8 times that of Getter Robo. Mecha Tairinki and Mecha Hangetsuki are built into the left and right wings, and it was designed to carry 200 fighters and 100 bombers. It launched from Battleship Island while Getter Robo was fighting Mecha Tairinki, and left the Saotome Institute half destroyed. It attacks with missiles fired from its shoulders and by ramming with the auxiliary wings it extends after its wings are destroyed. It was defeated by Getter Dragon's new finishing move, Shine Spark.

texts.english: The first saucer beast sent by the Vegan Empire. A saucer beast is a robot whose saucer opens and transforms into various forms, and many types exist. It attacks with strange rays from its eyes, high-temperature flame breathed from its mouth, and ramming in its saucer form with extended blades. It took TFO hostage but was easily rescued, and was defeated by the overwhelming power of Grendizer. Also, according to what was told later, the brain of the younger brother of Duke Fleed's lover Naida was apparently used as a living part in Girugiru.

texts.english: A saucer beast piloted by Guard member Jigra. As a guard unit it has higher capabilities than other saucer beasts. Its body in saucer form is covered with Veganium super alloy, which bounced off all of Grendizer's weapons, and it attacks with the rotating cutters on the sides of the machine. After transforming into humanoid form, it uses the saucer as a shield, fires a powerful destruction beam, and extends the whip-like fingers on its right hand to entangle Grendizer.

texts.english: The giant battleship that King Vega boards. It was used when escaping the explosion of planet Vega, and flew to the Skull Moon base using the space transposition device Transportion. It fires powerful beams from the protrusions at the front of the hull, and can produce smoke to hide itself and a powerful barrier from the many holes on the side of the hull. In the end it is destroyed by the concentrated attack of the Grendizer team.

texts.english: The first Vega Beast, stronger than the Saucer Beasts. Vega Beasts are wild animals turned into cyborgs, and have greater combat power than Saucer Beasts. In addition to power strong enough to tear off Grendizer's left arm, it has an excellent sense of smell, and can remember the scent of an opponent it has fought once and hunt that opponent down no matter where. Because its origin is a gorilla, it has a tendency to be afraid of fire. Also, as is the convention for an enlarged gorilla, it took Hikaru hostage and climbed to the top of a skyscraper and roared. It is the Vega Beast with the most memorable name.

texts.english: The strongest and last Vega Beast, which Lady Gandal boarded. A large amount of Vegatron energy was injected into it, and it has tremendous power and a sturdy body. It breathes high-temperature flames from its mouth, and the beams fired from the two protrusions on its chest not only damage the machine but also temporarily take away the opponent's sight.

and a sturdy body. It breathes high-temperature flames from its mouth, and the
beams fired from the two protrusions on its chest not only damage the machine
but also temporarily take away the opponent's sight.

texts.english: A Vega Beast piloted by Imperial Guard captain Morus. It originally had flesh, but on the last day of planet Vega, because Vega exploded when the transfer machine was activated, it was transferred by mistake to the very edge of the solar system, and on its way to Skull Moon it was reduced to bones by meteorites and cosmic rays. It fires powerful beams from its eyes and pierces enemies with the drill in its chest.

machine was activated, it was transferred by mistake to the very edge of the
solar system, and on its way to Skull Moon it was reduced to bones by
meteorites and cosmic rays. It fires powerful beams from its eyes and pierces
enemies with the drill in its chest.

texts.english: A Vega Beast equipped with a freezing ray, developed by the genius girl Kirika. It fires the freezing ray from its pupils and from the gem on its chest, and together with the blade on its right hand it gave Grendizer a hard time. The freezing ray was originally meant to cool the temperature of young planets, but was converted into a weapon by King Vega's order.

texts.english: A giant saucer battleship that launches from the Skull Moon base on the Moon. Normally it is hung from the symbol tower of Skull Moon. Under the command of Captain Blacky, it served as a combat mothership carrying Saucer Beasts and Mini Fours. It has powerful beam cannons and sturdy armor.
lines: A giant saucer battleship that launches from the Skull Moon base on the Moon.

of Captain Blacky, it served as a combat mothership carrying Saucer Beasts
and Mini Fours. It has powerful beam cannons and sturdy armor.

texts.english: A medium-sized space saucer of the Vegan Empire forces. It is about twice the size of the Minifo, and its weapons are a Vegatron beam cannon and two missiles. Like the Minifo, it excels at group combat, but it was not much of a threat to Grendizer.

missiles. Like the Minifo, it excels at group combat, but it was not much of a
threat to Grendizer.

texts.english: A small space saucer of the Vegan Empire forces. They appear in groups and attack in formation. Their weapons are Vegatron beam cannons and missiles. Besides combat, they are also used for reconnaissance and transport. They were a sufficient threat to the TFO, but because they were weak against Grendizer, most were destroyed in one hit. There are two kinds, for attack and for work, which differ in color.

texts.english: A Saucer Beast that sortied to support the Great Mazinger operated by Barendos. It attacks with disc-shaped arms with protrusions on the outside and three sharp legs. It is destroyed by the Atomic Punch of the Great Mazinger that Koji boarded.
lines: A Saucer Beast that sortied to support the Great Mazinger operated by

that Koji boarded.

texts.english: A Saucer Beast that was inside the spherical giant beam cannon of the Barendos battleship. It is made of charged energy in the air, so no solid-projectile weapons work on it at all. It is broken apart by the Anti-Gravity Storm and Breast Burn, but it rammed Grendizer with the three spheres inside its body. Although it calls itself a Saucer Beast, it cannot transform into a saucer.

texts.english: A Saucer Beast that Barendos deployed to capture the TFO. It extends its hook-claw-shaped hands to catch its opponent. It strangles Grendizer, which is fighting the Great Mazinger, from behind, but is destroyed by the Anti-Gravity Storm.

texts.english: A space monster that can be called both mechanical and biological, released into Japan by aliens plotting to conquer the Earth. It has a hard outer shell, a lizard-like face and an insect-type body, and spits out a dissolving liquid from its mouth. It grows by eating iron, and it ate the arm of the Great Mazinger.

texts.english: Gilgilgan's second form. It has the appearance of a humanoid upper body growing out of the back of the first form. It has become able to shoot rays from the lizard eyes of the lower body.
lines: Gilgilgan's second form. It has the appearance of a humanoid upper body
growing out of the back of the first form. It has become able to shoot rays
from the lizard eyes of the lower body.

texts.english: Gilgilgan's final form. It ate the aliens' saucer filled with cosmic energy, grew huge and became humanoid. It has wings and can fly. Its weapons are a sickle-like weapon on its waist and rays from its fingertips. It shows overwhelming strength, but its weak point is figured out to be the base of the sickle, and it is destroyed by a joint operation of the Great Mazinger and Getter Robo.

texts.english: A weapon that looks like a space creature, released by mysterious aliens plotting to invade the Earth. It entangled Getter Robo with the tentacles growing all over its body and tried to slam it into the ground. It also fires strange rays from its eyes. It exploded from the suicide charge of Bear Go. It drove Musashi to his death.

growing all over its body and tried to slam it into the ground. It also fires strange
rays from its eyes. It exploded from the suicide charge of Bear Go. It drove
Musashi to his death.

texts.english: A combat weapon of mysterious aliens. It is an assembly of fighter planes, tanks, the main guns of battleships and the like, and can fire from all over its body. It has the special ability to return to its original form again, if the individual parts are undamaged, even after being broken into pieces.
lines: A combat weapon of mysterious aliens. It is an assembly of fighter planes,

body. It has the special ability to return to its original form again, if the
individual parts are undamaged, even after being broken into pieces.

texts.english: The final combat weapon of mysterious aliens. Light wraps its whole body, and it absorbs beam and other light-ray energy and grows huge. Solid-projectile weapons, too, are deflected by the light. In addition to firing arrows of light that destroy the opponent from the inside, it has sharp claws and missiles from its chest. After the light was stripped away by the Great Typhoon and its mechanical body was exposed, it was destroyed by the Great Booster.

texts.english: A creature that had been lurking in the sea in ancient times, which revived and grew huge because humans spilled oil into the sea. For that reason it loves oil and attacks tankers. It can fly, and the dragon's-neck-shaped tentacles regenerate instantly even if cut, and can also be rotated to create strong winds. Also, its flexible body is immune to missile attacks.

texts.english: A Hakke Robo bearing the title "Thunder," piloted by Saiga. It is the last Hakke Robo to be completed, and it is not humanoid. It is equipped with the atomic-nucleus fragmentation cannon Proton Thunder, the one weapon said to be able to counter Zeorymer, which Masaki developed. This weapon is located on both sides of the machine's central sphere and turns matter within a radius of several kilometers into fine particles. It vanishes enveloped in the light of the Hades Attack together with Burrstone.

texts.english: A Hakke Robo bearing the title "Wind," piloted by Taiha. As its title says, it makes varied attacks using wind: "Bone Hoon," which slams down a powerful wind; "Blay Wain," which cuts with a kamaitachi (a slashing whirlwind); and "Dead Ron Hoon," which raises a giant tornado and takes away the target's freedom. It excels at aerial combat and can fly at high speed with the wings extending from over its shoulders. It pressed Zeorymer, which it was fighting for the first time, but was defeated by the Hades Attack.

texts.english: A Hakke Robo bearing the title "Earth," piloted by Rockfell. It was designed with the aim of destroying large cities and is not suited to close combat. It is equipped with a weapon that plants both arms on the ground and sends vibration waves to activate the magma layer and cause a great earthquake. In addition, it is equipped with anti-personnel and anti-materiel beams and missiles. It charged at Zeorymer with both arms blown off and was destroyed by a shock wave.

It charged at Zeorymer with both arms blown off and was destroyed by a

texts.english: A Hakke Robo bearing the title "Moon," piloted by Ritsu. It carries many beam weapons on its chest, legs, fingers and so on. It also used "Luna Flash," a sword made by converging the beams at its fingertips, and gave Zeorymer a hard time even in close combat. It is equipped with the special weapon "J-Kaiser," which releases all the energy the machine has, but it cannot be used continuously. For that reason it launches three satellites called the "Children of the Moon" and sends lightning energy to its own machine to recharge. It is destroyed by the Hades Attack of Zeorymer, which regained the Dimensional Coupler System and unleashed its true power.

texts.english: A Hakke Robo bearing the title "Fire," piloted by Shi-Aen. In the combination attack "Twin Lords" with Gallowin of water, piloted by his younger sister Shi-Tau, Gallowin's "Beam Searcher" and Bryst's "Plasma Light Bullet Magrash" collide in midair and destroy the target along with the space around it. There is also a technique called "Twin Flare," in which the two machines are linked and fire. As a single-machine attack it is equipped with the napalm "Flare Launcher," which gives off high heat. It cannot fly, but it can glide by hovering. It was heavily damaged shielding Gallowin from Zeorymer's beam, and was destroyed by the Hades Attack together with Gallowin.

texts.english: A Hakke Robo bearing the title "Water," piloted by Shi-Tau. Because it was developed as a support machine for Bryst, its weapons are mainly auxiliary: "Gallowin Blizzard," which seals the opponent's movement, and the "Mega Searcher," which emits laser beams. In the combination technique with Bryst, "Twin Flare," it plays the roles of energy supply, laser search and cooling. In order to secure its position when performing the combination technique, its mobility is higher than Bryst's. In the end it was destroyed together with Bryst by the Hades Attack.

texts.english: A Hakke Robo bearing the title "Mountain," piloted by Giso. Like Dinodilos, it was designed with the aim of attacking cities. It is equipped with 500 missiles over its whole body and hides a total of 18 nuclear missiles, nine under the armor of each leg. It can glide with the boosters on its shoulders and the hover on its legs. It vanishes enveloped in the light of the Hades Attack together with Omzack.

texts.english: The mass-produced version of Vermillion. A total of three units were assigned to TERRA, and they become the machines of Alpha Squadron members. Its performance and armament are no different from the Vermillion piloted by Elvy, and it fought mass-produced Dolems on equal or better terms.
lines: The mass-produced version of Vermillion. A total of three units were assigned
to TERRA, and they become the machines of Alpha Squadron members. Its
performance and armament are no different from the Vermillion piloted by
Elvy, and it fought mass-produced Dolems on equal or better terms.

texts.english: A Dolem that takes on the duty of defending the capital, with huge wings. It fires plasma burst light from the top of its head and shot down fighter planes in Operation Overlord. It can also put up a sound barrier to defend against attacks. It seems to be under the direct command of Maya Kamina and shows up on many battlefields.

Operation Overlord. It can also put up a sound barrier to defend against attacks.
It seems to be under the direct command of Maya Kamina and shows up on
many battlefields.

texts.english: A Dolem that is something like a combat commander among the Mu. Its combat strength is among the strongest even among Dolems, and its attack power is enough to defeat several of the Federation's warships in one blow. It extends its sharp claws long to pierce and slash enemies. It also hides a third arm on its right chest. It appeared before RahXephon riding on a pedestal called Brillante.

texts.english: The form of Quon, who attained Yolteotl, becoming one with the Xephon born from the black egg. It is the counterpart of Ayato's Xephon and has black wings. Like Ayato's Xephon, it has the ability to tune the world, and its physical abilities are the same. Incidentally, Quon's Ixtli was Ayato dressed in black. This is because Ayato inherited Quon's genes.

texts.english: A Dolem with a body like a stringed instrument. It attacked the fleet that was transporting RahXephon. It extends tentacles to entangle its target and corrode metal. It was defeated by RahXephon, and the Earth Federation took the wreckage back.
lines: A Dolem with a body like a stringed instrument. It attacked the fleet that was

metal. It was defeated by RahXephon, and the Earth Federation took the
wreckage back.

texts.english: A mobile weapon of the Mu, smaller than a Dolem. They appear in countless numbers and attack with beams from slits in their upper part. TERRA called them "D2."
lines: A mobile weapon of the Mu, smaller than a Dolem. They appear in countless

them "D2."

texts.english: A Dolem that tried to manipulate Ayato's mind. With the ring above its head it swallowed RahXephon into a phase space, and by sending Dolem stones into RahXephon's mouth it made Ayato believe he was in TOKYO JUPITER. However, it was cut in two by the awakened RahXephon.

RahXephon's mouth it made Ayato believe he was in TOKYO JUPITER.
However, it was cut in two by the awakened RahXephon.

texts.english: A Dolem floating in the air of TOKYO JUPITER, from which Ayato Kamina is absent. They exist in countless numbers in a stationary state and have a function that, upon sensing an intruder, takes action in defense. They attack enemies by firing beams from their heads.
lines: A Dolem floating in the air of TOKYO JUPITER, from which Ayato Kamina is
absent. They exist in countless numbers in a stationary state and have a
function that, upon sensing an intruder, takes action in defense. They attack
enemies by firing beams from their heads.

texts.english: The strongest, largest-class Dolem, given to Kuki. Itsuki said in the strategy meeting that its total length is about 2,600 m, its mass is 10^9 t, and its destructive power is 10^27 L. The plasma beam fired from its entire underside has enough power to instantly destroy a whole city. Also, its head floats in the air.
lines: The strongest, largest-class Dolem, given to Kuki. Itsuki said in the strategy
meeting that its total length is about 2,600 m, its mass is 109 t, and its
destructive power is 1027 L. The plasma beam fired from its entire underside
has enough power to instantly destroy a whole city. Also, its head floats in the
air.

texts.english: The form Medius Locus took after absorbing a massive energy convergence body and undergoing further transformation. The core section housing AI1 has itself changed form greatly, and what has become of the pilot inside is unknown.
lines: The form Medius Locus took after absorbing a massive energy convergence
body and undergoing further transformation. The core section housing AI1 has
itself changed form greatly, and what has become of the pilot inside is
unknown.

texts.english: The form in which the core housing AI1 grew huge through the self-repair and self-evolution abilities of the runaway Lasmunanium and fused with the TE Engine. As its name "ALL In 1" suggests, it tries to take everything into its body.
lines: The form in which the core housing AI1 grew huge through the self-repair and

Engine. As its name "ALL In 1" suggests, it tries to take everything into its body.

texts.english: A mobile weapon created by Medius Locus. It is thought to be based on the Tergum, but details are unknown.
lines: A mobile weapon created by Medius Locus. It is thought to be based on the
Tergum, but details are unknown.

texts.english: A mobile weapon created by Medius Locus. It is thought to be based on the Frons, but details are unknown.
lines: A mobile weapon created by Medius Locus. It is thought to be based on the
Frons, but details are unknown.

texts.english: A mysterious unmanned mobile weapon. It is said to resemble Tsentr Project prototype unit No. 1, but details are unknown.
lines: A mysterious unmanned mobile weapon. It is said to resemble Tsentr Project
prototype unit No. 1, but details are unknown.

texts.english: A mysterious unmanned mobile weapon. It is said to resemble Tsentr Project prototype unit No. 2, but details are unknown.
lines: A mysterious unmanned mobile weapon. It is said to resemble Tsentr Project
prototype unit No. 2, but details are unknown.

texts.english: The Earth Federation Forces, concerned about the high attrition rate of mass-produced humanoid mobile weapons due to repeated wars, drew up a development plan for a new-concept machine looking ten years ahead, the "Tsentr Project." Dr. Mitar Zapat, the central figure of the project, built a prototype of the "TE Engine," which applied "Terminus Energy," as the power source of the prototype machines. However, although Terminus Energy has high output, collecting it and converting it to power was extremely difficult, and it was predicted that it would take several years to complete the TE Engine. In addition, Dr. Zapat had also succeeded in developing "Lasmunanium," an armor material capable of self-repair, but this too ran into the problem that its function was difficult to control, just like the TE Engine. After trial and error with prototype units No. 1 through No. 4, Dr. Zapat gave up on developing a machine equipped with both Lasmunanium and the TE Engine. He assigned Lasmunanium to prototype unit No. 5, "Medius Locus," and the TE Engine to prototype units No. 6 and No. 7, and decided to pursue and improve each function. Furthermore, these three machines were given concepts and armament assuming actual combat: prototype No. 6 was developed for high-mobility combat and artillery combat, prototype No. 7 for close combat and melee combat, and Medius Locus as a machine with performance intermediate between the two machines described above. This machine was the first of the three above to roll out, but no test pilot was decided, and unlike prototypes No. 6 and No. 7, almost no tests of various kinds were carried out (one theory holds that it secretly underwent some kind of modification). Afterwards it was seized by someone and went missing. Its model number is YTsP-05.

texts.english: The form Medius Locus transformed into. Based on the various machine data and combat data AI1 obtained, it changed form through the self-evolution ability of Lasmunanium and powered up. Later it took in the TE Engine and became able to collect and use Terminus Energy. Compared with before the transformation, the machine's size itself changed, and its appearance and weapons lean toward those of a special machine (super robot). This is thought to be because Eldy had entered the data of Tsentr Project prototype unit No. 7 (special machine type) into AI1 in advance.

transformation, the machine's size itself changed, and its appearance and
weapons lean toward those of a special machine (super robot). This is thought
to be because Eldy had entered the data of Tsentr Project prototype unit No. 7
(special machine type) into AI1 in advance.

texts.english: A Dolem with a form that closely resembles a parka. Its face floats inside the parka, and it strikes opponents with the sharp protrusions where its feet would be. Because the Vibrato is in sync with Hiroko Asahina, when Vibrato is hurt, Hiroko is hurt too. It also displayed messages Hiroko wrote in her notebook on electronic signboards and the like around the city. It was defeated by Ayato, who struggled to protect Hiroko, but that simultaneously meant Hiroko's death.

texts.english: A powerful commander who once even took the No. 1 spot in the Gyandlar Commander ranking, in place of Devil Saturn 6. Ashura fires Nattoru bullets, which rob the target of bodily freedom, from the abdomen, and specializes in destroying the immobilized opponent in cruel ways. By nature Ashura is cruel and cunning, and once set a trap by turning Rom's party's surprise attack plan against them. Ashura drove Baikanfu into a corner, but was pierced through the chest by Thunder Cyclone and defeated.

texts.english: The boss of the space crime organization Gyandlar. Gyandlar's goal is to rule the entire universe and bring darkness and fear. It is also searching for Hyribead, an infinite energy said to grant eternal life. Gades is a villain who has wandered space for thousands of years piling up evil deeds, and trusts no one but himself. His sorcerous power is such that he can paralyze enemies in distant places. He attacked planet Cronos after Hyribead, but his ambition was thwarted by the Cronos tribe warriors, including Rom. He hates having rust form on his body to an extreme degree, and always kept with him a dedicated robot, Bibibi Mouse, to polish his body.

texts.english: The true form of Gyandlar executive Garudi. In truth, he is Rom and Leina's real older brother, whom they had thought dead since early childhood. He was picked up by Gades, who valued his talent for Tenku Shin Ken, and for a long time he underwent mind control as a Gyandlar executive. (The fearsome appearance of Garudi is also thought to be part of that control.) In the final episode of the original story, he gives his own sword to his beloved younger brother Rom and orders him to cut down Gades.

texts.english: A low-ranking Gyandlar Commander. When first introduced, Kyasumodon appeared as the main enemy and tried to set the Cronos tribe and the Battle tribe against each other, but after that appeared in large numbers as a grunt. Kyasumodon can transform into a flight form like a jet aircraft.

texts.english: One of the Gyandlar executives. Fond of underhanded schemes and plots, Grujios serves as a kind of strategist for Gyandlar. With tremendous sorcerous power, Grujios can revive the ghosts of Gyandlar Commanders and use them as servants. In truth, the real body is only a caterpillar-like face floating in the tank of the head. Grujios was defeated by Rom in the Battle of the Heavenly Demon Castle, but, just as promised in the "I shall return" warning, came back in spirit form. After becoming a spirit, Grujios gained a new ability to take over other people's bodies, and tormented Rom's party by posing as an ally.

texts.english: A low-ranking Gyandlar Commander. Zarios is characterized by caterpillar-track legs, but had no especially notable role in the original story.
lines: A low-ranking Gyandlar Commander. Zarios is characterized by

texts.english: A female Gyandlar executive. In contrast to Grujios, so to speak, she often takes direct command at the front lines. Devil Saturn 6 are her direct subordinates. Wielding an electromagnetic whip, her speech and attitude fit being called "Big Sis," but she gets angry when called that. She is bold and cruel by nature, and tries to compete with Grujios at every turn. She also has a cute side in that she is actually afraid of earthquakes, and in the original story she almost got on good terms with Tough Trailer for a moment. After that, she set a trap for Tough Trailer by making that character hold the Medusa demon sword, a cursed blade that drives its holder mad, but after that scheme failed, she herself came to favor the Medusa demon sword. She can also breathe fire from her mouth and emit hypnotic light from her eyes.

texts.english: The combined form of Devil Saturn No. 1 through No. 6. Thanks to its viciousness and power it has held the No. 1 spot in the Gyandlar Commander ranking; it dropped in rank once, but soon came back. Its attacks are varied: not only fighting, but also flames from the mouth, claws launched on chains, beams from the eyes, and so on. It once even devised the Devil Foot Smash to counter God Hand Smash. It was often entrusted with Gyandlar's field operations, and was beaten up by Rom and the others time after time. It is a commander whose odd Kansai dialect makes it hard to hate, but in fact only Devil Saturn No. 1 actually uses the Kansai dialect, and the other five speak standard Japanese.

texts.english: Leina's servant, who can transform into three forms: robot, jet helicopter and supercar. Technically a member of the Jet tribe. Because Triple Jim can carry members of the Cronos tribe, Jim is a great help when traveling, but is poor at fighting because of a gentle nature. That said, Jim understands how martial artists feel, and often put Jim's own body on the line for Leina's sake. Always humble and polite in speech, Jim shouts "It is above you, if you please!" even when warning someone that something is falling from above. In episode 24, Jim performed a catchphrase imitating Rom's. Jim also seems to be able to use Tenku Chushin Ken, though only a little.

texts.english: The former top disciple of Rom's father, Kirai Stol. A member of the Cronos tribe who is an elder disciple to Rom and the others. He learned Tenku Chushin Ken and surpassed his master in offensive techniques, but Kirai saw through his character, which sought only power, and did not permit him full mastery. Resenting this, he ran away from Kirai, and was living as a bandit when Gyandlar invited him, though Diondra seems to have thought he would be thrown away once he had served his purpose. He wields the forbidden technique "Tenku Chushin Ken: Electromagnetic Poison Hand-Blade." The poison hand-blade is a hand-blade into which poison has been soaked by dipping the hand in all kinds of deadly poisons; even a graze lets poison into the body through the wound and kills the opponent. He is also good at finger bullets, and has a technique called "Tenku Chushin Ken: Dark Finger Bullet."

texts.english: A low-ranking Gyandlar Commander. Its agility is its trait, but it seems not to have been depicted much in the original story.
lines: A low-ranking Gyandlar Commander. Its agility is its trait, but it seems not to

texts.english: A warrior of the Jet tribe who, like Rom and Drill, trained under Kirai. He was taught Tenku Shin Ken by Kirai. As his name suggests, he can transform into a jet aircraft. Within Rom's party he is the cool, handsome type, who dashes in to rescue friends and beautiful women in their moment of crisis. He is also quite sharp, and often served as Rom's strategist. His only built-in weapon is the sword stored at his waist, from which he unleashes various secret techniques of Tenku Shin Ken. The Blazer Cannon is an additional weapon that appeared from the middle of the original story; it has the same name as Rod Drill's, but the cannon on Jet fires beams.

texts.english: Rom's younger sister. She goes along on Rom's journey, accompanied by Triple Jim. Although not to the degree her brother is, she has some knowledge of Tenku Chushin Ken, and has shown the Mantis Fist, the Rock-Breaking Fist and the Gale Kick. She is cheerful and active by nature, and somewhat overly devoted to her brother. For that reason, she often frets over her brother, who is popular wherever they travel. She loves fortune-telling, but no matter how many times she does it, it seems to say she is fated never to meet a wonderful person. At first she was treated like a princess, but later she rides the Power Riser and takes an active part in battle. In episode 37 she delivered a somewhat awkward catchphrase, but the catchphrase she delivered when she became the lead in a later video series was truly polished.

texts.english: A fellow disciple of Rom and Jet. He is from the Battle tribe and transforms into a drill tank. Cheerful and bold, he excels at power-based fighting. He was something of a mood maker within the party, yet repeatedly saved his companions from danger with that drill. He is the type who sleeps a full 10 hours, and apparently once punched Jet in his sleep when Jet came to wake him. He has no built-in weapons, and since his trademark drill cannot be used in this form either, he fights with his fists alone, but he rarely shouts technique names; the only one confirmed is "Tenku Chushin Ken: Head-Hunting." The Blazer Cannon differs from Jet's in the shape of its muzzle, and is a missile launcher.

texts.english: A Cronos tribe warrior and martial artist living on planet Cronos. The son of Kirai, the Taoist master who founded Tenku Chushin Ken, he has attained full mastery of both Tenku Chushin Ken and Tenku Shin Ken. Rom likes to use "Tenku Chushin Ken: Whirlwind Kick." The purpose of Tenku Chushin Ken is to defeat evil and protect justice and truth, and in fact Rom's family are aliens who came to planet Cronos to build up their strength. He values justice above all and has a strong heart that never forgives evil, but he seems to be bad with women. Also, although he is polite and strict with himself, he seems to be a little soft on his younger sister Leina. By drawing out the power of Kenro, the sword inherited from his father, he can merge into the giant robots Kenryuu and Baikanfu. With his many Tenku Chushin Ken techniques and a distinctive catchphrase that he delivers suddenly, from out of nowhere, he plunges villains into the depths of terror, and after defeating Gyandlar, he sets off across dimensions (reincarnates) to save a universe ruled by darkness. Incidentally, in the original story Kenryuu and Baikanfu are petrified and left behind on planet Cronos at that time.

texts.english: An operator attached to the NERV Headquarters Central Command Room, in charge of communications and information analysis. When the Strategic Self-Defense Force attacked NERV Headquarters, he encouraged Maya and returned fire with a gun; despite his breezy way of speaking, he also has a gutsy side. His hobby is the guitar.

texts.english: Belongs to Technical Section 1 of the Technology Development Department at NERV Headquarters. She is the daughter of Dr. Naoko Akagi, who built the basic theory of the supercomputer MAGI, and the person in charge of Project E, the Evangelion development project. She has a cool personality, and when faced with the facts she can take a cold attitude toward others. She has been Misato's close friend since their university days. In contrast to her cool personality, her hobby is collecting cat trinkets, and she keeps cats at her family home as well.

texts.english: The pilot of EVA-00. The First Child, the first pilot of the Evangelion series. Her entire background is a mystery, and she is a quiet girl who does not show her emotions. She herself says that her reason for riding an Eva is "bonds." She holds special feelings for Gendo, and treasures his glasses, which broke when he rescued her from the entry plug at the risk of his own body during the Unit-00 experiment. The secret she hides is closely tied to the making of the Evangelion series and to Gendo's aims.

texts.english: The Supreme Commander of the special agency NERV. His background includes being the former director of the Artificial Evolution Laboratory and the former director of Gehirn. Having received the duty of investigating and annihilating the Angels, he has also been entrusted single-handedly with carrying out the Human Instrumentality Project. He is a cold man who will use any means to achieve his goal, and he always takes an overbearing attitude toward other people. This extends even to his own subordinates and his son; the only exception is toward Rei Ayanami. The Human Instrumentality Project he envisions is different from SEELE's plan, and in the end he becomes SEELE's enemy.

texts.english: The pilot of EVA-01. The Third Child, selected by the Marduk Institute. He lost his mother in early childhood and had lived apart from his father Gendo for more than ten years, but was called to Tokyo-3 when the Angels began to arrive. He is introverted and not very good at communicating with other people. At first he rode the Eva out of a sense of duty, but he comes to find the meaning of riding it through the fighting. As he comes into contact with the people of NERV and the boys and girls around him, he gradually opens his heart, but he is also hurt by the incidents that arise during the battles. His special skill is playing the cello.

She is an operator at the NERV Headquarters Central Operations Command who monitors the Eva pilots. She respects her superior Ritsuko. Because she is a fastidious perfectionist, she loathes things like Gendo's way of using any means to achieve his aims.

texts.english: A young man who belongs to NERV's Special Inspection Department. He came to Japan from the German Branch to bring Asuka, Unit-02 and a mysterious object called Adam. In fact he was a triple spy working for NERV, SEELE and the Ministry of the Interior of the Japanese government, but he is assassinated by someone, perhaps because his identity was exposed. He seems a frivolous man who calls out to women he likes, but he is an object of admiration for Asuka, and a caring older-brother type to those younger than himself. His hobby is growing watermelons. Incidentally, he and Misato were lovers in their student days.

texts.english: Belongs to Section 1 of the Operations Bureau, Tactical Operations Department, at NERV Headquarters. Her rank is captain at first (later promoted to major). Her main duties are planning operations for battles with the Angels and commanding those operations. She happened to be at the site of Second Impact in her childhood and lost her father then, so she bears a grudge against the Angels and joined NERV. On the surface she is a cheerful, sloppy and friendly big-sister type who lives with Shinji and gradually opens his heart. However, she herself carries several old wounds inside. She has been Ritsuko's close friend since university, and Kaji was her lover while they were at university. She loves beer and sometimes drinks from the middle of the day, and keeps a hot-spring penguin, Pen Pen, as a pet.

texts.english: Shinji's classmate. A hot-blooded Kansai-dialect speaker and a caring older brother to his little sister. At first, because his little sister was injured in an Eva battle, he took out his anger on Shinji by unfairly blaming him, but he reflected when he saw Shinji earnestly fighting the Angels. After that he became friends with Shinji, along with Kensuke. Later the Marduk Institute selected him as the Fourth Child, and he came to ride EVA-03. However, during its activation test an Angel took it over, Unit-03 was defeated by Unit-01 using the Dummy Plug, and Toji himself was seriously injured.

texts.english: The pilot of EVA-02. The Second Child, selected by the Marduk Institute. She is one-quarter Japanese, with German blood as well, and is a genius girl who graduated from university at 14. She is proud and has absolute confidence in her own ability. For that reason she takes a condescending attitude toward other people, especially boys her own age. That attitude apparently stems from the fact that her mother was involved in Eva experiments and killed herself after being mentally contaminated. She can find her own worth only as an Eva pilot, and when that identity is lost, her mind begins to collapse.

and when that identity is lost, her mind begins to collapse.

texts.english: An entry plug developed so that an Evangelion can be operated without a pilot. Some kind of personality seems to have been implanted in it, and it works as a dummy for the pilot with respect to the Eva.
lines: An entry plug developed so that an Evangelion can be operated without a pilot.

texts.english: The fifth Angel to be confirmed. It has an octahedral exterior and attacks approaching enemies with a powerful charged particle cannon. To defeat this Angel, NERV used a modified positron cannon for Evas (NERV specification), which required power supplied from all over Japan.
lines: The fifth Angel to be confirmed. It has an octahedral exterior and attacks

texts.english: The thirteenth Angel to be confirmed. Lurking inside a cumulonimbus cloud, it made contact with EVA-03, which was being transported to NERV's Second Experimental Site in Matsushiro, and immediately after the activation test it completely took over Unit-03 with Toji still inside, whereupon it was recognized as an Angel. It went as far as defeating Unit-00 and Unit-02, but was destroyed by Unit-01, which had activated the Dummy System.

texts.english: The fourteenth Angel to be confirmed. It invaded the Geofront from Tokyo-3 and, with overwhelming attack power surpassing any previous Angel, defeated Unit-02 and Unit-00. In the end it fought the berserk Unit-01 and was eaten.
lines: The fourteenth Angel to be confirmed. It invaded the Geofront from Tokyo-3

Unit-02 and Unit-00. In the end it fought the berserk Unit-01 and was eaten.

texts.english: The Fifth Child, dispatched by SEELE. His background, like Rei Ayanami's, is entirely unknown. He has a startling ability to change his synchronization rate at will, which astonished the NERV staff. He actively approached Shinji, and Shinji opened his heart to his straightforwardness and kindness. However, he was in fact the 17th Angel Tabris, sent in by SEELE, and he entered Terminal Dogma with the unmanned Unit-02 in tow. In the end, at his own wish, he was crushed by Unit-01, which Shinji was riding. He loved songs and hummed Beethoven's Ninth.

texts.english: Belongs to Section 1 of the Operations Bureau at the NERV Headquarters Central Operations Command. He assists Misato in planning operations and handles operator duties such as analyzing the battle situation inside the base. He has feelings for Misato that go beyond those toward a mere superior, and he obtains top-secret information for her without caring that his own position may be endangered because of it.

texts.english: The Deputy Commander of NERV. Always calm and composed, and a bit of a cynic. He has known Gendo since the time he was serving as an assistant professor at a university. His first impression of Gendo when they first met was "an unpleasant man," but after Second Impact he became Gendo's collaborator. At times he voices negative opinions to Gendo, but he is one of the few people who understand Gendo's aims.

texts.english: Shinji and the others' classmate and the class representative. A model student whose nickname is also "Class Rep." She secretly has feelings for Toji, and promises to make a lunch box and bring it to Toji, who eats bread bought at the school store for lunch. However, because of the Unit-03 incident, this promise was never fulfilled in the original work. Incidentally, she was apparently drawn to Toji's "kindness." She also has an older sister named Kodama and a younger sister named Nozomi.

texts.english: The Evangelion series that SEELE, the secret organization managing the Human Instrumentality Project, sent to NERV Headquarters to stop Gendo, who was advancing his own plan outside its schedule. There are nine in all. Unlike the series up to then, their specifications include flight ability and the S2 Engine as standard equipment. Dummy Plugs are used to activate and operate them, and those seem to contain Kaworu Nagisa's data.

texts.english: An operator of the Earth defense organization GEAR. She looks like a trendy girl, but is in fact a woman of many talents, 22 years old and born on Valentine's Day. Her ability with computers is especially high, and she is the only one who has beaten the central computer Meteo at chess. She wanted a clerical job in hopes of retiring early to marry, but she is a super woman who can even serve as a sub-pilot of the Cell Fighter.

texts.english: The chip of Giga Absolute, one of the three Machine Generals of Spiral Castle. The chip is a copy, but because bugs occurred along with the miniaturization, it has come to act foolishly. It can already be called a mechanical life form separate from the main body. Absolute is the leader of the three, and speaks with "dawa" at the end of its sentences.

texts.english: The pilot of Knight GEAR Ogre who came from the Gulfer home planet. The Gears require a human as pilot. He is also the captain of Gulfer Emperor's guard and holds the title of Black Knight. He always wears a mask, so his true face is unknown, and although he is only human, he has been entrusted with full authority over capturing the data weapons and looks down on the three Machine Generals. For that reason he often clashes with the three Machine Generals. He has a deep-rooted history with Vega.

texts.english: Vega's older brother and the prince of Alktos. He is Hokuto's uncle. He was originally a kind older brother who cared for his younger sister, but in a past battle his memory was manipulated by Gulfer Emperor, and he had been opposing humanity. After a long fight he recovers his memory, and from then on fights alongside the others, aiming to defeat Gulfer. Like Vega, he has considerable fighting power even without a machine. Also, because Altair's memory came back, Ogre raised the visor on its head and showed its original face.

texts.english: Ginga's younger sister. She calls Ginga "Gin-nii." She is quite a tomboy, and scribbling on the poster of Ginga's favorite idol is an everyday occurrence. She is surprisingly dependable and sometimes shows a sharpness unlike a three-year-old. With a child's high adaptability, she even becomes friends with Leo Circle.

texts.english: A bright, energetic 11-year-old boy who attends Hoshimi Elementary School. His father works as a correspondent for a regional magazine and is often away from Japan. He is the hot-blooded, straightforward type who is better at moving his body than thinking, but once his spirit breaks, he also has the bad side of losing motivation for everything. Chosen as a Dendoh pilot together with Hokuto, he received the blue Gear Commander. He has learned Shorinji Kempo from his mother since he was little, and its movements are used in Dendoh's actions. At first he seems to have ridden simply because it looked cool, but he gradually awakens to his mission. He has a strong competitive spirit and took on the role of pulling along Hokuto, who is toyed with by a strange fate. His favorite idol is Yuki-chan of C-DRiVE, and her fan-club-only poster seems to be more precious to Ginga than his life.

texts.english: Ginga's mother, age 36. She was the 15th leader of Hiroshima's strongest lady gang, "Andromeda," but fell in love at first sight with Genichi Izumo and married him, and had two children, Ginga and Otome. Her Shorinji Kempo, which she has continued since her lady-gang days, is at the level of an instructor's assistant, and every day she drills Ginga hard under the teaching "Strength is heart." She also has a firm, upright character and never forgives injustice or wrongdoing.

texts.english: The chip of Giga Witter, one of the three Machine Generals of Spiral Castle. Like the other two, it was sent to Earth to search for Dendoh's pilots and the data weapons. Of the three, Witter has the weakest sense of mission and gets bored easily. It speaks with "jan" at the end of its sentences.

texts.english: A genius girl who graduated from MIT (Massachusetts Institute of Technology) at age 11. She was scouted by GEAR as the youngest person ever, and has been entrusted with the post of chief analyst of data weapons. She has none of the unpleasantness common to elites; she loves animals and is a kind-hearted girl. Her mental age is indeed high, and at times she treated Ginga and the others like children. Her hobby is bass fishing, and she says its charm lies in an uncertainty that is not just logic.

texts.english: A boar-type data weapon that symbolizes "Creation." It has an impulsive, clumsy personality, and also serves as the leader of the data weapons. It rarely materialized to fight, but it was used frequently as a weapon. Its attribute is "Light."

texts.english: The emperor of the machine empire Gulfer, which plots to exterminate humanity.
lines: The emperor of the machine empire Gulfer, which plots to exterminate
humanity.

texts.english: One of the three executives of Spiral Castle. In Ginga's words, "pompous guy number 3." Its body is made of liquid metal, and it changes shape to dodge enemy attacks or entangle opponents. It is also quick, and good at surprise attacks by seeping into walls.
