texts.english: One of the three executives of Spiral Castle. In Ginga's words, "a pompous kendama." It generates powerful electromagnetic waves from its main body and has the ability to disable all electronic equipment. Also, as long as its head, the core, is not destroyed, its body will regenerate any number of times.

texts.english: One of the three executives of Spiral Castle. In Ginga's words, "pompous guy number 2." It deploys an electromagnetic interference field around itself and has the ability to hinder the materialization of data weapons. It emits electric shocks from its arms and fires a beam cannon from its mouth. It is also quite a power fighter.

number 2." It deploys an electromagnetic interference field around itself and has
the ability to hinder the materialization of data weapons. It emits electric

texts.english: One of the Machine Knights that infiltrated Earth hidden in meteorites, the one that emerged from a meteorite that fell near Mikazuki Island. Machine Knights are higher beings than machine beasts and possess high intelligence. It excels at high-speed aerial combat and can also transform into a flight form. The Photon Rifle is a versatile weapon that can also transform into a Photon Scythe.

texts.english: One of the Machine Knights that infiltrated Earth hidden in meteorites, the one that emerged from a meteorite that fell in the wasteland of the Oceania continent. Its weapons are the Photon Laser fired from its forehead and electric shocks from the wings on its back. It is the Machine Knight that dodged the Final Attack and remained to the end.

texts.english: One of the Machine Knights that infiltrated Earth hidden in meteorites, the one that emerged from a meteorite that fell in the Amazon jungle of the South American continent. It excels at tricky attacks with its extendable arms.
lines: One of the Machine Knights that infiltrated Earth hidden in meteorites, the one

American continent. It excels at tricky attacks with its extendable arms.

texts.english: One of the Machine Knights that infiltrated Earth hidden in meteorites, the one that emerged from a meteorite that fell in the Sahara Desert of the African continent. It has the ability to heat its whole body white-hot and explode everything in the surrounding area.
lines: One of the Machine Knights that infiltrated Earth hidden in meteorites, the one

texts.english: A pilot of the Earth defense organization GEAR, age 26. He was originally a hero-loving young man working at the Hoshimi Amusement Park, but happened to discover the GEAR headquarters and forcibly became a member. At first he was a candidate for Dendoh pilot together with Vega, but because Hokuto and Ginga were chosen, he became support personnel. He is an expert at clay-pigeon shooting.

texts.english: Hokuto's mother, age 29. In fact she is the young lady of the Saionji family, said to be a shadow power in the political and business world. Despite her gentle appearance she is good at sports and highly intelligent; she became a university student by skipping grades, met Keisuke Kusanagi, and married him after a great romance. She has only just moved into Hoshimi Town and runs the cafe Polar at her home. Her specialty dish is beef stew.

texts.english: Hokuto's father, age 32. He works as an announcer in the news department of Nitto TV. In his younger days he lived only for work, and he secretly feels guilty that he could not pay attention to his son, so recently he keeps inviting Hokuto to watch soccer. Taking a daughter of the Saionji family as his wife shows that he has quite a bit of nerve.

texts.english: A fifth-grader who transferred to Hoshimi Elementary School. He is Ginga's classmate and next-door neighbor. He is an honor student who thinks first before acting, a personality opposite to Ginga's, so at first they clashed, but they gradually become best partners. Though an honor student, he has a surprisingly lively side, and seems to be popular with both boys and girls in his class. On the very day he moved in, he was chosen with Ginga as a Dendoh pilot and received the black Gear Commander. He has a strong sense of responsibility; he is afraid of riding Dendoh, but thinks that if only the two of them can do it, they have no choice but to do it. He also has deep knowledge about computers and has even hacked the school's computer. Also, he casually uses the word "Newtype," so he may well be a big anime fan. His hobbies are soccer and billiards, and his pet dog is named Jupiter.

texts.english: The chip of Giga Gourmet, one of the three Machine Generals of Spiral Castle. The chips have meta-traced into human form so that they can move more easily, but their true form is android. Of the three, Gourmet is the one who can come up with the most sensible plans. It speaks with "bari" at the end of its sentences.

texts.english: A shadowy powerful figure who controls Japan's political and business world from behind the scenes. Seventeen years ago he helped a girl who had flown in from space and raised her as his daughter. At that time he learned of the existence of Gulfer, and to protect Earth from Gulfer's hands he threw away his private fortune and established the Earth defense organization GEAR.
lines: A shadowy powerful figure who controls Japan's political and business world

from space and raised her as his daughter. At that time he learned of the
existence of Gulfer, and to protect Earth from Gulfer's hands he threw away
his private fortune and established the Earth defense organization GEAR.

texts.english: The chief of the Earth defense organization GEAR, age 58. GEAR is an abbreviation of Guard Earth and Advanced Reconnaissance, meaning "an organization for Earth defense and cutting-edge research." Chief Shibuya has been deeply involved since its founding and is also the only person who knows the true identity of deputy commander Vega. As commander he sometimes makes harsh decisions, but he is a father figure full of kindness who worries about the children, and keeps together GEAR, which has many young people. He holds 3rd dan in kendo, 2nd dan in judo and 3rd dan in calligraphy, and after retirement he plans to open a pottery class in his hometown of Shizuoka.

texts.english: A boy raised as Gulfer Emperor's son and Altair's younger brother. He had been taught by Gulfer Emperor that he was the rightful successor to Ogre, but in reality it seems he was regarded as a spare. Because he grew up in the machine empire, he is poor at expressing emotions and cannot cry or laugh well. He grew up eating only colorful cubes of solidified nutrients, so he is said not to know even the joy of eating.

texts.english: A top Gulfer executive who came to Earth as Subaru's guardian. Unlike the chips, his main body itself takes human form, so his combat power is high, and even in this form he has the power to wipe out the GEAR base.
lines: A top Gulfer executive who came to Earth as Subaru's guardian. Unlike the
chips, his main body itself takes human form, so his combat power is high, and
even in this form he has the power to wipe out the GEAR base.

texts.english: A top Gulfer executive and aide to Gulfer Emperor who commands at the front lines in place of the emperor. He excels at melee combat and is good at staff fighting with an extendable staff (a nyoibo). He also has the terrifying special ability to revive immediately even when destroyed. He often travels, or performs combined attacks, riding on the back of the heavy machine beast Vector, which is capable of interstellar travel.

texts.english: Zero's strongest form, combined with the heavy machine beast Vector. Armed with a giant lancer and the Photon Blasters fired from both shoulders, its combat power and mobility are both greatly powered up. Heavy machine beasts is a general term for machine beasts that earned promotions through achievements when Gulfer invaded other planets before conquering Earth; having gained experience, they are stronger individuals than ordinary machine beasts.

beasts is a general term for machine beasts that earned promotions through

having gained experience, they are stronger individuals than ordinary machine
beasts.

texts.english: The king of the data weapons, born from the fusion of the revived Unicorn Drill and Leo Circle. It symbolizes "Friendship." It can transform into several forms: Kiba Striker, Kiba Breaker and Kiba Spinner. Because its performance exceeds that of the other data weapons, it is often used as a finishing move. Its attribute is "Wind" + "Whirl" = "Storm."

texts.english: The chief designer who handles all the hardware of the Earth defense organization GEAR. After graduating from a top university he worked at a toy maker, but was recruited into GEAR for his outstanding design ability. He is surprisingly young at 31. He likes heroes, which explains why he gets along with Kirakuni. He collects ROGO blocks.
lines: The chief designer who handles all the hardware of the Earth defense
organization GEAR. After graduating from a top university he worked at a toy
maker, but was recruited into GEAR for his outstanding design ability. He is
surprisingly young at 31. He likes heroes, which explains why he gets along
with Kirakuni. He collects ROGO blocks.

texts.english: A dragon-type data weapon that symbolizes "Compassion." It has a calm, hard-to-please personality, is learned, and tends to love solitude. It often materialized to fight. Its attribute is "Flame."
lines: A dragon-type data weapon that symbolizes "Compassion." It has a calm,

texts.english: A cobra-type data weapon that symbolizes "Confidence." It is delicate and shrewd, the type whose true thoughts cannot be read. It is the best schemer among the data weapons. Data weapons also have the role of unlocking the sealed abilities of the Gears, and it is said that something will happen when all six data weapons are gathered. Its attribute is "Lightning."

texts.english: A phoenix-type data weapon that symbolizes "Hope." Its attribute is "Rainbow." It had been hiding in Hokuto's head from the start, lending its power while borrowing the appearance of Vega as a young girl. The human brain, which transmits commands by electric signals, can also become a hiding place for data weapons. It can be made into a weapon for both Dendoh and Ogre at the same time. Also, because Dendoh has obtained all the data weapons, it can use Akatsuki's Great Sword, the ultimate evil-dispelling blade.

texts.english: A buffalo-type data weapon that symbolizes "Wisdom." It is usually quiet, but when angered it is out of control. It is the strongest of the data weapons. For some reason it was not used much. Its attribute is "Earth."

texts.english: The deputy commander of the Earth defense organization GEAR. She hides her face behind a mask, and her true identity is kept secret even within GEAR. She was greatly involved in the founding of GEAR and is well versed in information about Dendoh and the data weapons. She was originally a candidate for Dendoh pilot, but since Hokuto and Ginga were chosen, her main duties became directing operations and supporting at the front lines using her dedicated bike, the Valkyrie. She also has astonishing physical ability, and is the only person who can fight Gulfer in person using the latest technology weapons developed by Dr. Inoue, such as beigoma bombs and the Measure. Usually she acts as a strict superior, but now and then she shows cute sides, such as making blunders or repairing her cracked mask with cellophane tape and using it.

texts.english: A mysterious girl who seems to be deeply connected with Dendoh.
lines: A mysterious girl who seems to be deeply connected with Dendoh.

texts.english: The giant computer that manages the GEAR headquarters. GEAR needs only a very small staff thanks to Meteo. It is powered by the Meteo Cube, a high-energy crystal from outside Earth.
lines: The giant computer that manages the GEAR headquarters. GEAR needs only a

texts.english: A unicorn-type data weapon that symbolizes "Trust." It has a curious, friendly personality. Besides becoming a weapon or materializing, data weapons can also become "aliased," taking an astral form that has no physical interference with other objects. Unicorn Drill liked to alias and would slip out of the Gear Commander on its own to play. Its attribute is "Whirl."

texts.english: The lord of Spiral Castle, sent to conquer Earth, who is called "Oyakata-sama." Under it are the three Machine Generals, and it is the apex of a pyramid that includes the machine beasts below them. Spiral Castle is a unit of the Gulfer army, and countless Spiral Castles exist throughout the universe.

texts.english: Gulfer Emperor's pet. It is not a machine life form but a space creature that eats machines. For that reason it is also used to punish subordinates who have failed. Hidden in Lagowe's huge jaws are fangs implanted with the Lagowe Virus, a computer virus that is deadly poison to machines.

texts.english: A lion-type data weapon that symbolizes "Courage." It has an easygoing, slow-paced personality and often dozes off. It likes girls, becoming friends with Otome and helping with the e-mail exchanges with Yuki-chan of C-DRiVE. Its attribute is "Wind."

texts.english: One of the former Nadesico crew and a Space Force lieutenant colonel, age 25. He is Yurika's childhood friend from her days on Earth and has been in love with her since he was a boy; during the Jovian War he served as Nadesico's assistant captain, but his feelings did not reach her. He is currently captain of the battleship Amaryllis of the Space Force 3rd Fleet and is on colony guard duty, and in the Shirahime Incident he witnessed Black Sarana boson out. He is capable at work but weak with women, so he has long been a plaything of the women. Incidentally, these days he is pushed around by Yukina every day.

texts.english: Chairman of Nergal Heavy Industries, age 25. During the Jovian War, in order to monopolize Martian overtechnology, he boarded Nadesico under a concealed identity as a replacement pilot, and his ability as a pilot was ace class. His principle of action puts Nergal and himself first, and he does not choose his means to achieve his goals. After the war he disappeared from the public stage, but seems to have continued his activities behind the scenes with his specialty, covert operations.

texts.english: Admiral of the United Space Force. He was a central figure in the Hot-Blooded Coup and opened the road to peace; he is an active Mokuren soldier but also holds a post in the Space Force as a goodwill ambassador. His personality is bold yet calm and cool-headed. He is a quite sharp man. During the Jovian War, he fought Nadesico as captain of the battleship Kannazuki of the Assault Yuto Space Corps.

texts.english: Brigadier general of the Earth Alliance Unified Peacekeeping Forces. He is the person in charge of security at Amaterasu, the main terminal colony of the Hisago Plan. He is the type who cannot see his surroundings when he gets hot, and cannot really be called a capable commander. The Unified Forces is a military reorganized around the Mokuren forces and the Earth's army, navy and air forces; many people who felt cramped because the Space Force stole the leading role during the Jovian War belong to it, so relations with the Space Force are bad. Of course, Brigadier General Azuma also regards the Space Force as his enemy.

texts.english: One of the three Aestivalis pilot girls of the old Nadesico, age 23. She is a born otaku girl who loves manga, anime and games, and does doujin activities as a hobby. She joined the military to draw realistic SF manga using her experience as a pilot. After the Jovian War she left the military and now has a serialization in a monthly magazine as a professional manga artist, but she seems to be drawing school stories, not SF. She has a cheerful, friendly personality, but a fairly hard past, such as being taken in by an uncle after her parents died.

texts.english: A brilliant woman, a survivor of the Nergal research facility on Mars, who handled the medical and science teams on the old Nadesico. She is also one of the few Class A Jumpers. In fact, she is the girl who was sent alone to Mars twenty years in the past when Akito made humanity's first Boson Jump during the First Battle of Mars, and she has a past of having been raised at a Nergal laboratory with her memory lost. After the Jovian War she was protected by Nergal, and she is officially registered as having died in an airplane accident. She loves to explain everything.

texts.english: Chief mechanic of the old Nadesico, age 34. He was originally the owner of a small factory who did illegal modifications as a hobby, and his skill as a mechanic is first-rate. Garage kits, dioramas, hacking, inventions: he is a hobbyist with lopsided but diverse talents. After the Jovian War he returned to his old factory and lived with his wife. The scar on his cheek is from fighting yet again with the wife he left on Earth this time, and is not an old wound.

texts.english: The chairman's secretary of Nergal Heavy Industries, who boarded the old Nadesico partway through as co-helmswoman, age 25. She is strongly career-oriented and tended to be at odds with the Nadesico crew. After the Jovian War she seems to have done various jobs as Akatsuki's right hand, and for a time she is said to have looked after Akito.

texts.english: Nadesico's central computer. The name Omoikane is written with the kanji for "thinking" and "concurrent," and comes from the deity Omoikane-no-kami who appears in the Heavenly Rock Cave legend of Japanese mythology. Its official name is SVC2027. It has a kind of self-awareness, and is the super-high-performance computer that makes Nadesico a one-man-operation battleship. It has been with Ruri since the days of the old Nadesico, and has feelings resembling friendship toward her.

texts.english: The leader of the Martian Successors. He was formerly the supreme commander of the Mokuren Yuto Corps with the rank of lieutenant general. He was the de facto leader during the Jovian War, but was expelled in the Hot-Blooded Coup and went missing. He seems to have been in contact with the Crimson Group since wartime and to have been preparing for an armed uprising beneath the surface. He is a hot-blooded man who loves justice and can die for his ideals, but he has the troublesome side of never doubting that his ideals are also ideals for others.

texts.english: Former battle leader of Nadesico. He is an employee of Nergal Heavy Industries and was also the person in charge of the Schiaparelli Project, which aimed to retake the Mars ruins. After the Jovian War he belongs to the Nergal Secret Service, and is in charge of watching over and protecting the former Nadesico crew and intelligence work against rival companies. He is a taciturn and honest man, and it was he who rescued Akito from the Martian Successors' laboratory.

texts.english: The younger sister of Tsukumo Shiratori, the hero of Mokuren who was assassinated at the peace talks. During the Jovian War she had so much initiative that she boarded Nadesico alone in order to assassinate Minato, who had misled her brother. After the war she was taken in by Minato, and is a 16-year-old current high-school girl attending school in Ooiso City. She belongs to the track team at school and is scheduled to compete in the summer inter-high. She has feelings for Jun, but does not seem to be conscious of him as a man yet.

texts.english: Lieutenant colonel of the Unified Forces. He was in charge of the security of Amaterasu as Brigadier General Azuma's subordinate, but in reality he had the hidden face of being the number two of the Martian Successors, and deceived those around him.

texts.english: A lieutenant in the Unified Forces and one of the three Aestivalis pilot girls of the old Nadesico, age 23. She has quite a manly personality and calls herself "ore." She had feelings for Akito, but was shy about romance and could not tell him how she felt. At the time she had dyed her hair green, so at a glance she looks like a different person. After the war she transferred to the Unified Forces and serves as a pilot instructor and Aestivalis squadron leader, and has trained many excellent subordinates.

texts.english: A captain of the United Space Force and the first officer of Nadesico B, age 25. He also commands in combat, flying a Super Aestivalis. He is a former Mokuren soldier and served as first officer of the battleship Kannazuki during the Jovian War. Now he looks like a flirty, flippant guy, but at that time he was a straightforward young man; it is said that when he guarded Ruri on Akiyama's special orders after the war, he disguised himself as a surfer and ended up picking up a light attitude.

texts.english: One of the few Class A Jumpers, age 23. A A-Class Jumper refers to a person capable of solo biological Boson Jump, and is an indispensable talent for controlling jumps. Akito is Yurika's childhood friend from her days on Mars, and served as both an Aestivalis pilot and a cook on the old Nadesico. After the war he opened a ramen stall, and seems to have lived in a tenement with Yurika and Ruri, the three of them. After that, following a ramen contest with Koichiro Misumaru, he married Yurika. On their honeymoon he was thought to have died in a shuttle accident, but in fact the two had been abducted by the Martian Successors, and in the human experiments on Boson Jump, Akito lost most of his five senses. He was later rescued by the Nergal Secret Service, but because he could not take Yurika back, he is now operating covertly to retake Yurika and take revenge on the Martian Successors, with Nergal's support. He gives off a cold, cool air, and seems a different person from the indecisive, naive youth of the old Nadesico days.

texts.english: Helmswoman of the old Nadesico, age 27. She was originally a beautiful secretary at a major company, but boarded Nadesico in search of fulfillment. A woman who is not only alluring but also highly intelligent and tolerant, she fell in love with Tsukumo Shiratori of Mokuren and served as a bridge between Earth and Mokuren. After the war she took in Yukina, who had lost her family, and teaches mathematics in Ooiso City.

texts.english: One of the former Nadesico crew, dispatched from Nergal as supervisor and auditor. He is also the person who selected the old Nadesico crew. His age and real name are both unknown, and Prospector is something like a pen name. Incidentally, it means a miner or test driller. Near the end of the Jovian War he turned against Nergal, but he returned to Nergal after the war. Belonging to the chairman's secretary section, he is active mainly in information gathering.

texts.english: The leader of the assassination unit directly under Kusakabe. He can be called the dark side of the Martian Successors, and specializes in dirty work such as kidnapping and murder. He is a cold, ruthless man who thinks nothing of killing his comrades for a mission. Incidentally, his left eye is a prosthetic eye.

texts.english: Members of the assassination unit led by Hokushin.
lines: Members of the assassination unit led by Hokushin.

texts.english: Captain of Nadesico B, famous as the youngest-ever genius beautiful girl captain. She is 16 and holds the rank of major. She is a master of computer operation, with the nickname Electronic Fairy. She is a girl created by prohibited genetic manipulation, and at age 11 she served as the operator of the old Nadesico. Before boarding the old Nadesico she had almost no memories except for education, so the memories of that time are important to her. After the war she lived with Yurika and Akito, but because the two had an accident, she was taken in by Minato. At that time she met Takasugi and recovered from the memory of the accident, returned to the Space Force, solved numerous difficult cases, and has come to the present.

texts.english: One of the three Aestivalis pilot girls of the old Nadesico, age 23. She is an eccentric whose specialties are chilly puns and the ukulele, and her parents seem to have been comedians. Having been left behind by her fiances twice through death, she seems to have thought of herself as a woman who brings misfortune. After the war she wandered the world learning various martial arts and polishing her bizarre sense of humor. Having saved the owner from thugs on her travels, she seems to have become the hired mama-san of the bar "Kemeko."

texts.english: An ensign of the United Space Force and the assistant first officer of Nadesico B, age 11. Like Ruri, he is a boy born through Nergal's genetic manipulation, and has excellent operation ability. Reflecting on how Ruri was raised, he was placed with an ordinary family from early childhood, and seems to have grown into a bright boy with rich emotional expression. He adores Ruri, who is close in age and similar in background, as an older sister, and Ruri also seems to think of him as a younger brother; the nickname Harry was given by her.

texts.english: Commander-in-chief of the Earth Alliance Space Force. He was an admiral during the Jovian War, but seems to have risen in rank. He is Yurika's father and a doting father to the extreme. Basically he is a capable soldier, but when it comes to Yurika he has the bad habit of putting personal feelings first. Naturally he was strongly opposed to her marriage to Akito. Also, his habit of reciting strange senryu and haiku does not seem to have been cured.
lines: Commander-in-chief of the Earth Alliance Space Force. He was an admiral
during the Jovian War, but seems to have risen in rank. He is Yurika's father and
a doting father to the extreme. Basically he is a capable soldier, but when it
comes to Yurika he has the bad habit of putting personal feelings first.
Naturally he was strongly opposed to her marriage to Akito. Also, his habit of
reciting strange senryu and haiku does not seem to have been cured.

texts.english: Captain of the old Nadesico, age 25. She is also one of the Class A Jumpers. A sheltered daughter whose father is commander-in-chief of the United Space Force, she has a fairly carefree personality but is a genius at strategy simulation. She kept waiting for Akito, whom she fell in love with as a small child, and even after they met again on the old Nadesico, she never doubted that Akito loved her very much. Near the end of the Jovian War she made the decision to discard the Mars ruins into the far reaches of space, and as a result the two armies, having lost the purpose of the war, headed toward a truce. In a sense she is the one who deserves credit for ending the war. After the war she stayed in the military while helping at Akito's stall, and happily got married, but on their honeymoon she was abducted by the Martian Successors and used as a human translator for Boson Jumps, joined to the ruins in a state of suspended animation.

texts.english: Communications officer of the old Nadesico, age 22. She originally worked as a voice actress, and seems to have been scouted for her beautiful voice. While aboard the old Nadesico she rivaled Yurika over Akito, and even came close to eloping. After the war she returned to voice acting and has become a hugely popular idol active in songs and radio, and is called by the nicknames "Megu-nee" and "Megu-tan."

texts.english: Deputy director of the Colony Development Corporation, posted at Amaterasu. In reality, however, he is a member of the Martian Successors and a scientist who serves as the chief of Boson Jump research. He is a nonchalant, elusive man, and quite a character.

texts.english: A girl created through genetic manipulation like Ruri. She also has excellent operation ability. She was originally raised at a Nergal laboratory, but was captured by the Martian Successors and later rescued by Akito. Since then she has acted together with Akito, who lost his five senses, as his support. The battleship Eucharis that she operates is the mothership of Black Sarana. She lacks emotional expression even more than Ruri used to, and is a mysterious girl.

texts.english: Kaine's mother. She is divorced from her husband, Jim Austin, who was an Alliance soldier. She worked at the immigration control center of the colony Alucard, but went missing during the fighting with Giganos. A woman faithful to her duties and valuing ethics, she is someone Kaine respects, though he does not say so out loud.

When first introduced, the Practice Squad was an obnoxious elite group, but as the story progressed, their devoted actions toward Meio won support, and they gained fans.

texts.english: One of Gon Jem's Four Heavenly Kings, who pilots the Stark Gan-Dolla. His rank is captain. Fittingly for the Gon Jem Squad, which is called "Giganos's filth," he has an extremely cruel personality, and is described as a murderer wearing a military uniform. He has a big scar on his face and always has a 5-sun (about 15 cm) nail in his mouth. Maybe he is short on iron.

texts.english: The founder and supreme ruler of the United Empire Giganos. It seems he was originally a high-ranking officer of some country. He starts the invasion of Earth to eliminate everyone and every idea belonging to the Earth Alliance as inferior and create a new order in space. He loves Earth so much that, in order to wipe out the Alliance forces without harming Earth's beauty, he even carries out pinpoint attacks using mass drivers. He holds an elitist ideology of thoroughgoing ability supremacy, and keeps as pets rumble fish, which kill each other if several are put in the same tank.

texts.english: The commander of the Asia theater secret guard unit of Giganos. His rank is colonel. He has four skilled subordinates called Gon Jem's Four Heavenly Kings. He is rough and vulgar by nature, and that shows in his way of fighting too: even in Metal Armor combat, he excels at close combat with a huge Azure Dragon sword. Having done a number of dirty jobs, he seems to have connections in the military. He is also surprisingly caring toward his subordinates and is trusted by them. With a sacred straw rope (shimenawa) strung around his neck, he resembles a Tosa fighting dog.

texts.english: A 16-year-old civilian boy who lived on the space colony Alucard and attends the Astronaut Academy. His parents are divorced; his father is a staff officer of the Alliance forces and his mother works at the colony's immigration control center. He gets along well with Tapp and Light. During Giganos's attack on Alucard, the three happened to be on the scene in town where a man carrying a data disk of a secret weapon was shot dead by someone, and were entrusted with the disk by the man as he died, and they ended up becoming pilots of the secret weapon, the Dragonars. However, since the Dragonars had a system that could be piloted only by those who had completed pilot registration, they went along with the Alliance forces as events unfolded. By personality he is more of a flirt, but he is a straightforward type who acts without thinking too much, and the typical bully-boy type, oddly loyal and with a strong sense of justice. As a result he stirs up trouble here and there and drags those around him in. His hairstyle was originally a pompadour, but the demon sergeant cut it, giving him his current look. He falls in love at first sight with Linda, whom he met as a refugee from the Moon.

texts.english: One of Gon Jem's Four Heavenly Kings, who pilots the Stark Gewai. His rank is captain. He is the biggest man in the Gon Jem Squad, with a skeleton that does not seem human, but his wits are weak to match. He has a very violent personality and a habit of firing his machine cannon everywhere when something displeases him, which is extremely annoying. Looking for a wife.

texts.english: A soldier of the Earth Alliance Forces, with the rank of lieutenant. The official pilot of Dragonar-1. Because Kaine stole the Dragonar-1 that he should rightfully have ridden, he reluctantly became the training officer for Kaine and the others, an unfortunate man. Perhaps for that reason, although he is a capable soldier, he got no further than captain even after promotions. He becomes a crying drunk when he gets drunk.

texts.english: One of Gon Jem's Four Heavenly Kings, who pilots the Stark Dauzehn. His rank is lieutenant. He has looks that could be called handsome, but among the four he is the most calculating, cold-blooded and vindictive. His manner of death was, truly, too awful. I cannot forget the sight of him threatening Linda while licking a knife.

texts.english: One of the refugees aboard the transport ship Idaho, a mysterious beautiful teacher. In truth, however, she is a second lieutenant of Earth Alliance Forces intelligence, in charge of monitoring the D-Weapons and guarding Linda. At 22, she is the most adult of the three heroines. She is a big-sister figure to Linda and Rose, and is calm and composed. Perhaps for that reason she gets along with Light, but it did not progress much. A mature woman full of kindness and consideration for others, she has the flaw of being a bad drunk.

texts.english: A 16-year-old student at the same Astronaut Academy as Kaine, from New York. He becomes the pilot of Dragonar-2. He is the so-called "gentle and strong" type, but like Kaine and the others, a cheerful boy with a light attitude. He is family-minded, and sends part of his military pay to his parents and younger sister living in New York. Influenced by his parents, who were musicians, he loves music, and his treasured CD player is, by his own account, the third most important thing to him after his life. He particularly likes rock and jazz. His dream for the future is to work in show business and run a theater that stages musicals and the like. A self-declared and generally acknowledged "feminist" (in the Japanese sense of being gallant toward women), he gets on good terms with Rose before anyone notices.

The Practice Squad was also called the "boys' unit," which is an apt description. He is the only one of the three to die in battle, and that, too, was to protect Meio, as one would expect.

texts.english: A lieutenant colonel of the Giganos Empire. Known as a radical, he proposes indiscriminate all-out attacks with mass drivers, and so on. Each time, however, Guiltorre admonishes him, and he seems to be inwardly irritated that his opinions are not accepted. He is interested only in winning this war and has no perspective on what to do with the world after the war. He is an ambitious man with both baseness and pettiness, but the image of a small-fry sticks to him.

texts.english: His full name is Lang Plato. He is the father of Linda and Meio. A scientist who was the chief of Metal Armor development for the Giganos military and who designed and developed the three Dragonars. But to weed out the seeds of war he had sown himself, after the outbreak of war he defected to the Earth Alliance with the Dragonars, and is working on the Dragoon mass-production plan at the Chongqing base. His love for his family is deep, as shown by his remembering the clothing size of his ex-wife, but it does not seem to get through to his children very well. Despite carrying a heavy past, he normally plays a cheerful old guy. His favorite food is Chinese steamed buns.

texts.english: The demon sergeant appointed as the training officer for Kaine and the others. It is hard enough just to give soldier training to the three goofballs, and as the person in charge of training he is also scolded by Lieutenant Douglas, so it is a thankless role. In the end, however, considering that he marries a certain person, he can be called a lucky man. He has a bold personality, but is surprisingly meticulous, and is a dependable big-brother figure to the three.

texts.english: A young ace of the Giganos Imperial Guard Armored Corps, known as the "Blue Hawk of Giganos." He is 24 years old with the rank of captain. He agrees with the ideology of Giganos and is trusted by Guiltorre, but carries the burden of being the son of a traitor. Calm and confident, he is blessed with the qualities of a commander who makes accurate decisions, and he has many believers within the military. For that reason he also has many enemies, and attempts to bring him down never cease. In the latter half of the story he completely steals the show with his activity, and is highly regarded as the hidden protagonist. The last scene of the final episode in particular is a must-see.

texts.english: One of Gon Jem's Four Heavenly Kings, a tall woman who pilots the Stark Dein. Her rank is captain. She is quite strong, and it is said that no one who teased her got away unharmed. She is the sole woman in the Gon Jem Squad and a gutsy big-sister figure, but shows a cute side toward a man she acknowledges as stronger than herself. Her skill is solid, and she survived to the end even after the Gon Jem Squad was wiped out, and snatched the best parts.

texts.english: A 17-year-old student at the same Astronaut Academy as Kaine, who carries noble blood. He becomes the pilot of Dragonar-3. He is deeply versed in electronics, and seems to have taken to Dragonar-3, the electronic warfare machine, at first sight. Among the three he is comparatively calm and intellectual, but since he is basically a goofball, he often plays the part of the comic handsome guy. His role is to stop Kaine, who runs ahead alone. He is a rich family's young master, but he rebelled against that and entered the Astronaut Academy. However, thanks to the environment he grew up in, he can handle social pleasantries properly and is skilled with ladies, and he also shows off his dandy side, being fussy about food.

texts.english: One of the refugees aboard the transport ship Idaho. Her pensive eyes have a maturity that hardly seems that of a 16-year-old. But that is natural: she has a major secret and has been living with a thorn in her heart. She stubbornly refuses Kaine's ardent advances at first, but gradually opens her heart. Her knowledge of electronics is also considerable.

texts.english: A 16-year-old refugee girl who was aboard the transport ship Idaho. She is traveling with Linda to look for her parents, from whom she was separated on the Moon. She is full of energy and cheerful, the type who naturally soothes those around her. As the only ordinary person among the three heroines, her ordinariness conversely shone. She quickly entered a steady relationship with Tapp.

texts.english: A civilian boy who lived in Green Noa 1, a colony in Side 7. His hobbies include karate, piloting the Homo Abyss (a one-person small aircraft), and piloting junior mobile suits. He has a strong complex about his feminine-sounding name, and when he punched Jerid for laughing at it, he was taken away by the Titans. After that, through his contact with Quattro, who had infiltrated Green Noa, he joined the AEUG. On that occasion he put up a fight in the Gundam Mk-II, which he was riding for the first time, a performance that made Bright and the others call him "the return of Amuro Ray." After joining the AEUG he continued to achieve great results, and with the blossoming of his Newtype ability he played an ace-class role. He also showed outstanding talent in mobile suit development, and the Mk-II's flying armor and the Zeta Gundam incorporate his ideas. His personality is a complex one in which sensitivity and ferocity, boyish honesty and calculating streaks coexist. At first he joined the fighting out of a vague anger at the Titans, but through his encounters with Quattro, Amuro and Four, he came to fight by his own will in order to bring the war to an end, and grew greatly as a person. He wins the decisive battle against Scirocco on the Colony Laser, but is driven to a mental breakdown. Afterward he spends a life of recuperation with Fa, but in "Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ" he guides Judau and Ple several times. He recovers in the final episode of that work.

texts.english: The leader of the Argama's mobile suit team. His rank is captain, but he is an important AEUG figure who not only fights as a pilot in the Rick Dias and the Hyaku Shiki but also gives his opinion on strategy. He habitually wears sunglasses, and there is much that is mysterious about his words and actions and his past. His true identity is Char Aznable, the Red Comet of Zeon, who was sent from Axis to scout the state of the Earth sphere. He noticed Kamille's Newtype potential early on and looked after him in various ways. At first he concentrated on being a pilot in order to fight the Titans, who threatened the position of the Spacenoids, but through his reunion with his former rival Amuro, the appearance of Scirocco, Blex's death and the speech at Dakar, he becomes a central figure of the AEUG. But after the battle with Haman's Qubeley at the Colony Laser, he goes missing. After that, Char never used the name Quattro again. Incidentally, quattro is the Italian word for the number 4, and it means the fourth name, following Casval, Edouard and Char.

In "Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ," due to a shortage of hands, there were scenes where he served as a pilot, and even after Judau and the others moved to the Nahel Argama he continued to serve aboard and assisted Beecha, who became acting captain.

hands, there were scenes where he served as a pilot, and even after Judau and
the others moved to the Nahel Argama he continued to serve aboard and
assisted Beecha, who became acting captain.

texts.english: A girl who lived next door to Kamille's home in Green Noa 1. After her parents were captured by the Titans, she joined the AEUG and became a pilot. While in Green Noa 1, out of goodwill she wanted to look after Kamille in various ways, but after joining the AEUG she came to rely on Kamille out of anxiety and fear. And because she wanted Kamille to acknowledge her, she pushed herself too hard as a pilot many times. In order to nurse Kamille, whose mind collapsed in the final battle with Scirocco, she leaves the Argama early in "Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ."

texts.english: One of the junk dealer friends of Shangri-La and Judau's best friend. He is good with machines and was active not only as a pilot but also as a mechanic and as bridge crew. He has an honest personality and is a little timid, but he speaks up for his own opinion when he should, and sometimes took brave action for his friends. In the original work he also showed himself in drag along with Judau.

texts.english: A woman who serves as acting captain of Anaheim's supply ship La Vie en Rose. Normally she is a capable commander who handles supply and other matters efficiently, but she has feelings for Bright that go beyond fondness, and she shows girlish bashfulness in front of him. In order to protect the Nahel Argama, she used La Vie en Rose as a shield and lost her life.

texts.english: One of the junk dealer friends of Shangri-La. Within the group she was mainly in charge of gathering information. Her personality is lively and spirited, and she was a quarreling friend of Judau, but inwardly she had feelings for him. After boarding the Argama, she burned with rivalry toward Roux and fought mainly in the Gundam Mk-II. In the course of the fighting she shows a girlish side in front of Judau several times, but in the end she responds to Beecha's feelings.

texts.english: A girl who had been adjusted as a Newtype pilot at Axis. She took to Judau at first sight, and after Glemy's mind control was released, she became a member of the Argama. Her favorite food is chocolate parfait, and she loves baths too. Her everyday life is that of a young girl, and she often troubled Judau and the others with childlike selfishness and possessiveness. But deep inside, she was filled with the loneliness of having been raised as a warrior. Feeling responsible for Leina going missing, she tries to be an emotional support for Judau, but loses her life in the battle with Ple Two.

texts.english: A civilian boy who lived in Shangri-La, a colony in Side 1. He supported himself and his younger sister Leina by working as a junk dealer. He tried to steal a mobile suit from the Argama when it docked, but through circumstance and his innate sense of justice, he drove off Yazan and Neo Zeon in the Zeta Gundam, and this led to his becoming a pilot belonging to the Argama. He is full of drive and vitality, with a constantly bright, positive personality. He fought for his friends and Leina, but as his friends and Leina were drawn into the fighting, he came to have a clear will to fight to end the war. He has high potential as a Newtype as well, and connected hearts with Haman, Ple and others. After winning the decisive battle with Haman, he joins the Jupiter Energy Fleet with Roux for further growth.

texts.english: One of the junk dealer friends of Shangri-La and the leader type among Judau and his group. However, because of his opportunistic and selfish personality, he is not trusted very much by his friends and often clashed with Judau. At one point, judging the situation, he considered siding with Neo Zeon together with Mondo, but in the end he returned to the Argama and fought mainly as the Hyaku Shiki's pilot. After Bright withdrew from the front, he held his friends together as captain of the Nahel Argama.

texts.english: Ple's twin younger sister. She received even heavier mind control than Ple, and her personality is also more aggressive. Fighting as Glemy ordered, she takes Ple's life, but through meeting Judau she comes to doubt her own actions. In the final battle at Axis, riding the Quin Mantha, she finally leaves Glemy's side, also guided by Ple's soul. But her mind and body were already at their limit, and she gives out after guiding the escape of Judau, who had won the decisive battle with Haman.

texts.english: One of the junk dealer friends of Shangri-La. He gets along especially well with Beecha, and at one point they tried to leave the Argama together. Boasting outstanding mechanic's sense, he was active in the colony Moon Moon, for example by repairing an abandoned work mobile suit, a Catl. He was opportunistic by nature at first, but he grew as a person after meeting Rasara, the leader of Moon Moon.

texts.english: Judau's younger sister. A kind-hearted girl who always worried about Judau, who ran a junk business, even while nagging him. After boarding the Argama she was in charge of cooking, laundry and the like, but by chance she was taken under Glemy's protection, and after that she received an education as a lady. When Neo Zeon occupied Dakar, she was shot by Haman while shielding Judau, and was further caught up in the fighting and went missing with her fate unknown. However, after all the battles are over, she is reunited with Judau safely thanks to Sayla Mass.

texts.english: A volunteer soldier of the AEUG who transported the ZZ Gundam's Core Fighter to the Argama. Her trademark is a pilot suit with a meteor marking. After Judau started riding the ZZ Gundam, she served as the Zeta Gundam's pilot. She has a strong-minded personality with a clear will of her own, and at times she clashed with Judau and the others, who were fighting by circumstance, but she gradually came to get along with them as comrades. She was also bewildered by Glemy Toto's one-sided advances, but when she shot him in the decisive battle at Axis, she wept alone. After all the battles are over, she joins the Jupiter Energy Fleet with Judau.

texts.english: The captain who leads the mobile suit unit of the Londo Bell unit. In the One Year War he piloted the RX-78 Gundam, left record-setting results, and at the same time made the Federation aware of the real existence of Newtypes. After the war, however, he was forced to live under house arrest by the Earth Federation, which feared his power. Afterward he joined Karaba, the AEUG's support organization, and served as leader of its mobile suit unit. After the First Neo Zeon War he belonged to Londo Bell, the Federation Forces' external independent unit, and fought the Neo Zeon forces led by his archrival Char Aznable, who was advancing the Earth cooling operation. At the time of the One Year War he was a nervous boy in whom sensitivity and dependence coexisted, but through his encounters during the war he awakened as a Newtype, and through various experiences he grew greatly as a person. After stopping Axis from falling to Earth in the Second Neo Zeon War, he goes missing together with his beloved Nu Gundam, which he himself took part in designing, and with Char.

texts.english: A technical officer of the Earth Federation Forces who is in charge of adjusting the Nu Gundam. She has feelings for her superior Amuro, and burns with extraordinary enthusiasm for adjusting the psycho-frame so as to be of help to him. During the battle at Axis, thinking that even a little would add to his strength, she tries to deliver a psycho-frame sample to Amuro and goes onto the battlefield in a half-destroyed Re-GZ. Then she cuts in between Hathaway and Quess and shoots down the Alpha Azieru, but she is shot and killed by Hathaway, who has flown into a rage over Quess being killed.

texts.english: He served as captain of the White Base in the One Year War, as captain of the Argama in the AEUG, and as captain of the flagship Ra Cailum in Londo Bell as well. He has decisiveness and judgment based on abundant combat experience.

texts.english: A Gundam Fighter representing Neo Russia. Age 26. He was once the leader of a space pirate group famous as colony raiders, but he and his men were captured, and he entered the Gundam Fight in exchange for his comrades' lives. Except during fights, his arms were bound together with a beam chain, and a small bomb to make him obey was planted in the belt on his chest. He is a taciturn man who never loses his self-control, but he hides a burning passion within. He excels at power techniques delivered from a huge frame of over two meters, and he inherits the crest of the Black Joker and becomes a member of the new Shuffle Alliance.

texts.english: A Gundam Fighter representing Neo Sweden. Age 17. She is a second lieutenant in her country's space forces. She lost her parents in early childhood and was given an elite education in a military facility to become a Gundam Fighter, but only after meeting Domon and the others did she feel peace of mind for the first time. A bright and energetic girl, she has feelings for Domon, but in the end she stepped aside, considering his relationship with Rain. She has genius combat sense and uses techniques that build rhythmic gymnastics movements onto a base of martial arts.

texts.english: A soldier of the Neo Japan colony. His rank is major. He holds the belief that power is justice and is also a central figure in the Gundam Development Bureau. He was once a Gundam Fighter, and has the experience of entering the 12th tournament and losing to Master Asia. He is the mastermind of the Devil Gundam incident and tried to seize hegemony using its power, but was defeated by Domon and the new Shuffle Alliance.

texts.english: The Prime Minister of Neo Hong Kong, which became the host nation of the 13th Gundam Fight because Master Asia won the previous tournament. He is ambitious, and the type to scheme without dirtying his own hands. As chairman of the tournament committee he rigged matches and plotted permanent rule over the colony nations using the power of the Devil Gundam, but in the end, infected by DG Cells, he boarded the Walter Gundam and was defeated by Domon. He liked sweet things and always had snacks in his mouth.

texts.english: His full name is Raizo Kasshu. A scientist of Neo Japan, Domon's father, and the developer of the Ultimate Gundam. The Ultimate Gundam used Ultimate Cell that perform "self-regeneration," "self-evolution" and "self-replication," and it was being developed as the ultimate Mobile Fighter with the aim of purifying the Earth's environment. But because of Urube's scheme he was made to take responsibility for the incident of Kyoji's theft of the Ultimate Gundam, and was sentenced to cryogenic imprisonment. He was later rescued by Rain and cooperates with Domon to defeat the Devil Gundam.

texts.english: A Gundam Fighter representing Neo Nepal. An assassin feared as the Grim Reaper Kyral, who killed opponents before their matches in order to win by default. He has superb perception that more than makes up for the handicap of being blind, and excels at the Kyral technique using a sword cane. After fighting and losing to Domon, he set out on a pilgrimage to pray for the souls of the people he had killed until then, but he came rushing to the final battle with the Devil Gundam leading the Gundam Coalition.

texts.english: Sai Saici's minder and foster parent. His name is read "Keiun." A master of Shaolin kung fu, he took part in the tournament as Sai Saici's support crew. He always acts as a set with Zuisen, but he is more the physical-strength one.

texts.english: A Gundam Fighter representing Neo China. He is short and often mistaken for a child, but is actually 16. He comes from a line of martial artists, his grandfather Sai Feilong being the winner of the 4th tournament, but he lost his father at a young age and entered the Gundam Fight aiming to rebuild the Shaolin Temple, his father's cherished wish. He is the successor of Shaolin, and his skill at kung fu is genius-level. He is somewhat of a showoff, and looked up to Domon as his big brother, but he inherits the title of Club Ace and becomes a member of the new Shuffle Alliance. He is good at cooking, and his fried rice is especially superb.

texts.english: A Gundam Fighter representing Neo England who won three times in a row in the past, and pilot of the John Bull Gundam. A gentleman who was called a hero in his home country. He is a master rifle shot, and his three consecutive victories caused a stir in the melee-centered Gundam Fight. He entered the 13th tournament in spite of illness, but was infected by DG Cells and became one of the Devil Gundam's Four Heavenly Kings.

texts.english: A Gundam Fighter representing Neo France. Age 20. The young head of the de Sand family, which values the spirit of chivalry; he entered the tournament together with his butler Raymond for the great cause of protecting the people. He excels at fencing, and the sharpness of his technique is first-rate. He likes fair and square fights and dislikes despicable behavior; he is serious by nature and swore loyalty to his homeland and Princess Maria Louise. He inherited the title of Jack in Diamond and becomes a member of the new Shuffle Alliance. His hobbies are tea and rose growing, and he often acted foppishly, such as scattering roses at the unveiling of a new special move.

texts.english: A Gundam Fighter representing Neo America. Age 20. He was a delinquent from downtown New York, but he embodies the American Dream by winning 100 straight matches in colony boxing. Leading the Chibodee Gals, who are also former delinquents, he entered the tournament to grasp the American Dream again. He has the personality of a true cheerful American, with strong patriotism and sense of justice as well. He inherits the crest of the Queen the Spade and becomes a member of the new Shuffle Alliance. Because of a memory of being caught up in a riot at a circus tent in childhood, he is bad with clowns.

texts.english: A Gundam Fighter representing Neo Japan, the champion of colony martial arts and holder of the title King of Hearts. Age 20. In order to clear his father's disgrace, he entered the tournament chasing the Devil Gundam, which had fled to Earth. King of Hearts is outwardly the title of the Colony Martial Arts King, but in truth it is the proof of the leader of the Shuffle Alliance. The Shuffle Alliance is a group that has controlled conflicts from the shadows of history and prevented the extinction of humanity, and the previous King of Hearts was Master Asia, who was also Domon's master. Domon studied under Master Asia from the age of ten and mastered the School of the Undefeated of the East, and his fighting sense is such that he catches bullets with his bare hands. He also attained the state of Meikyoshisui through training during the tournament and became the winner of the 13th Gundam Fight. By nature he is a headstrong fighting fool, and at first he gave off an unfriendly, standoffish air, but through meeting comrades and talking with fists, he awakened to friendship and love, and in the end grew to the point of, clumsily, confessing his love to Rain.

texts.english: Master Asia's beloved horse. Because it wears a fighter suit itself and operates the Mobile Horse, there is a rumor that it has mastered the School of the Undefeated of the East. After Master Asia's death, it accepts Domon as its rider and acts together with him.

texts.english: A Gundam Fighter representing Neo Italy and pilot of the Neros Gundam. A boss of the Italian mafia, he entered the tournament to show off his own strength. Cruel by nature, he had a special move called Silver Legs, but lost to Domon in the very first episode. After that he was infected by DG Cells and revived, and took on the role of one of the Devil Gundam's Four Heavenly Kings; a rare person whose personality did not change before and after being infected by DG Cells.

texts.english: Domon's partner and childhood friend. Age 20. She is the daughter of Dr. Mikamura and an excellent doctor. She is also well versed in mechanics and supports everything from maintaining the Gundam to looking after Domon. She is not only caring but also energetic, and sometimes fought riding a Gundam. She secretly holds romantic feelings for Domon, but she could not easily say so because of the insensitive Domon and her own heart that cannot be honest. She was used as the core of the Devil Gundam's final form but was rescued by Domon, and delivered the finishing blow to the Devil Gundam with the "Sekiha Love Love Tenkyoken."

texts.english: The pilot of Mazinger Z. He is the grandson of Mazinger Z's developer Juzo Kabuto, and the son of Great Mazinger's developer Kenzo Kabuto. He carried on the will of his grandfather, who was killed by Baron Ashura, and fought Dr. Hell, who plotted world conquest. After his grandfather's death, he moved to the Photon Power Laboratory with his younger brother Shiro and transferred into the first year of the high school division of Tojo Academy. He is an action-oriented hothead who also tends to get carried away, and was often seen rushing ahead and falling into enemy traps. He is also a soft-hearted man of justice and is trusted by those around him. He boasts outstanding athletic ability, and his skill at his hobby, motorcycles, is first-rate. After defeating Dr. Hell, he went to study at NASA with Sayaka, but returned to Japan for the decisive battle with the Mycenae Empire, and boarded Mazinger Z again and fought alongside Great Mazinger. Afterward, he also admirably protected the Earth as a member of the Grendizer Team against the Vegan Empire's invasion. Note that when he appeared in Grendizer, his combat suit had been redesigned.

texts.english: Boss's henchman. As his nickname says, he is a laid-back type. He is relatively sensible, and sometimes spoke against Boss's reckless actions and got scolded for it. He has always been with Boss and Mucha since their Minato Nursery School days, and when they were little he sometimes bullied the crybaby Boss. Surprisingly, he is good at sports and a good skier.

texts.english: Koji's classmate. Partly because he has a crush on Sayaka, he treats Koji as a rival at every turn. To compete with Mazinger Z, he had the three scientists of the Photon Power Laboratory build him his own personal robot, Boss Borot, and joined the fighting together with his henchmen Nuke and Mucha, but was often more of a hindrance. However, he is a warm-hearted man of justice and an irreplaceable best friend to Koji. After Dr. Hell fell and the Mycenae Empire began its invasion of the surface, he cooperated with the Science Fortress Laboratory and fought alongside Great Mazinger. When Koji fought the Vegan Empire as part of the Grendizer Team, he also showed up as a helper. Like Nuke and Mucha, his real name is unknown.

texts.english: Boss's henchman. As his nickname says, he has a reckless personality and rides his motorcycle roughly. He is small but spirited, and sometimes piloted Boss Borot in Boss's place. His grades at school are not good, but he has a streak of cunning and did things like stealing fuel from the Jet Pilder.

texts.english: His real name is Gennosuke Yumi. He is the top disciple of Juzo Kabuto and serves as the director of the Photon Power Laboratory. He is also the developer of Aphrodite A and Diana A, which his daughter Sayaka pilots, and he made numerous modifications to Mazinger Z during the fight against Dr. Hell. He is gentle and calm by nature, and has the sense of responsibility and judgment befitting the director of the Photon Power Laboratory fighting Dr. Hell. After defeating Dr. Hell, he left the fight with the Mycenae Empire to the Science Fortress Laboratory and returned to his original duty of researching Photon Power energy.

texts.english: The daughter of Professor Yumi and the pilot of Diana A. She does not attend high school and helps with her father's research at the Photon Power Laboratory. She is strong-willed, and although she and Koji are like fighting friends, inwardly she worries about him more than anyone. For that very reason, she grew jealous of Koji, who is weak to beautiful women, and the team sometimes failed to coordinate in battle and got into trouble. After defeating Dr. Hell, she studied at NASA with Koji, but returned to Japan for the decisive battle with the Mycenae Empire and threw herself into the fighting again.

texts.english: The developer of Great Mazinger and the biological father of Koji Kabuto and Shiro. He was developing Mazinger Z together with Koji's grandfather Juzo Kabuto, but was seriously injured in an accident at that time and was given cyborg surgery by Juzo. Afterward he developed Great Mazinger and, as director of the Science Fortress Laboratory, stood against the Mycenae Empire's invasion of the surface. He raised the orphans Tetsuya and Jun and holds family affection for them, but out of a sense of responsibility and duty to protect peace, he cannot show those feelings openly and sometimes stays ruthless. He also has a complex about being a cyborg and feels guilty toward Koji and the others, to whom he cannot act like a father. In the final battle with the Mycenae Empire, he threw himself out to save Tetsuya, who, because of his complex as an orphan, had refused to coordinate with Koji and fallen into a pinch, and did not return. In the movie "Mazinger Z vs. the Great General of Darkness," he appears from the opening dressed as a prophet (?) and prophesies the revival of the Mycenae Empire and that Boss Borot will fly through the sky.

texts.english: The pilot of Great Mazinger. In order to pilot Great Mazinger, which was developed as a combat robot, he was taken in from an orphanage by Kenzo Kabuto at the age of seven and put through harsh training. Because he was raised as a combat professional, he has high combat ability even bare-handed. His upbringing and nihilistic way of talking give him an unapproachable, cold impression, but in reality he is kind-hearted and a strict man of justice. He inwardly admires Kenzo Kabuto, who took him in and raised him, like a father, yet has a strong complex about being an orphan. For that reason he was jealous at the sight of Koji and Kenzo, who returned home for the decisive battle with the Mycenae Empire, and made an irreparable mistake in the final battle. Note that at the time "Great Mazinger" started airing, the setting was age 22, but this was later changed to 18, making him more youthful. Incidentally, in the comic version by Gosaku Ota, he has a more comical side than in the TV version while being an even harder character.

texts.english: One of the Hyakki Empire's executives on par with Hidler, and a scientist-engineer. Besides developing and researching robots and weapons, he devises invasion plans, handling the whole of the Hyakki Empire's intellectual side. Many talented young elites seem to gather under him. He is cool-headed, but sometimes behaves strangely. He left the gravity control device to Burai and died in an explosion together with the Combined Hyakki Robot.

texts.english: The pilot of the Poseidon Machine and Getter Poseidon. A transfer student to Asama Academy, he became acquainted with Genki, the son of Dr. Saotome, and was scouted as the Poseidon Machine's pilot for his extraordinary stamina and brute strength. Although he declined at first, he regretted that Genki was injured in an attack by the Hyakki Empire and joined the fighting in the Poseidon Machine of his own accord. By nature he is an easygoing man who dislikes fighting, and he has the gentleness to love animals and children. His hobby is baseball, and he later became captain of Asama Academy's baseball team. Note that in the original work he never uses Musashi's special move, Daisetsuzan Oroshi.

texts.english: The pilot of the Liger Machine and Getter Liger. At the time of the Dinosaur Empire's invasion of the surface, he turned down his classmate Ryoma's request to board the Getter once, but when Michiru, who bears the likeness of his late mother, was in danger, he volunteered to be a pilot himself. He is a cool nihilist with outstanding athletic ability and is also thoughtful, so he is easily misunderstood by others, and he clashed several times with the direct Ryoma and Musashi. Yet he is a quietly hot-blooded man burning with a sense of mission, and deep in his heart he is bound to his comrades by deep ties. His hobby is the harmonica.

texts.english: The daughter of Dr. Saotome and a student at Asama Academy like Ryoma and the others. She helps with her father's research and supports the Getter Team by handling reconnaissance, searching and supply with the Command Machine, Lady Command. She is the Getter Team's madonna, has both a spirited side and womanly gentleness, but several times showed jealousy at the appearance of beautiful guest characters. In the final battle with the Hyakki Empire, she pilots the Liger Machine in place of the absent Hayato. Also, it seems she accepted Hayato's feelings just before that final battle.

texts.english: The director of the Saotome Institute. He lost his eldest son Tatsuhito in the Dinosaur Empire's first invasion, leaving a family of four: his wife Kazuko, eldest daughter Michiru and second son Genki. A leading authority on Getter Ray research, he originally built Getter Robo for space development, but for the war with the Dinosaur Empire he sent out an armed Getter and later completed the new-type Getter Robo for combat. Although he looks shabby with his unkempt beard and geta sandals, he is not only a first-rate researcher but also commands the Getter Team in battle with calm judgment and accurate instructions. His personality is usually gentle, but he also has a side that stops the three hotheads even by shouting at them.

texts.english: The ruler of the Hyakki Empire. He had been hiding in the deep sea for a long time, but after watching the Dinosaur Empire fall and seeing Getter Robo take heavy damage, he raised the Science Fortress Island and set out to conquer the world. In order to replenish energy and to build powerful Hyakki Robots, he targeted the Getter Ray amplifier and attacked the Saotome Institute. He is cold-hearted and ruthless, choosing any means for his ambitions, and even ordered the elimination of Risa, his own real daughter who betrayed the empire. Note that the horns of the Hyakki clan are attached by modification surgery, and they die if their horns are destroyed.

texts.english: One of the Hyakki Empire's executives and its combat commander. He swore loyalty to Burai and drew up a variety of operations. He goes to the battlefield and gives orders to the combat units, and sometimes personally leads bombers into battle. He is cruel and base by nature, and chooses any means to defeat Getter Robo, such as interfering with Tekkouki, who wants a one-on-one duel with Getter Robo.

texts.english: The pilot of the Dragon Machine and Getter Dragon. The captain of Asama Academy's soccer club, he fights as a Getter Robo pilot in place of Tatsuhito, the son of Dr. Saotome, who lost his life in the Dinosaur Empire's invasion of the surface. He has a strong sense of responsibility and a serious, single-minded personality; although he is somewhat inflexible at times, he held the Getter Team together as its leader. His family home in Kyushu is a kendo dojo, he himself has some skill with the sword, and he sometimes fought putting it to use. His prized vehicle is a sidecar, in which he often had Musashi ride beside him.

texts.english: A young man who works at Shirakaba Ranch while helping with the research of his foster father, Genzo Umon. Daisuke Umon is a temporary guise; his true self is Duke Fleed, the pilot of Grendizer. For that reason, when the fight against the Vegan Empire begins, he transforms into his combat suit with the shout "Duke Fleed." Concealing his identity is considered synonymous with protecting the Earth, and few people know his true identity. Normally he is good at guitar and horse riding, a serious young man who loves beautiful nature, and is adored by those around him for his kind heart that cares for others.

texts.english: The director of the Institute of Space Science and the foster father of Daisuke Umon. His full name is Genzo Umon. A renowned scientist with deep knowledge of UFOs and space science, he co-manages Shirakaba Ranch with Danbei Makiba. He took in Duke, who reached Earth, as an adopted son, and watches over him with affection no different from a real son's. Calm and composed, in battle he becomes a commander and gives accurate instructions.

texts.english: The science minister whom King Vega dispatched to Skull Moon Base. He has been ordered by King Vega to cooperate with Commander Gandal, but since they are equal in rank, he sometimes takes independent action. Brilliant, he designed and developed a variety of destructive weapons and Saucer Beasts. He also surpasses Lady Gandal in strategy and scheming, and troubled Grendizer with vicious plans. Under the eyepatch over his left eye is a small computer and projector, which are used for information and battlefield analysis. Incidentally, his son's name is Zuril Jr.

texts.english: The highest authority at the forward base on the Moon, Skull Moon. He gives orders to the operations units at Skull Moon Base and, after Blacky's death, also served as attack captain. His loyalty to King Vega is deep, to the point that he does not hesitate to hurt himself. He also devises cold-blooded plans and thinks nothing of other people's lives to accomplish a mission. Inside him is a separate female personality called Lady Gandal, and the two hold independent views of their own. Gandal prefers to suppress enemies with overwhelming military force, while Lady Gandal excels at bold tactics and psychological warfare using strategy, and the difference of opinion sometimes caused quarrels. In the early period, Gandal's face split open and a small full-body Lady Gandal emerged from inside, but after he suffered serious injuries and underwent plastic surgery, the way she appears changed so that the faces swap by sliding.

texts.english: The dictator who rules Planet Vega. He leads the Vegan Empire and plots to rule the entire universe. Because Planet Vega is on the verge of collapse due to Vegatron radiation, he is after Earth, which has beautiful nature and resembles Planet Vega. After Planet Vega exploded, he went to Skull Moon Base aboard the King of Vega and took command directly. He is a symbol of terror who repeats destruction and plunder with cold cruelty, but he seems to have a soft side toward his daughter Rubina. He was reduced to cosmic dust by the concentrated attack of the Grendizer Team.

texts.english: Duke Fleed's younger sister, age 14. A tomboy who hates being treated with restraint. She has high physical ability no less than her brother's, and her motorcycle riding skill is considerable. She also has mild precognition and once saved Koji's life from an assassin. During the Vegan Empire's attack on Planet Fleed she was separated from her brother and fled to Earth with an old man who seems to have been an attendant; perhaps she sealed away the painful memory herself, as she seems to have believed she was an Earthling. On Earth she was raised as the old man's granddaughter, but the old man, who happened to witness Grendizer fighting, told her all the secrets, and she came to realize her true identity. At first she mistook Daisuke for an enemy and attacked him, but seeing the royal family's pendant she realized he was her brother, they reconciled, and she became the pilot of the Drill Spazer. While being active as a member of the Dizer Team, she came to feel a faint romantic feeling, drawn by Koji's personality.

texts.english: A soldier belonging to King Vega's direct Royal Guard. A whip user with enough skill to accurately pull a glass at a distance to himself. He has calm observation and judgment and excels at tactics that relentlessly attack the opponent's weakness. He attacked and cornered Grendizer during the defenseless "death time" of six seconds from when Grendizer combines with the Spazer until the seat move is complete, and seven and a half seconds from the start of the seat move until separation is complete, but was defeated by Grendizer on its first combination with the Double Spazer.

texts.english: The newly appointed captain of King Vega's direct Royal Guard. A prince of Planet Mole and once Duke Fleed's one-and-only best friend, but he was captured by the Vegan Empire and subjected to mind control, and hated Duke Fleed as the enemy of Planet Mole. During the Vegan Empire's attack on Planet Fleed, he caused Duke Fleed, who tried to help him, to suffer a Vegatron radiation wound. When he faced Duke Fleed in person, the bomb planted in his badge exploded, and the shock brought him back to his senses. After treating Duke Fleed's old Vegatron radiation wound with the Vegatron Minus Beam, he headed to the Moon to attack Skull Moon Base, but lost his life to the self-destruct device that had been set on Jigajiga.

texts.english: The attack captain of the Vegan Empire's Earth invasion operation. Acting on Commander Gandal's orders, he descended to Earth in the Motherburn and took personal command of the effort to defeat Grendizer and subdue the planet. He is a model soldier, burning with a sense of mission and always fighting with resolve to die, but he also has a cowardly side that does not shrink from betrayal to protect his own position. His plans were sloppy at the finish and he failed time and again, and in the end he made a suicide attack on Grendizer and was killed in action.

texts.english: The prince of Planet Fleed, which was destroyed by the Vegan Empire, and the pilot of Grendizer. He has high physical ability and telepathy. When Planet Fleed was attacked, he was exposed to Vegatron radiation in his right arm as the price of saving a close friend. At that time he was also captured by the Vegan Empire and confined, but he seized Grendizer, escaped, and challenged them all alone. But Planet Fleed was destroyed, and afterward he drifted through space and reached Earth, where he lived peacefully as Daisuke Umon. When he learned that the Vegan Empire's hand had reached Earth, at first, because of memories of past battles, he refused to board Grendizer, but he swore to fight to protect Earth, his second home. Sincere and deeply fond of Earth, he is normally mild, but he shows anger toward the Vegan Empire and attacks without mercy.

texts.english: Low-ranking soldiers of the Vegan Empire. They are armed with laser guns and always move in twos or threes. They perform various duties such as guarding bases, carrying cargo, and piloting Minifos.

texts.english: The head of Shirakaba Ranch and the father of Hikaru and Goro. As the president of the "Society for Befriending Space Aliens," he often skipped work to go skywatching, which troubled Hikaru. He is good with a lasso, and when he worked as a cowboy in Texas long ago he seems to have been called "Dan the Quick Draw." He also loves Hikaru too much, and tries to hang any man who approaches Hikaru. Of a bottomlessly cheerful nature, he normally gives the impression of being too precarious to leave alone, but he has also shown a side of a fine father who tightens up when he should. He mistook Koji, who came out of the TFO, for an alien.

texts.english: The eldest daughter of the Makiba family, who works at Shirakaba Ranch. As she worked with Daisuke at the ranch, she came to have feelings for him. When she learned that Daisuke was Duke Fleed, she worried over whether there was anything she could do, decided in the end to fight together with him, and later became the pilot of the Marine Spazer. Blessed with outstanding athletic ability, a high level of riding skill and a light touch of movement, she succeeded in the Combination Cross, which had given Koji trouble, in two attempts during actual combat without special training. Although somewhat of a tomboy when with her younger brother Goro, her cheerfulness plus her gentle nature and strong will became a support for Duke Fleed.

texts.english: The daughter of King Vega and Duke Fleed's former fiancee. She was once sent to Planet Fleed through political maneuvering, and fell in love with Duke at that time. She was told that Duke Fleed was alive on Planet Ruby, which the Vegan Empire governs, and reunited with him on Earth. And she told him that Planet Fleed was recovering from contamination by Vegatron radiation. A woman full of dignity, she wished for the peaceful coexistence of Earth and the Vegan Empire, but she was caught up in the fight between Duke Fleed and Minister Zuril, was gravely wounded, and died.

texts.english: A Royal Guard captain who came to Earth after being ordered by King Vega to defeat Grendizer. A confident tactician, he probed the captured Koji's memories with a confession device, raided the Robot Museum, obtained Great Mazinger, and fought Grendizer.

texts.english: A 15-year-old junior high school student who is thrown into a mad battle regardless of his own will. He lived a comfortable life without any connection to Tekkoryu, but he holds faint memories and knowledge about Zeorymer in his subconscious, and can pilot Zeorymer unconsciously. He is a shy, ordinary boy, with a gentle side that refuses to make sacrifices and cannot be ruthless. However, he has a duality in which his personality changes to a vicious one during combat; he fears this self and suffers in agony. When his personality becomes vicious, his gaze sharpens and the color of his eyes changes. Zeorymer piloted in this state displays its true power, and keeps the other Hakke robots at bay with overwhelming attack power and high-speed movement.

texts.english: The central figure of the Zeorymer awakening project. A person from the Japanese government who has been deeply involved since Zeorymer was placed under its control. He knows the secret of Masato's birth, and leads Masato Akitsu to Last Guardian. He is calm and composed, does not defy orders from above, and carries out his missions reliably. In combat he gives accurate instructions, but not out of concern for Masato; they are strictly for the sake of the Japanese government. He always wears sunglasses and does not show his true feelings.
