texts.english: One of the Hakkeshu and the pilot of Burrstone of the Mountains. Read "Giso." He is a quiet man who secretly loves Rockfell but never says it aloud. A typical warrior, he respects Yuratei. Although he senses signs of treason from Saiga, out of consideration for Rockfell's feelings he cannot bring himself to tell Yuratei.

texts.english: The creator of Masato Akitsu, Miku Himuro and the Hakkeshu. Fifteen years ago, the original Masaki Kihara was an engineer of Tekkoryu, but he fled taking Zeorymer, and immediately afterward was killed by the Japanese government, which feared his defecting. However, he had set into the fertilized egg of his clone Masato that Masaki's personality would awaken when Masato rides Zeorymer, and so he achieves resurrection. The reason Zeorymer can be moved only by Masato and Masaki is that the genes of Masato's fertilized egg were input to the pilot registration system. As an engineer he is a genius, showing talent not only in bioengineering but also in mechanical engineering, and he built the Dimensional Coupler System. He is cruel and cunning, and does not hesitate to sacrifice others for his own aims. His goal is to become the King of the Underworld himself, and having calculated that either the Japanese government or Tekkoryu would rule the world, he left a clone of himself with both of them.

texts.english: One of the Hakkeshu and the pilot of Omzack of the Lightning. Read "Saiga." He belittles Yuratei, and is an outlier among the Hakkeshu in conduct and personality. He speaks with confidence and looks down on others somehow. He is a cold-hearted ambitious man who thinks of taking control of the world, and to that end uses Rockfell's love while knowing of it.

texts.english: A female warrior of the Hakkeshu who pilots Briest of the Fires. She has a twin younger sister, Shi-Tau, in the same Hakkeshu. A martial arts master, she has higher ability as a warrior than Tau, so in combat she gives orders to Tau. She is calm and composed, and loves Tau more than anyone, but her feelings do not reach Tau.

texts.english: A female warrior of the Hakkeshu who pilots Gallowin of the Waters. She feels a fierce inferiority complex about the difference in talent from her twin older sister Shi-Aen, and is dissatisfied about being assigned a support role even in combat. Her emotions swing wildly, and she dislikes her appearance being just like her sister's, so she gets furiously angry when she is compared with her sister.

texts.english: One of the Hakkeshu and the pilot of Lanstar of the Winds. Read "Taiha." He and Yuratei are lovers, but he feels frustrated by a love that cannot be fully rewarded. To make others acknowledge that he is a man worthy of loving Yuratei, and to prove that he is the strongest warrior of the Hakkeshu, he volunteered as the first assassin to retake Zeorymer. He has a warm heart and is the type who charges straight toward his goal. He fought speaking of his feelings for Yuratei to the end, but fell before the "Hades Attack." Also, each member of the Hakkeshu has a tattoo on the palm of the hand that represents his or her title.

texts.english: A girl destined to ride Zeorymer together with Masato Akitsu. When aboard Zeorymer she seems to become the sub-pilot who controls the data, and boards from Zeorymer's chest light sphere. She has accepted her fate and was preparing at Last Guardian for the fight against Tekkoryu. To make Masato, whom she meets for the first time, resolve to fight, she speaks cool, cold words, but inside she is kind and cares for others. Also, she has superhuman physical ability and a tough body, and is a girl with many mysteries.

texts.english: The 20-year-old emperor of Tekkoryu, a giant society plotting world domination. Tekkoryu, known by the nickname Hau Dragon, lay hidden underground for fifteen years behind the hardware company International Electronic Brains, but began to act as soon as the Hakke robots were completed, and is carrying out the Hades Project to turn the world into the underworld and reign as the King of the Underworld herself. Before being chosen as emperor she was one of the Hakkeshu and was supposed to become Zeorymer's pilot. She and Taiha love each other, but because of her position as emperor she cannot love him as a single man. In front of others she behaves with the dignity of an emperor, but she also has womanly weakness, and when Taiha sortied she was crying in her room, holding back her voice.

texts.english: One of the Hakkeshu and a masked warrior who pilots Rose C'est La Vie of the Moon. Read "Ritsu." He gives off a cool, cold air, but inside him swirls an abnormal obsession and hatred toward Zeorymer. Under the mask is the face of a beautiful woman, and that is a trauma for him, who wants to be more manly than anyone. He was the first to learn the secret of his own birth and tried to go against his own fate.

texts.english: The Tekkoryu engineer who developed the Hakke robots. Fifteen years ago, Luhran plotted world conquest using Tekkoryu together with Masaki Kihara, but gave it up because of Masaki's betrayal. Luhran is obsessed with defeating Zeorymer and seems to know the mystery of Zeorymer's energy system. Luhran is timid, but the type who says what needs to be said.

texts.english: A sturdy female warrior of the Hakkeshu who pilots Dinodilos of the Earth. She secretly has feelings for Saiga. For that reason, although she respects and bows to Yuratei, her heart is moved by Saiga's ambition. She is passionate, and because of her strong will, even when she learns that she is being used, she ends up shielding Saiga.

texts.english: Dr. Izumi's granddaughter and the sub-pilot of the Gulver FXII. In the early days she wore a flight cap with goggles when sortieing, but before long she went without a helmet. She calls Kazuya, who was raised with her like a brother, "Big Brother," and has feelings for him, but she realizes Kazuya's feelings for Erika and steps aside. A tomboy who learns karate like Kazuya, she has black-belt-level skill. Also, perhaps because of Dr. Izumi's influence, she is good at tinkering with machines, and once built a see-through camera. When she gets excited or troubled, she has a strange habit of imitating a dog by saying "Uu~, woof!"

texts.english: The person in charge of Daimobic. He is a father-substitute to Kazuya and his karate teacher. He has also displayed karate techniques such as flying kicks and body strikes, with the "Swallow Double Kick" as his specialty. He has a strong sense of justice and is humane, and is highly respected. It is also thanks to Dr. Izumi that Daimobic can fight on its own judgment without being at the beck and call of Commander Miwa, even though Daimobic receives subsidies from the government. He is a first-rate scientist as well, and often holds the key to a turnaround, such as manufacturing the Photon Missile when he felt threatened by the appearance of the Cobrado, and using the power of Daimolite to change Daimos into a pure energy state. However, he loves sweets, and since he sometimes directed battles while licking a lollipop, I cannot help feeling that his dignity was somewhat lacking. In episode 30, "Danger! Dr. Izumi's Life," he was badly injured trying to protect the Daimolite storehouse and was implanted with an artificial cerebellum made by Baam.

texts.english: The daughter of the late Grand Marshal Leon and the sister of Admiral Richter. She had gone to the front lines as a budding doctor to treat soldiers, but the battle saucer she was riding was shot down, and she lost her memory from the shock; Kazuya rescued her and they fell in love. After regaining her memory, she leaves Daimobic, but is confined in the Undersea Castle, and as she is about to be executed for treason, she escapes with the help of her mentor, Hospital Director Worin. After that, too, she is toyed with by a strange fate, drifting from place to place and repeatedly missing her beloved Kazuya. After becoming the new leader of the liberation organization, she resolves to fight for peace by a method different from Kazuya's, and becomes a star of hope for both Baam people who wish for peace and Earth activists. She was originally a woman with the triple qualities of being strong, gentle and beautiful, but her love with Kazuya made her grow greatly in spirit.

texts.english: Erika's nursemaid. She calls Erika "Ohiisama" (my little princess). Because the late Grand Marshal Leon had asked her to look after the futures of the two siblings, she was one of the few people who could admonish Richter inside the Undersea Demon Castle. She has not aged in vain, and noticed the relationship between Erika and Kazuya right away. She kept supporting Erika and Kazuya's relationship, and for that she was charged with treason, had her wings cut off and was made to do forced labor. After being rescued by the Liberation Army, she became a pillar of support as the guardian of Erika, who had become the new leader.

texts.english: The pilot of the Gulver FXII and a maxim enthusiast. A close friend of Kazuya, with whom he served aboard Space Daimobic. He plays the cool nihilist, but has a strong sense of justice and cannot be stopped once he flares up. He says spiteful things to Kazuya at every turn, but there are signs that he says them to spur Kazuya on. He grew up in France, and after losing his mother in early childhood he was taken in by his grandfather, Ittosai Yuzuki, and had swordsmanship drilled into him, so his sword skill is first-rate. He is a cautious man who never lets go of the sword on his back, whatever the situation. But he seems to be bad with women, and keeps his distance on the principle that "a wise man does not approach danger." His glasses are for show, but his head is not for show, and his hairstyle has been the same since childhood.
lines: The pilot of the Gulver FXII and a maxim enthusiast. A close friend of Kazuya,
with whom he served aboard Space Daimobic. He plays the cool nihilist, but
has a strong sense of justice and cannot be stopped once he flares up. He says
spiteful things to Kazuya at every turn, but there are signs that he says them to
spur Kazuya on. He grew up in France, and after losing his mother in early
childhood he was taken in by his grandfather, Ittosai Yuzuki, and had
swordsmanship drilled into him, so his sword skill is first-rate. He is a cautious
man who never lets go of the sword on his back, whatever the situation. But he
seems to be bad with women, and keeps his distance on the principle that "a
wise man does not approach danger." His glasses are for show, but his head is
not for show, and his hairstyle has been the same since childhood.

texts.english: The pilot of Daimos and a karate master. A former astronaut who brought Daimolite back aboard Space Daimobic, dispatched by the International Space Agency. Because his father was posted to the Moon base when he was five, he was raised with Dr. Izumi as a surrogate parent, and was taught karate and shooting. After returning to Earth, he belongs to the Daimobic base, and following his father's last wishes he becomes Daimos's pilot and fights the Baam Earth conquest army. He has a straightforward personality and the stubbornness to stick to his own convictions. In an accident during astronaut training he was left completely paralyzed and once almost gave up on his dream, but he has a past of recovering through bloody effort, and his mental strength is guaranteed. He comes to love the amnesiac girl Erika, and that love will in time lead the universe to peace. His hobby of playing drums is at a professional level. Also, there is data that he tends his hair only once every 36 days.

texts.english: A member of the Koplander Team. She has precognitive ability and the ability to hear Raideen's inner voice, so she gives Akira and the others advice that only she can give. She is a wise and calm woman, the opposite of Mari, and Mari always suspected her relationship with Akira. In the past, in search of something to live for and something to be absorbed in, she was also a member of a biker gang.

texts.english: Akira's classmate and the idol of Rinkai Gakuen. She is the daughter of Director Higashiyama of the Future Engineering Research Institute, with a cheerful, tomboyish personality, and Akira often teased her about how scatterbrained she was. She becomes a pillar of support for the fighting Akira, and in the end, with the sole wish of helping Akira, joins the Koplander Team and backs up Raideen in Bluegar.

texts.english: The director of the Future Engineering Research Institute and the father of Mari Sakurano. To counter the invasion of the Demon Empire, he built the science fortress Mutropolis. While directing it, he formed the Koplander Team to back up Raideen.

texts.english: A sporty boy who serves as captain of the soccer club at Rinkai Gakuen. He is destined to become one (fade-in) with Raideen, the legacy of King Ra Mu. To prevent the arrival of the Age of Demons, he fights the Demon Empire with Raideen. He is a hot-blooded man of justice with a cheerful personality, and has the strength not to lose to his own destiny and the courage not to flinch even in desperate situations.

texts.english: Akira's father and an archaeologist. In the original story, in episode 1 he is turned to stone along with the ship he was on by the Demon forces, and later falls into Sharkin's hands.

texts.english: Ayato's classmate. She is going out with Mamoru Torigai but casts meaningful glances at Ayato. She always acts cheerful, such as by teasing Ayato, but she is the type to keep her true feelings to herself. On the subway heading to the mock exam site, she was caught up, together with Ayato and Mamoru, in a derailment caused by Operation Overlord.

texts.english: An Earth Federation inspector sent to TERRA. 29 years old. His name is read "Isshiki Makoto" (family name first). His career is unknown in detail and wrapped in mystery. He has known Itsuki Kisaragi since childhood, but they are not on good terms. He is ambitious and repeatedly speaks and acts as if looking down on others, and he especially said harsh words to Ayato. He has no hesitation about treating people as tools and can betray others without a second thought. He will use any means to gather information, and exploited the feelings of Sayoko Nanamori, who has feelings for Itsuki Kisaragi. TERRA staff privately gave him the nickname "White Snake."

texts.english: Ayato's classmate. He is Hiroko Asahina's boyfriend and Ayato's best friend. He has a light-hearted personality and is good at cracking jokes and playing the fool, but he is always shot down by Hiroko. Together with Ayato and Hiroko, he was caught up in a derailment caused by Operation Overlord on the subway heading to the mock exam site.

texts.english: An ace pilot belonging to the Federation. 27 years old. She was the only survivor of Operation Overlord, and when she learned that the real objective had been to seize Ayato, she vented her anger on Haruka. At first she disliked Ayato because her comrades had been wiped out in an operation whose only purpose was to seize him, but she gradually warmed to him. Transferred from the Federation to the TERRA air wing, she organized Alpha Squadron together with her former comrades and serves as its leader. She has the Indonesian nickname "Bunga Mawar" (a rose). She is bold, but because she cares about her subordinates she was adored by the Alpha Squadron members. As a soldier she dislikes naive thinking about the Mu, and she doubts the wisdom of making a child, Ayato, fight. At the same time, however, she agonizes over her raison d'etre as a professional soldier. She is a bit of a bad drunk, and after drinking with Haruka she often picks on Ayato.

texts.english: The head of the Bahbem Foundation. His age is unknown. He gives TERRA financial aid and technical support, and is a powerful figure who can apply pressure even to the Federation. He lives on Karun Mutiana Island. The foundation's predecessor, the Naacal Trading Company, was founded in 1576, but the first head's name and appearance are the same as the current Bahbem's. With technology applying excavated OOPArts and the patents for it, he controls the world economy from behind the scenes, a mysterious old man called "the modern-day Rasputin."

texts.english: A 17-year-old boy who was a high school student in TOKYO JUPITER but, after meeting RahXephon, follows a twist of fate. An artistic boy whose hobby is painting, he wants to become a painter in the future. His father is absent and he lives with his mother, Maya Kamina, but they have little interaction, so he does not think much of her. When TOKYO JUPITER was invaded, he met Haruka, learned the truth of the world, and boarded RahXephon in the Room of Rah as it led him. He is easily swept along by his surroundings, but he is the type to come through when it matters. His emotions swing widely, and toward people he dislikes he tends to avoid rather than resist. When he first escaped from TOKYO JUPITER, he felt that values different from his previous ones were being forced on him and felt resistance, but this gradually faded through contact with various people, and he grew as a person. His sense of fashion seems slightly off.

texts.english: The form of Ayato who has reached the true heart "Yolteotl." In this form he has lost his human heart and obtained a god's heart, and he is no longer human. For that reason he does not die even if he is shot. He can change into Shinsei RahXephon at will. Ixtli, in the form of Reika Mishima, appears before Ayato, who moved other people's hearts through his painting, and Ayato once rejected Ixtli. But his feelings for Haruka made Ayato grow enough to accept Ixtli. Incidentally, the reason Ayato's Ixtli had the form of Reika Mishima is that it extracted Haruka's appearance as a teenager, and his romantic feelings for her, from his erased memories. In the world of tuning, Ayato had almost lost the memories of other people. The form in which he has obtained the true face "Ixtli" and the deified heart "Yolteotl" is called "Ixtli in Yolteotl," and it indicates one who has become a complete human.

texts.english: Ayato Kamina's mother and a powerful Mulian. Perhaps because it is just the two of them, she dotes on Ayato, but Ayato does not seem to feel the same way. She holds full authority over the MU Tokyo Government-General, and when the attack on Tokyo began she gave orders from the Tokyo Government-General's central command room. She has supernatural powers such as levitation, and when RahXephon awoke, she cut her cheek on a flying fragment and shed blue blood. She is extremely composed, and even when Ayato escaped from TOKYO JUPITER she saw him off fearlessly.

texts.english: Chief of the Analysis Section of the TERRA Science Research Department. 29 years old. In addition to specializing in research on music centered on the D1 aria emitted by Dolems, he is also in charge of analyzing RahXephon and the OOPArts of the Neriya Temple. He was a university classmate of Haruka, and they once went out together. He currently lives in a mansion with his younger sister, Quon Kisaragi, and his favorite drink is tomato juice. He also paints as a hobby. He has strong self-control and always acts cheerful, but seems to hold complex feelings toward Ayato. Like Quon, Itsuki sometimes calls Ayato "Ollin."

texts.english: The younger sister of Itsuki Kisaragi of the TERRA Science Research Department. Her age, birthday, affiliation and so on are all unknown, and although she is not a TERRA employee she is allowed in the command center and to take part in operations. She lives with her brother, and her favorite drink is a blue drink. She likes music, and plays the piano and the violin herself. She undergoes examinations almost every day, and always wears a Life Module because it is necessary for sustaining her life. She is a mysterious girl who now and then murmurs poetic words that accurately capture incidents and features that are yet to occur. She is easygoing and keeps her own pace, and somehow has a world of her own. Her catchphrase is "Ra-ra...," which she often hummed in the middle of conversations. She calls Ayato "Ollin" and has a mysterious mark on her abdomen.

texts.english: The form of Quon who has reached the true heart "Yolteotl." Whereas Ayato found himself through painting, Quon found her own song by playing the piano. In the world of tuning she acted as if guiding Ayato.

In the world of tuning she acted as if guiding Ayato.

texts.english: An operator in TERRA's Operations Department. 18 years old, with the rank of second lieutenant. Her emotions run strong, and when the Dolem that killed her parents appeared, she became furiously angry at the insensitive Ayato. She is also a sentimental type who can cry for others. She is secretly going out with Soichi Yakumo without telling anyone around her, and she is troubled when she learns of Megumi's feelings for Soichi. Incidentally, her name is written with the Chinese characters for "gold," "lake" and "moon."

texts.english: Commander of the MU Tokyo Government-General Defense Force. Although he was a soldier belonging to the Ministry of National Defense, he defected to the Mu side during the First Mu War and took the post of the person responsible for commanding the defense of the capital. Like the Public Security, he is thought to have been turned into a sub-Mulian. He is servile and timid toward those stronger than himself, and takes an arrogant attitude toward the weak. Because of that, he apparently cannot hold his head up before Maya. He also seems to have a deep-rooted history with Kunugi.

texts.english: The TERRA Commander. 43 years old. His name is read "Kunugi Jin" (family name first). TERRA is an abbreviation of Tereno (special domain), Empireo (heaven, highest heaven), Rapidmova (rapid), Reakcii (reaction), Armeo (army). He is strict about discipline and has a stern face, but is trusted by his subordinates. With his keen insight, he chose words that carried his real intent and repeatedly provoked Ayato. He is calm and composed and always shows a severe expression as TERRA's commander, but he also has the unexpected side of keeping a blue bird, "Michiru," in his own room. He has lived apart from his wife, Mariko, for a long time, and the cause seems to lie in the First Mu War.

texts.english: A public security agent of TOKYO JUPITER. The agent points a gun at Ayato's head to abduct him, but is knocked unconscious by a knee to the face from Haruka, who appears suddenly. The agent was beside Maya in the Room of Rah, and was swallowed by rubble when Allegretto appeared.

texts.english: An intelligence analysis officer in TERRA's Operations Department. Her rank is special captain. 29 years old. A professional who handles anything without a hitch, from hand-to-hand combat to piloting fighters. Even when those around her are excited, she does her work at her own pace and sees through what she has decided. During Operation Overlord she infiltrated TOKYO JUPITER, rescued Ayato, who was about to be abducted by Public Security, and told him the truth of the world. Her personality is cheerful with a motherly side, but at times she acts like an adolescent girl, such as by giving Ayato hand-knitted gloves. She seems to have known Itsuki Kisaragi from before she joined TERRA. She is Elvy's drinking buddy, and they often went out for yakiniku. She lives in the Rikudo house with her younger sister Megumi and her uncle Shougo, and has unusual eating habits, such as putting sugar on natto and putting mayonnaise on her rice.

texts.english: A trainee operator in TERRA's Operations Department. 14 years old. She refuses to go to school and has a complex about her older sister Haruka. She has a faint crush on Soichi Yakumo, and she is best friends with fellow operator Kim, but she does not know that Soichi and Kim are going out. When she was 8, she and Haruka were taken in by their uncle Shougo. She is bright and lively, and has a heart capable of attentive consideration. At Shougo's suggestion, she showed Ayato, who had been decided to lodge at the Rikudo house, around Negoro Island, and they drank ramune together at a candy store. Since they were close in age and had been something like quarreling friends, they quickly warmed to each other.

texts.english: A scientist who serves as Itsuki Kisaragi's assistant. 28 years old. Because she secretly harbors feelings for Itsuki, she plays the part of Haruka's friend, but inwardly she holds intense rivalry. She is acutely conscious of being looked at by others and does not wear her glasses in front of men, but when the other person's gaze turns away, her true feelings seem to show on her face. Normally she is calm, but she suddenly snaps, so she seems to be the type who cannot control her emotions. She also has a past in which her father and brother died in the Bahbem Foundation's basic research on TDD.

She is an old acquaintance of Itsuki Kisaragi and Makoto Isshiki, but both of them have been uneasy around her, then and now. She is calm and composed and almost never shows her emotions. As an envoy of the Bahbem Foundation, she visited Nirai Kanai together with the delivery of the Vermillion.

texts.english: A beautiful girl who guides the awakening of Ayato and RahXephon. She resembles the girl in the painting that Ayato was in the middle of painting. She encountered Ayato in a corner of the ruined TOKYO JUPITER and whispered meaningful words to him. She has special abilities, such as guiding the ALIEL that Haruka was riding to the Room of Rah and activating RahXephon with her song. She was thought to have died when Ayato escaped from Tokyo, but she is a mysterious person who appears before Ayato again and again and acts as if guiding him.

texts.english: A reporter from Amato News who came to Nirai Kanai for an exclusive interview. 36 years old. His name is read "Futagami Johji" (family name first). He excels at gathering and organizing information, and is independently investigating the course of the Mu War and the Shrine of Time and so on. He also links the other party's behavioral psychology and relationships to various mysteries, and asks key persons questions that strike at the heart of the matter. texts.english: The TERRA Deputy Commander. 22 years old, with the rank of major. His name is read "Yakumo Souichi" (family name first). He and Kunugi place absolute trust in each other, and he often takes command in the field in place of Kunugi, who is frequently away. He is affable and attentive even to small details, so he is a prince-like figure who is very popular with both men and women. Although he never loses his smile, he handles things carefully so as not to get too deeply involved, so he sometimes gives a cold impression, but he seems to hold a fervent conviction in the depths of his heart. Incidentally, feeding the blue bird that Kunugi keeps is mostly Soichi's job. He is going out with Kim, but keeps it secret from those around him.

For Ayato, who lodged at the Rikudo house, he made a nameplate, and with his attitude of acting without words he opened Ayato's heart. He is an old acquaintance of Watari and Kunugi and a good advisor to them as well. He should be a shogi master, but he apparently lost to Quon now and then.

texts.english: A young man who protected the world from Dr. Hell's Mechanical Beast army with Mazinger Z. A bright, straightforward hothead who pulls others along. Believing that the only way to solve the Earth's resource shortage was trade with aliens, he studied at NASA's UFO Center, analyzing UFO structures, developing UFOs and researching space science, but because UFOs frequently appeared in Japan, he returned home with the TFO that he had developed. He was the first to realize that Daisuke was Duke Fleed, and they became comrades bound by hot friendship and fought the Vegan Empire together. At first he used the TFO and was sometimes a hindrance, but after he became the pilot of the later-developed Double Spazer, he showed performance that was no less than Grendizer's.

texts.english: A formerly excellent soldier of the Mokuren Assault Yuto Space Corps. A user of Mokuren-style jujutsu. In the days of the Jovian War he fought Nadesico A several times together with Tsukumo Shiratori. But he fell into Haruki Kusakabe's scheme and assassinated Tsukumo at the peace talks between Mokuren and Earth. Regretting that, he later wrote a manifesto beginning with "Hot-bloodedness is not blind faith" and carried out the "Hot-Blooded Coup" within Mokuren together with Genpachiro Akiyama. In the course of it he disappeared. After that, he was picked up by Nergal Heavy Industries and, as a member of the Nergal Secret Service, probed the movements of the Martian Successors. Also, together with Goat, he rescued Akito Tenkawa from the Martian Successors and gave him rehabilitation and training in piloting mobile weapons.

texts.english: A creature that had been lurking in the ancient sea, revived and grown to gigantic size because humans spilled oil into the sea. For that reason it loves oil and attacks tankers. It has the ability to fly, its dragon-neck-like tentacles regenerate instantly even when cut, and it can also rotate them to create strong winds. In addition, its flexible body is immune to missile attacks.

texts.english: The commander of the Earth Defense Force Pacific Regional Headquarters, who also serves concurrently as Japan's chief of national defense. He is, above all, a belligerent man who thinks a few sacrifices are unavoidable in order to win battles. He seems to want to become a hero, and in order to produce results he attacks indiscriminately, including civilians, and tortures prisoners. A born militarist who declares that civilians are noncombatants and so are a burden, useless mouths to feed, and lower than dogs. He believes all Baam people should be exterminated, and dislikes Kazuya, who shields Erika. He also has a hysterical side, immediately hurling discriminatory words at anyone who does not follow his wishes. In the end, he is arrested on charges of repeatedly ignoring orders from the military's upper echelons.
